articles.title: Patrick Mahomes can't hide reaction after Andy Reid broke news he's been working toward for months
articles.standfirst: Reid has cleared the three-time Super Bowl MVP to start
articles.summary: Reid has cleared the three-time Super Bowl MVP to start
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes didn't spend the offseason simply trying to become healthy enough to play again. He spent it trying to become himself again.

That mattered Thursday, when Kansas City Chiefs coach Andy Reid confirmed that Mahomes will start the season opener against the Denver Broncos , completing a long recovery from the torn ACL and LCL he suffered late last year.

“This has always been the goal, to get out there and play Week 1,” Mahomes said. “It was a long offseason. A lot of work, a lot of great people around me — trainers, Brittany, my family — supporting me, but now we get to go out there and play the sport that I love.”

He added that he was “super excited” to return at Arrowhead and face a strong Denver team.

Injury won't change who he is

The obvious concern is whether a quarterback coming off such a serious injury will be more cautious, particularly against a defense capable of pressuring him. Mahomes said that's not how he plans to approach it.

“You’ve got to go out there and be yourself,” he said. “I’ve built up the strength, I’ve built up all the days of rehab so I can be myself.”

He acknowledged that avoiding unnecessary punishment still matters, but made it clear that caution will not become hesitation.

“I’m going to keep myself out of harm’s way like I always will, not trying to take big hits and stuff like that, but I’m a competitor,” Mahomes added. “I signed up for this, and I’m going to go out there and play football.”

That mindset has always been central to Mahomes ’ game. His ability to extend plays, improvise and keep attacking has been as important to Kansas City’s success as his arm talent.

“Playing quarterback is one thing, but you’ve got to love competing to have success,” Mahomes stated. “I’m going to be myself.”

Reid gets version of Mahomes he wanted

Mahomes underwent surgery the day after the injury and attacked his rehabilitation aggressively enough to participate in offseason work and training camp.

He hasn't taken a live game snap since December, but he doesn't expect that absence to create a major psychological barrier.

“I think it’s going to be hard for me not to just be myself when I step on the field,” Mahomes said.

“Usually, you get hit once or twice and you’re kind of like, ‘Alright, I’ve got to go out there and play.’ I’m excited just to be out there on the field again with my teammates and try to find a way to get a win.”

That is probably the most encouraging part of the announcement for Kansas City. Reid isn't getting back a quarterback who sounds tentative about what comes next.

Mahomes is talking like someone who believes the rehab did what it was supposed to do. Week 1 was the target all along and now he gets to prove he's ready for it.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes walks away in anger as knee injury doubts overshadow Week 1 return
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes is done answering questions about his injury.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes is done answering questions about his injury.
articles.body:
A new season is getting closer for the Kansas City Chiefs , and it appears that Patrick Mahomes is ready to return. However, before Week 1 , the quarterback has made it clear that he wants to put all questions about his recovery behind him. The quarterback made it clear that he no longer wants to keep talking about his leg injury after a reporter asked him once again about his physical condition during his meeting with the media on Thursday.

“Hopefully I’m done with the questions about the leg,” he told reporters.

The three-time Super Bowl champion suffered tears to the ACL and LCL ligaments in his left knee during the matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers last December . The severity of the injury raised doubts about his availability for the start of the season, but after a successful surgery, the quarterback was cleared to return to practice in July.

From the moment he underwent surgery, Mahomes set Week 1 as his main goal, and everything indicates he will stay on track with his recovery timeline. The quarterback explained in August that doctors had projected a return nine months after surgery if he followed the proper rehabilitation process.

“It’s nine months. It’s the amount of time [doctors] said from the beginning, that if I did everything the right way, I would be ready to play Week One. I’m someone that, if you put [a goal] out in front of me, I want to go out and get it and maximize every single opportunity, every rep in the weight room, every hour that I can spend in the building to get my body right. This has always been the plan. From the day I got the surgery, as quick as I did, to hopefully the first game of the year, the plan will go accordingly, and I’ll be able to go out there and be myself.”

Head coach Andy Reid also confirmed that there is a strong possibility Mahomes will be the starter in the season opener against the Denver Broncos.

“As far as our roster goes, there's a very good chance that Patrick will go ahead and start unless something were to come up here in the next couple days,” Reid told reporters. “Most likely he'll be the guy that's out there.”

With their offensive centerpiece back, the Chiefs are looking to move past any uncertainty and begin a new season with their sights set on competing for another NFL championship.

articles.title: Travis Kelce’s $25 billion Chiefs boss gives everyone a lesson in humility
articles.standfirst: Clark Hunt could have watched from somewhere dry, but the billionaire Chiefs owner stood in the pouring rain
articles.summary: Clark Hunt could have watched from somewhere dry, but the billionaire Chiefs owner stood in the pouring rain
articles.body:
Clark Hunt could have sent someone else. The billionaire owner of the Kansas City Chiefs has employees, executives and an entire organization capable of distributing flags without him ever stepping into the rain.

Instead, Hunt stood outside a Kansas City-area McDonald’s early Thursday morning, getting soaked as he personally handed $5 Chiefs flags to fans alongside Pro Football Hall of Famer Bobby Bell. The simple moment quickly went viral because people are not accustomed to seeing someone connected to a $25 billion fortune doing an ordinary job in miserable weather.

The flags were part of the Chiefs’ annual Red Thursday fundraiser benefiting Ronald McDonald House Kansas City , which supports families with children receiving medical care. The limited-edition design featured Andy Reid’s famous phrase, “How ’Bout Those Chiefs,” with all proceeds remaining in the Kansas City community.

Clark Hunt understands the importance of being close to the people

The financial comparison makes the scene even more powerful. The Hunt family has an estimated net worth of $25.6 billion, although that number represents the entire family fortune and not Clark alone. Their wealth began with oil tycoon H.L. Hunt and later expanded through energy, real estate, hotels and professional sports.

Clark is the son of Chiefs founder Lamar Hunt and serves as the franchise’s chairman and CEO. He also leads Hunt Sports Group and is closely connected to FC Dallas and Major League Soccer. The Chiefs alone were recently valued at approximately $6.2 billion.

Hunt could spend his mornings inside private offices discussing billion-dollar stadiums, NFL television deals and the future of one of the league’s most recognizable franchises. On Thursday, however, the millionaire businessman was standing outside in the pouring rain and placing flags directly into the hands of ordinary fans.

That does not erase the enormous distance between Hunt’s life and theirs . But it does show that he understands something many wealthy owners sometimes forget: people want to see the person in charge. They want an owner who is willing to come close, look them in the eye and participate in the traditions they are asked to support.

Showing up was also smart leadership. Hunt knows the Chiefs are more than Travis Kelce, Patrick Mahomes, Super Bowl trophies or a valuable NFL business . The franchise depends on people who wear red, buy tickets, stand in bad weather and make the team part of their families.

Not many billionaire owners would personally hand out $5 flags in pouring rain. Clark Hunt did, and for one morning, one of America’s richest sports families offered everyone a small lesson in humility.

articles.title: Taylor Swift becomes an insect: Four new species bear her name
articles.standfirst: Swifties have another reason to celebrate: Taylor now has her own bugs
articles.summary: Swifties have another reason to celebrate: Taylor now has her own bugs
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has entered an unexpected new era: she’s now part of the scientific record. Researchers have named a newly established genus of Australian plant-feeding insects Swiftiephylus, giving the pop superstar an unusual place in entomology.

The genus contains four newly described species, all connected to Swift or her music.

The names include Swiftiephylus taylorae, Swiftiephylus amator, Swiftiephylus intrepidus and Swiftiephylus poetorum. Their Latin-inspired names reference Taylor, Lover, Fearless and poets, respectively.

The insects belong to the Miridae family, one of the largest families of true bugs, which contains thousands of described species worldwide.

The naming idea came from Sarah Schroeder , a doctoral researcher in entomology at the University of California, Riverside, and a lifelong Swift fan.

“It felt authentic to me as a lifelong Swiftie to honor Taylor in this way, as well as bring attention to the diversity of insects that has yet to be discovered,” said Schr o eder in a statement.

The insects have pale yellow bodies decorated with red accents, a combination Schroeder associated with Swift’s blonde hair and red lipstick. The insects are closely associated with Australian she-oaks, and their appearance could help them blend into the flowers and surrounding vegetation.

From forgotten specimens to scientific discovery

What makes the story especially remarkable is that these insects weren’t discovered during a recent expedition. Their specimens were collected during Australian biodiversity expeditions between 1995 and 2004, as part of a major effort that produced more than 50,000 insect specimens.

Many remained in museum collections for years before scientists had the opportunity to examine them closely.

Schroeder and her adviser, entomologist Christiane Weirauch , eventually studied hundreds of specimens borrowed from major natural history collections. Their research showed that the insects represented distinct species, even though they shared host plants and had similar physical characteristics.

The research also demonstrates why taxonomy remains important. Giving an organism a scientific identity allows researchers to study its biology, evolutionary relationships and ecological role. That information can ultimately help scientists understand and protect biodiversity.

Schroeder hopes the unusual connection will draw attention to the enormous number of insect species that haven’t yet been formally identified. Scientists believe vast numbers of insects remain undocumented, meaning discoveries like these are still possible even in collections containing specimens gathered decades ago.

The study describing the four Swiftiephylus species is part of a larger scientific paper documenting 12 newly described insects. Published in Insect Systematics & Evolution, the research adds another small piece to scientists’ understanding of Australia’s remarkable insect diversity.

While Swift is best known for stadium tours, blockbuster albums and a global fanbase, her newest namesakes are considerably smaller.

These Australian plant bugs may never perform on a stage or appear on a music chart, but they’ve gained a place in scientific history carrying the name of one of the world’s most recognizable entertainers.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes has separated himself from the NFL’s QBs in playoff success with a gap no one else is close to closing
articles.standfirst: Mahomes has 17 wins, followed by Aaron Rodgers with 12 playoff wins
articles.summary: Mahomes has 17 wins, followed by Aaron Rodgers with 12 playoff wins
articles.body:
The NFL season is back and for a second consecutive year Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers will be the oldest player. As he embarks on his farewell campaign, Rodgers joins Tom Brady as the only quarterbacks since 1950 to start Week 1 at age 42 or older. Brady ultimately played until he was 45, capturing a ring at age 43 with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2020 .

On the other side of the balance, no rookies will start in Week 1 , but five teams will feature a new signal-caller to begin the season, including Malik Willis in Miami, Geno Smith with the Jets, Kirk Cousins in Las Vegas, Kyler Murray in Minnesota, and Cooper Rush in Atlanta. Furthermore, only 10 of the 32 starting quarterbacks in Week 1 have been with their current teams for more than five seasons.

Patrick Mahomes Stands Alone Atop the Postseason Landscape

When evaluating the premier signal-callers gracing the gridiron this autumn, Patrick Mahomes from the Kansas City Chiefs rests on a tier entirely of his own regarding playoff success, not only for logging a staggering five Super Bowl appearances and capturing three rings, but also for racking up a division-leading 17 postseason victories .

The reality is that prior to last year's structural shifts, Mahomes had triumphed in at least one playoff game across all of his seven seasons as an entrenched starter, constantly anchoring his squad deep in the AFC Championship Game .

Consequently, the superstar passer approaches this fresh campaign fueled by competitive hunger, determined to steer his franchise right back into dominant winning ways.

Active Playoff Win Leaders Across the League

Trailing behind Mahomes' unmatched pace sits Aaron Rodgers with 11 postseason wins , making this elite tandem the only active field generals boasting more than 10 playoff victories.

Securing third place stands Josh Allen with 8 wins , followed closely by veteran Matthew Stafford with 7 victories in fourth, while Super Bowl 59 MVP Jalen Hurts holds fifth place holding 6 wins .

Rounding out the elite tier, Joe Burrow and Brock Purdy each command 5 postseason victories, completing the exclusive circle of contemporary quarterbacks who have accumulated five or more playoff triumphs as the league battles through another grueling championship chase.

articles.title: Andy Reid expects DT Chris Jones to play Week 1 vs. Broncos despite calf issue
articles.standfirst: Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid remains optimistic about his defensive centerpiece despite a late calf problem
articles.summary: Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid remains optimistic about his defensive centerpiece despite a late calf problem
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appear likely to have Chris Jones available for their opening game of the 2026 NFL season despite a late injury concern involving the veteran defensive tackle.

Jones was added to Kansas City 's injury report Friday with a calf issue and was limited during practice. The development immediately raised questions about whether one of the Chiefs ' most important defensive players would be able to take the field against the Denver Broncos .

However, head coach Andy Reid has provided a positive update. According to reports from the Chiefs ' final preparations, Jones was held out of Saturday's practice after his calf tightened up Friday, but Reid did not sound overly concerned about the situation.

" Andy Reid said Chris Jones was held out of today's practice because his calf tightened up Friday. ‘I think he'll be all right,' Reid said of Jones ," Nate Taylor of ESPN reported.

Jones was still present at practice Saturday, although he did not wear a helmet. Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reported that the defensive tackle went through warmups and stretching while wearing a compression sleeve on his left calf.

" Chris Jones was out at practice Saturday but without a helmet. He had a compression sleeve on his left calf. He was going through warmups and stretch," Sweeney reported.

The Chiefs ' decision to be cautious with Jones is particularly understandable given that the team does not have to play until Monday night. The extra recovery time could give the 32-year-old more opportunity to make sure the calf is ready before he takes the field at Arrowhead Stadium.

The latest official injury information also provides encouragement. Jones was listed as limited on Friday but did not receive a game-status designation on the Chiefs ' final report, meaning Kansas City has not formally ruled him out or labeled him questionable for the matchup.

Jones remains central to Kansas City's defensive plans

There is little doubt why the Chiefs would prefer to have Jones available for the first game of the season.

The veteran has established himself as one of the NFL's premier interior defensive linemen since Kansas City selected him in the second round of the 2016 draft.

He enters his 11th season with the franchise and has accumulated 87.5 career sacks, which ranks among the best totals for defensive tackles since he entered the league.

Jones was also selected to his seventh Pro Bowl following the 2025 season. He finished that campaign with seven sacks and 29 combined tackles across 17 games, continuing an impressive run of production despite being one of the most heavily scrutinized players on opposing offensive lines.

His ability to collapse the pocket from the middle could be particularly valuable against Denver.

The Broncos enter the season with Bo Nix returning at quarterback, while Denver will be looking to build on a 2025 campaign in which the team ended Kansas City's long reign atop the AFC West. The Broncos are therefore not simply another Week 1 opponent for Reid's team.

Kansas City is also entering a pivotal season of its own. Patrick Mahomes is preparing to return from the knee injury that ended his 2025 campaign, and Reid has indicated that Mahomes is expected to start if there are no setbacks.

That makes the opening-night matchup especially important for a Chiefs team attempting to immediately reassert itself in the division.

Kansas City will already be without two starters, with Josh Simmons and Chamarri Conner ruled out for the opener. Keeping Jones on the field would therefore provide a significant boost to a defense that will have its hands full with Denver's offense.

The Chiefs and Broncos are scheduled to meet at Arrowhead Stadium on Monday, September 14, with kickoff set for 8:15 p.m. ET.

For now, Reid's assessment suggests the Chiefs are taking a precautionary approach rather than dealing with a major injury. If Jones continues progressing over the next two days, Kansas City should have its defensive anchor available when the AFC West rivals meet under the Monday night lights.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes’ backyard football field has an unexpected opponent and Brittany is showing the damage
articles.standfirst: A group of birds has turned the Mahomes’ home field into their personal playground
articles.summary: A group of birds has turned the Mahomes’ home field into their personal playground
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes is used to facing aggressive defenses, but the opponent attacking his family’s backyard might be the one he can’t beat. A group of eagles has been repeatedly pecking at the grass on the football field installed at their Kansas City-area home, and Brittany Mahomes is documenting the damage.

In a series of posts on her Instagram Stories, Brittany showed the birds scattered across the field, pecking at the turf and leaving visible marks behind. The mess didn’t stop at the playing surface. “They also destroyed all our blow-ups,” Brittany wrote, adding a smiling emoji that seemed to express frustration rather than amusement.

The Eagles keep coming back

The eagles first appeared around July , according to Brittany. By August, she thought they had left for good. “But sadly they left,” she wrote at the time. “I think they had their babies and now they’re gone they come back for mating season, maybe, I don’t know.” Her prediction turned out to be accurate: the birds returned, and this time they brought more damage.

For Mahomes , who spends his Sundays reading NFL defenses, this is a different kind of problem: no game plan, no blitz pickup, and no way to stop the birds from winning. While he prepares for another season with the Chiefs, Brittany is left to deal with the aftermath, one peck at a time. The backyard may be built for football, but right now, it belongs to the eagles.

For Mahomes, this is a different kind of problem than the ones he faces every Sunday. On the field, he knows how to read defenses and find solutions. In his own backyard, there is no play that works. Brittany is the one dealing with the mess while he gets ready for another season with the Chiefs. The football field is there for training, but for now, it belongs to the birds.

The Chiefs open their 2026 season on Monday, September 14, against the Denver Broncos at Arrowhead Stadium on Monday Night Football. It is a chance for Kansas City to bounce back after a disappointing 6-11 season in 2025, when Mahomes missed time with a season-ending knee injury.

Mahomes finished last year with 3,587 passing yards, 22 touchdowns, and 11 interceptions below his usual standard. He already holds the Chiefs' franchise records with 35,939 passing yards and 267 touchdown passes, and he enters 2026 with something to prove.

articles.title: Travis Kelce names the one thing that tops winning a Super Bowl with Chiefs: "The best night of my life"
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City star says marrying Taylor Swift surpassed even the biggest nights of his football career.
articles.summary: The Kansas City star says marrying Taylor Swift surpassed even the biggest nights of his football career.
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has spent years collecting some of the biggest prizes in the NFL, but the Kansas City Chiefs star has now made clear that one night is above everything he has achieved on the field.

Kelce married Taylor Swift at Madison Square Garden on July 3, with around 1,000 guests in attendance, and he has finally opened up about the experience in a newly released ESPN interview.

When Chris Berman asked whether the wedding had really happened, Kelce replied: "This is true, this is true," before joking, "Didn't I see you there?"

He then made his feelings about the occasion unmistakable.

"It was the best night of my life," Kelce said.

Kelce says wedding surpassed expectations

The tight end, who has won multiple Super Bowls with the Chiefs , described marrying Swift as something even greater than he had imagined.

"Marrying Taylor was more than I could have ever dreamed it to be because of all the people that showed up, and the amount of, you know, love that was in the air."

Patrick Mahomes was among the guests and also offered his own view of the celebration.

"My perspective, it was a lot of fun, I did a little dancing," Mahomes said.

The Chiefs quarterback was still recovering from his ACL and LCL injuries at the time, which limited just how far he could go on the dance floor.

"I didn't know if I was gonna be able to dance, and it was good to get my first dancing experience of the offseason."

Kelce reflects on a night to remember

Kelce had already spoken about the wedding on his New Heights podcast earlier in September, where he thanked those who attended.

"Me and Taylor are so thankful for everybody that showed up," he said.

"From the vows to just seeing everyone, to how much fun we had, throughout the entire evening.

"And hearing that, kind of be relayed through everybody's stories of the night. And it was just so magical, man."

articles.title: An NFL legend's slip-up could cost him dearly: Did he break the confidentiality agreement regarding Taylor and Travis's wedding?
articles.standfirst: Charles Woodson's playful attempt to find out who attended Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding produced an awkward moment on live television
articles.summary: Charles Woodson's playful attempt to find out who attended Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding produced an awkward moment on live television
articles.body:
C harles Woodson may have discovered one thing about Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's wedding that he probably did not want to hear: even NFL legends were not necessarily getting through the door.

The Hall of Famer found himself at the center of an amusing exchange during Fox NFL Kickoff when a discussion about the Kansas City Chiefs suddenly moved away from football and toward Kelce's hugely publicized wedding to Swift .

Thompson was hosting the program alongside Woodson and former New England Patriots star Julian Edelman ahead of the new NFL season.

Woodson had been discussing Kansas City's chances of returning to the top of the AFC after a disappointing campaign when he began considering how motivated Kelce might be after his offseason wedding.

Woodson said: "The other part of that dynamic duo is Travis Kelce. How hungry can he be? He just had the wedding of the century…"

Edelman immediately responded: "It was a great wedding."

That answer caught Woodson's attention. He stopped his football analysis and asked: "Hold on. Did you go?"

Edelman did not exactly hide his involvement, simply repeating: "It was a great wedding."

Woodson then turned his attention toward Thompson , asking whether she had attended the celebration too. That's when the Fox host made it clear that there were limits to what she could reveal.

She joked: "That's not important right now. We signed NDAs."

The comment instantly changed the tone of the exchange. Rather than confirming any specific private details about the wedding, Thompson appeared to be reminding her colleagues that attendees had agreed to keep certain information confidential.

Woodson then jokingly complained about his own absence from the guest list: "I thought I had the Ohio connection with him. I thought I would be the one invited."

Thompson teased him by suggesting his invitation may simply have gone missing, telling him it was "probably just lost in the mail."

Woodson's response was to question Edelman about his Super Bowl résumé. After the former Patriots star revealed that he had won three championships, Woodson joked: "That's probably why. I didn't get invited."

Why the wedding secrecy has become such a talking point

Swift and Kelce's July 3 wedding was always expected to attract enormous attention, but the couple managed to maintain a significant degree of privacy despite the scale of the event.

The ceremony took place at New York City's Madison Square Garden, with around 1,000 guests reportedly attending. Adam Sandler officiated, while Kelce's brother Jason served as best man and Swift's brother Austin was her man of honor.

The guest list also brought together two enormous worlds: Swift's entertainment circle and Kelce's NFL network. Reports have identified major sports names among those present, including Tom Brady, Patrick Mahomes, Erin Andrews, Michael Strahan, Rob Gronkowski and Peyton Manning .

Recent coverage has also shown that the couple is becoming somewhat more open about the celebration. Kelce has described the wedding as "magical" and recently spoke about how meaningful it was to have so many loved ones together in one place.

Thompson herself has previously referred to the occasion as "magical" while discussing it with fellow broadcaster Erin Andrews on their Calm Down podcast.

Still, the playful Fox NFL Kickoff exchange demonstrates that the couple's guests may have been expected to respect clear boundaries regarding what they could disclose publicly.

There is no indication that Woodson actually believed Thompson had committed a serious breach of confidentiality.

The entire conversation was presented as a joke, with Woodson simply playing the role of the disappointed former player who could not understand why Edelman and Thompson had made the guest list while he had not.

Now, however, the wedding talk has given way to a much more important matter for Kelce and the Chiefs: football.

Kansas City enters the 2026 season hoping to rebound after missing the playoffs for the first time during the Patrick Mahomes era.

Mahomes is returning after suffering a torn ACL and undergoing surgery last season, while the Chiefs have also added Kenneth Walker III and brought Eric Bieniemy back as offensive coordinator.

Kelce , meanwhile, has decided to continue his playing career, giving Kansas City another crucial piece of its attempt to return to contention.

As for Woodson , he may not have received an invitation to the wedding, but he now has a much better consolation prize: a front-row seat to watch whether Kelce, Mahomes and the Chiefs can turn the page on last season and begin their latest NFL campaign with a statement.

articles.title: Mariska Hargitay tells Jimmy Kimmel why Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding left her "on cloud nine"
articles.standfirst: The "Law & Order: SVU" star opened up about the couple's July celebration
articles.summary: The "Law & Order: SVU" star opened up about the couple's July celebration
articles.body:
Mariska Hargitay is still basking in the memories of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce 's wedding, and she has now given fans a glimpse into why the celebration made such a lasting impression on her.

The "Law & Order: SVU" star appeared on " Jimmy Kimmel Live!" on September 9, where she discussed attending Swift and Kelce's July wedding at New York City's Madison Square Garden.

Hargitay attended alongside her husband, Peter Hermann , and said the experience exceeded anything she had anticipated.

"I’m still floating from that wedding," Hargitay admitted. "It was so spectacular and so intimate, I have to say. I have to say, I am blown away, because [when there’s a wedding with that many guests], you think, like, "Oh, okay, it’s gonna be that." And it just wasn’t."

The scale of the event made that intimacy particularly surprising. Swift and Kelce brought together a huge collection of friends, relatives and famous faces at the iconic Manhattan venue, which ordinarily has a capacity of roughly 20,000 people.

Their wedding was confirmed by Swift's representative after months of intense speculation surrounding the date and location.

Rather than focusing on the celebrity spectacle, however, Hargitay said one of the most personal elements of the ceremony stood out above everything else.

"I even say that the vows were my favorite part of the whole wedding," she continued. "It was that magical."

That reaction provides an interesting perspective on an event that attracted enormous attention because of the global fame of both newlyweds.

The ceremony was officiated by actor Adam Sandler , while Swift's brother Austin served as her "Man of Honor" and Kelce's brother Jason was his best man. The couple did not have additional bridesmaids or groomsmen.

Hargitay and Swift's friendship goes well beyond the wedding

Hargitay's presence at the wedding was hardly a random celebrity invitation. She and Swift have maintained a friendship for years, with their connection dating back to Swift's "Bad Blood" music video.

Their relationship even inspired one of Swift's most recognizable personal tributes to the actress: the singer named one of her cats Olivia Benson after Hargitay's iconic "Law & Order: SVU" character. Hargitay has also spoken warmly about Swift's personality and their friendship.

That connection has extended into their shared love of basketball. In June, Hargitay and Swift were photographed together while attending Game 4 of the NBA Finals involving the New York Knicks.

Hargitay recalled the experience on Kimmel's show, including Swift's enthusiasm for getting her properly dressed for the occasion.

"She was throwing me around like a rag doll!" Hargitay said about the singer.

The actress was also asked whether Swift might eventually make an appearance on "Law & Order: SVU," potentially joining the long list of celebrities who have expressed interest in appearing on the long-running NBC drama.

Hargitay was skeptical. "I don’t know, somehow I think she’s super busy," the actress laughed.

For Hargitay, the wedding discussion comes during an unusually successful period in her own career. She recently earned two Creative Arts Emmy Awards for "My Mom Jayne," her documentary about her late mother, actress Jayne Mansfield.

The Television Academy lists Hargitay as the winner of Outstanding Documentary or Nonfiction Special and Outstanding Directing for a Documentary/Nonfiction Program.

She is also making history as host of the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, becoming the first woman to host the ceremony since Jane Lynch in 2011. The awards are scheduled to air live on NBC and Peacock on September 14.

That busy schedule has not stopped Hargitay from looking back fondly on the summer's biggest celebrity wedding.

While Swift and Kelce's marriage attracted attention because of its star-studded guest list and extraordinary scale, Hargitay's description suggests that the couple managed to make the occasion feel personal for the people closest to them.

And for someone who has known Swift for more than a decade, the actress appears to have experienced the celebration not simply as another major Hollywood event, but as a deeply personal milestone for a close friend.

articles.title: Broncos vs Chiefs: Where to watch Patrick Mahomes on Monday Night Football and what time the game starts
articles.standfirst: Chiefs and Broncos open their season at Arrowhead: Mahomes hosts Bo Nix in the first AFC West matchup
articles.summary: Chiefs and Broncos open their season at Arrowhead: Mahomes hosts Bo Nix in the first AFC West matchup
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL season kicks off with a blockbuster AFC matchup. The Kansas City Chiefs open their campaign at home against the Denver Broncos in Week 1, a divisional clash that often defines the pulse of one of the most competitive divisions in American football.

With Patrick Mahomes leading the home team's attack and Denver betting on the continuity of their young quarterback Bo Nix, the start at Arrowhead promises intensity from the first snap.

Schedule and where to watch the first game at Arrowhead Stadium

The match will be played at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, a colossus with a capacity of 76,416 fans that is among the loudest and most hostile environments in the entire league.

Kickoff is scheduled for Monday, September 14, 2026, for the first game of Monday Night Football; the time will be:

During the season and for this game, Monday Night Football will be broadcast on ESPN and ABC ; while the game can be streamed on the ESPN and Fubo apps.

Who will win the first Monday Night Football game of 2026? Prediction and odds

Various sportsbooks have the Chiefs as clear favorites for the start of the season. The moneyline gives Kansas City an implied probability of 56.6%, compared to Denver's 43.4%.

The point spread hovers around -2.5 / -3 points in favor of the home team, a moderate advantage that reflects the weight of playing at home but also the respect commanded by the Broncos' defense.

In the total points market, the line is set at 43 and 43.5 points, with very similar odds between the over and under (1.91 on 43 points, 1.98 on the under). This is a relatively modest total for a game featuring Mahomes, indicating that bookmakers anticipate a more tactical than offensive contest.

Broncos vs Chiefs lineups: Mahomes versus the new era in Denver

The heart of the game, as is almost always the case in this division, is the man under number 15. Patrick Mahomes leads an offense that blends veteran experience with explosive youth. Around him, Kansas City relies on wide receiver Rashee Rice and the speedy Xavier Worthy as aerial weapons, while the ever-present tight end Travis Kelce, now 36, remains the go-to player in clutch situations.

In the backfield, the addition of Kenneth Walker III brings an impact running back who can ease the load on Mahomes' arm.

On the other side, Denver relies on Bo Nix, the 26-year-old quarterback who takes command of the visiting offense. The receiving corps looks revamped and experienced: veteran Courtland Sutton provides size and reliability, while the addition of Jaylen Waddle adds elite speed on short and medium routes.

Tight end Evan Engram provides Nix with a reliable target in midfield, and on the ground, JK Dobbins and young RJ Harvey look to balance the offense so as not to leave the rookie quarterback alone.

The offensive line will be a determining factor for both: Kansas City relies on the interior block of Creed Humphrey and Trey Smith, while Denver protects Nix with veteran tackle Garrett Bolles at the front of his wall.

Implications for the AFC at the start of the season

As it's the first week of the season, the AFC West standings start completely blank, with all teams having yet to play a match. That's precisely why a divisional matchup in Week 1 carries double the weight: head-to-head matchups within the division are the primary tiebreakers at the end of the year, and securing this victory means both a win in the overall standings and a direct advantage in the head-to-head record.

For the Broncos, stealing a win at Arrowhead would be a statement of intent; for the Chiefs, defending their fortress is a way to set an example from the start of the season.

What's the prediction for Broncos vs Chiefs? Monday Night Football prediction

Arrowhead in Week 1, with Mahomes throwing and a deafening atmosphere, is a scenario that historically weighs heavily on visiting teams, especially a young quarterback like Nix.

The Broncos have weapons to trouble their opponents and a defense capable of keeping the score low—hence the restrained 43-point total—but home-court advantage and the home team's offensive prowess tip the scales. The prediction: a narrow victory for Kansas City, in a game that could come down to the point differential and be decided in the final quarter.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes enters Week 1 with three numbers that show why the Chiefs should feel confident against the Broncos
articles.standfirst: Mahomes has a 10-4 record on Mondays and a 13-2 record against the Broncos in his career
articles.summary: Mahomes has a 10-4 record on Mondays and a 13-2 record against the Broncos in his career
articles.body:
And just like that, we are one game away from wrapping up Week 1 of the new NFL season following a historic Sunday slate where 13 games combined for an incredible 693 total points , averaging 53.3 points per game and marking the highest-scoring Week 1 Sunday in league history.

The curtain falls on this anticipated opening week with a blockbuster Monday Night Football showdown between divisional rivals the Kansas City Chiefs and the Denver Broncos , matching up two projected AFC playoff contenders.

This duel carries extra weight after Denver snapped Kansas City's nine-year stranglehold on the AFC West division title last season, boasting a stout defense ready to test quarterback Patrick Mahomes , who did not take a single preseason snap for the first time in his career, making this his first full-speed game action in nine months.

Why Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs Are Primed for Monday Night

Mahomes' triumphant return arrives exactly nine months after he suffered a devastating tear to both the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and the lateral collateral ligament (LCL) in his left knee.

Having their superstar signal-caller back at full strength is a massive relief for Kansas City; since taking over as the full-time starter in 2018, no player in the league has accumulated more regular-season wins (94) , passing touchdowns (267) , or passing yards (35,655) .

Furthermore, his 17 playoff victories lead all active players and rank second all-time behind only Tom Brady's 35 postseason wins .

Heading into tonight's divisional clash, the Chiefs are favored by fewer than three points at most major sportsbooks, a spot where they historically thrive with an elite 30-13-1 ATS record when laying less than three points or playing as an underdog.

Digging deeper into the historical trends, Mahomes brings staggering individual dominance into the opener, holding a 6-2 record in Week 1 games, a 10-4 mark on Monday Night Football , and an impressive 13-2 career record against the Broncos (7-0 at home), though two of those losses have occurred across their last three meetings.

This prime-time matchup serves as an ideal litmus test for Kansas City; a statement victory over a high-caliber opponent like Denver would immediately silence doubters, whereas another setback would cast lingering questions over their trajectory in a hyper-competitive conference.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce to welcome a baby girl next summer: What the tarot says about their future
articles.standfirst: After their dream wedding, the couple could be preparing for their next big chapter
articles.summary: After their dream wedding, the couple could be preparing for their next big chapter
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce could be heading toward another major milestone in their relationship, if a celebrity tarot reader’s latest prediction is anything to go by.

Celebrity tarot reader Angie Banicki has offered her thoughts on what may lie ahead for the newlyweds, suggesting that starting a family could eventually become part of their future. During an exclusive reading for The Daily Mail, Banicki said the cards pointed toward children for Swift and Kelce, with particularly strong signs of a baby girl.

However, Banicki doesn’t believe the couple will rush into parenthood. Instead, she sees the pair spending the coming months enjoying their marriage and making the most of their time together before taking that next step.

According to her reading, next summer could mark an important turning point, with “baby girl vibes” emerging strongly from the cards.

“I feel like they're taking almost until next summer. It feels like they want to be really slow and deliberate with it,” she said.

“They're not trying yet. I keep getting like vacation time, like just wanting to spend it with each other... I'm getting baby girl vibes. Yep, I'm getting [a] baby girl.”

Banicki believes Swift and Kelce are focused on their relationship and enjoying the excitement that comes with being newlyweds.

Her prediction comes after the couple celebrated their wedding in spectacular fashion at Madison Square Garden in July, surrounded by family, friends and an impressive collection of celebrity guests.

A new chapter after their wedding

Kelce has since opened up about just how meaningful the wedding was to him. During a recent ESPN interview, the Kansas City Chiefs star described marrying Swift as the best night of his life, explaining that the occasion was beyond anything he could’ve dreamed of.

"Marrying Taylor was more than I could have ever dreamed it to be because of all the people that showed up, and the amount of, you know, love that was in the air,” said Kelce .

He also praised the love surrounding them and the people who came together to celebrate their relationship.

The football star previously discussed the wedding during the September 2 episode of his New Heights podcast with his brother, Jason Kelce . He called the evening “magical” and said he wished it could’ve lasted longer, while expressing gratitude to everyone involved in creating the intimate celebration.

Despite the excitement surrounding the wedding, Swift and Kelce have kept many details private. The couple hasn’t publicly revealed every aspect of their celebration, leaving fans eager to learn more about their big day and what married life looks like behind the scenes.

Banicki believes that some of those wedding details could eventually be shared, while also seeing the ceremony as the beginning of an entirely new phase for the pair.

The couple appear to be enjoying their newlywed chapter for the time being. But if Banicki’s cards are right, they could have an even bigger reason to celebrate next summer.

articles.title: Is Taylor Swift at Broncos vs. Chiefs tonight? Denver's record with her in attendance
articles.standfirst: As fans wait to see if Swift arrives at Arrowhead, the Broncos hope to improve on their intriguing record when she's watching from the stands.
articles.summary: As fans wait to see if Swift arrives at Arrowhead, the Broncos hope to improve on their intriguing record when she's watching from the stands.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has become a familiar face at Kansas City Chiefs games, making one of the biggest off-field questions resurface this Monday: Will she be at Arrowhead Stadium for Kansas City's season opener against the Denver Broncos?

As of Monday afternoon, the pop star's attendance had not been confirmed. Still, there's an interesting trend: every time Swift has attended a Chiefs-Broncos matchup, Denver owns a 1-2 record in those games .

Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs game?

As of now, there have been no confirmed sightings or reports of Taylor Swift at Arrowhead Stadium ahead of the Broncos-Chiefs showdown .

Kansas City hosts Denver on September 14 , with kickoff scheduled for 7:15 p.m. local time . The game marks the season opener for both teams and wraps up Week 1 of Monday Night Football .

Since going public with her relationship with Travis Kelce in 2023 , Swift has attended several Chiefs games. However, her schedule and the secrecy surrounding her appearances make it nearly impossible to know whether she'll attend until game day.

For now, the answer remains the same: she could be there, but nothing has been officially confirmed.

The Broncos are 1-2 when Taylor Swift is in the stands

To date, Taylor Swift has been publicly documented at three Chiefs-Broncos games, all of them played at Arrowhead Stadium.

Her first appearance came on October 12, 2023 , when Kansas City defeated Denver 19-8 . That night, Travis Kelce finished with nine catches for 124 yards.

She also attended the November 10, 2024 matchup, when the Broncos came within inches of pulling off the upset. Denver led 14-10 at halftime and had a chance to win with a late field goal, but Kansas City blocked Wil Lutz's attempt as time expired to escape with a 16-14 victory .

Denver's only win with Swift in attendance came on Christmas Day 2025 , when the Broncos beat the Chiefs 20-13 at Arrowhead. Bo Nix led the comeback before connecting with RJ Harvey on a one-yard touchdown pass with 1:45 remaining to seal the victory.

As a result, Denver owns a 1-2 record in Chiefs-Broncos games attended by Swift.

It's hardly a statistic that will change Sean Payton's game plan, but it does show that Swift's presence has hardly been a "curse" for the Broncos.

Taylor Swift has only attended this rivalry at Arrowhead

Another interesting wrinkle is that Taylor Swift has never been publicly spotted at a Broncos-Chiefs game in Denver.

In fact, some of Denver's biggest recent wins over Kansas City came without her in attendance.

Swift was not at the game when the Broncos snapped their 16-game losing streak against the Chiefs with a 24-9 victory on October 29, 2023 . She also reportedly missed Denver's 22-19 win over Kansas City in November 2025 .

In other words, the Broncos have beaten the Chiefs both with Taylor Swift in the stadium and without her.

The real storyline on Monday, however, is whether Denver can continue its rise to the top of the AFC West . The Broncos enter the season as the defending division champions, while Kansas City is looking to bounce back after a disappointing 6-11 campaign .

If Taylor Swift shows up at Arrowhead, the cameras will undoubtedly find her. But the Broncos will be far more focused on leaving Kansas City with another victory than on who's sitting in one of the stadium's luxury suites.

articles.title: Travis Kelce shows up without Taylor Swift but proudly flaunts his sparkling wedding ring
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce arrived at Arrowhead without Taylor Swift, but all eyes were on the one accessory he couldn’t hide: his dazzling wedding ring.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce arrived at Arrowhead without Taylor Swift, but all eyes were on the one accessory he couldn’t hide: his dazzling wedding ring.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce arrived at Arrowhead Stadium with one detail that immediately caught attention: his wedding ring. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end showed off his new piece of jewelry while walking through the stadium halls before playing his first regular-season game, which also marks his first appearance since marrying Taylor Swift .

Travis Kelce’s arrival before Chiefs-Broncos matchup

In a video shared by the Chiefs, Kelce, 36, can be seen walking through the tunnels on his way to the locker room to get ready for the home opener against the Denver Broncos on Monday, Sept. 14 .

For the occasion, the three-time Super Bowl champion kept his look simple: a seafoam green shirt, brown pants, sunglasses and a stylish gold watch. However, the centerpiece of his outfit was his sparkling gold wedding ring, which quickly grabbed attention.

The matchup against Denver marks the start of Kelce’s 14th NFL season , a campaign that could be the final chapter of a legendary career. It also represents his first game as Taylor Swift’s husband after the couple celebrated a lavish wedding on July 3 at New York City’s Madison Square Garden .

Kelce had already shown off his ring following the ceremony, but he displayed it again during a Sept. 2 episode of his New Heights podcast , where he talked with his brother and co-host, Jason Kelce.

“You’re finally married!” Jason, 38, said as Travis smiled, lifted the hand wearing his new bling and replied, “I am a married man.”

Although Kelce had been spotted wearing the ring during Chiefs training camp, it was not until that podcast episode that fans got a close look at the accessory’s design. The piece features an engraved crisscross pattern that wraps around the entire band.

articles.title: Taylor Swift’s high-fashion look revealed as she watches Travis Kelce with Tom Cruise
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift returned to Arrowhead for the Chiefs’ season opener, but she wasn’t alone.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift returned to Arrowhead for the Chiefs’ season opener, but she wasn’t alone.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift returned to Arrowhead Stadium , but this time the occasion carried a special meaning: it marked her first appearance at a Kansas City Chiefs game as Travis Kelce’s wife .

The singer was on hand to support her husband during the season opener against the Denver Broncos , where she also shared a suite with actor Tom Cruise . His presence immediately caught fans’ attention and sparked a wave of reactions across social media.

Taylor Swift steals the spotlight at Arrowhead with Tom Cruise by her side

For the occasion, Swift embraced a look inspired by Kansas City’s colors. According to Page Six , the pop superstar wore a red-and-cream gingham polo dress from Guest in Residence , the brand founded by her friend Gigi Hadid . She completed the outfit with a delicate bracelet while enjoying a drink and chatting with Cruise from the suite.

Since making her relationship with Kelce public in 2023 , Swift has become a regular presence at Chiefs games, often mixing vintage team gear with designer pieces and outfits that pay tribute to Kansas City’s red, white and black color scheme.

Among her most memorable appearances are the custom puffer jacket inspired by Kelce’s jersey, designed by Kristin Juszczyk ; the diamond “87” necklace and Judith Leiber football clutch she wore during Super Bowl LVIII ; and her stylish Chanel ensemble during the 2025 playoffs.

Swift’s latest appearance comes after a historic summer alongside Kelce. The couple tied the knot on July 3 at Madison Square Garden in New York City in a private ceremony surrounded by family and close friends.

Although they have yet to release official photos from their wedding, both have already shown off their new rings. Swift has displayed a curved diamond band, while Kelce has been spotted wearing a thicker yellow gold ring featuring engraved details.

The singer also recently appeared at the Grammy Museum , where she wore a Dôen outfit, while Kelce starred in his first campaign with Tommy Hilfiger , alongside the couple’s adorable Samoyed dog, Wendy.

Although they have yet to share official wedding photos, both have already shown off their new rings. Swift has displayed a curved diamond wedding band, while Kelce has been spotted wearing a yellow gold ring featuring engraved details.
Travis Kelce’s arrival before Chiefs-Broncos matchup
In a video shared by the Chiefs, Kelce, 36, can be seen walking through the tunnels on his way to the locker room to get ready for the home opener against the Denver Broncos on Monday, Sept. 14.

For the occasion, the three-time Super Bowl champion kept his look simple: a seafoam green shirt, brown pants, sunglasses and a stylish gold watch. However, the centerpiece of his outfit was his sparkling gold wedding ring, which quickly grabbed attention.

The matchup against Denver marks the start of Kelce’s 14th NFL season , a campaign that could be the final chapter of a legendary career. It also represents his first game as Taylor Swift’s husband after the couple celebrated a lavish wedding on July 3 at New York City’s Madison Square Garden.

articles.title: Taylor Swift erupts at ESPN cameras after Travis Kelce’s big play: “Don’t show me!”
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift’s reaction stole the spotlight at Arrowhead, but it wasn’t because of her celebration.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift’s reaction stole the spotlight at Arrowhead, but it wasn’t because of her celebration.
articles.body:
It was a true celebration at Arrowhead Stadium to kick off the season for the Kansas City Chiefs , as the team sent a strong message to the rest of the NFL after Patrick Mahomes returned to the field and with what could be Travis Kelce ’s final season.

As usual, whenever the Chiefs take the field, much of the attention was focused on the possible presence of Taylor Swift during the AFC West showdown, even though some fans have criticized how much attention she receives, especially during television broadcasts.

However, it appears Swift may not be too interested in being the center of attention — at least that’s what some fans believe based on her reaction during an explosive play by her now-husband, the legendary tight end Travis Kelce .

Does Taylor Swift not want to appear on TV?

The X account MLFootball suggested that several fans who watched Swift’s lips believed she was asking the cameras not to focus on her, allegedly saying: “Don’t show me, get off of me.”

The moment happened after Travis Kelce delivered one of the biggest plays of the night, escaping after Patrick Mahomes came under pressure in the third quarter.

While it is impossible to know exactly what Swift was saying, her reaction to the play was undeniable. T he pop superstar celebrated with the same excitement she has become known for, showing her support for her husband after his huge gain.

The moment came just months after Swift and Kelce tied the knot in a spectacular wedding ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York .

It was a perfect night for the Chiefs, who dominated their AFC West rival — the same team that recently ended Kansas City’s reign as division champions.

The performance helped the Chiefs snap a three-game losing streak against Denver, the team that ended Kansas City’s nine-year reign as AFC West champions .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes is back: Kansas City Chiefs destroy the Denver Broncos with their new weapon
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes’ comeback was a success, but the Chiefs’ new weapon proved he could be the missing piece in Kansas City’s offense.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes’ comeback was a success, but the Chiefs’ new weapon proved he could be the missing piece in Kansas City’s offense.
articles.body:
Kenneth Walker III stole the spotlight in Patrick Mahomes ’ long-awaited return. The new Kansas City Chiefs running back rushed for 173 yards and two touchdowns in his debut with the team, helping Kansas City get revenge against the Denver Broncos with a dominant 31-10 victory on Monday night.

While Mahomes’ surgically repaired left knee was the biggest storyline entering the season opener, Walker quickly became the offensive star of the night. The former Seahawks standout delivered the type of explosive performance Kansas City hoped for when it signed him in free agency.

Mahomes looked completely healthy despite the knee injury and the brace he wore, throwing for 184 yards and two touchdowns while adding another score on the ground. His performance helped the Chiefs snap a three-game losing streak against Denver, the team that ended Kansas City’s nine-year run as AFC West champions.

Walker carried the ball 23 times, recording the most rushing yards by a Chiefs player since Jamaal Charles ran for 226 yards against the Colts in 2012 , one year before Andy Reid became Kansas City’s head coach. He also contributed in the passing game with three receptions for 18 yards.

Walker takes over as Chiefs offense overwhelms Denver

The Chiefs’ new weapon made an immediate impact, rushing for 89 yards on 14 carries in the first half while also making plays as a receiver out of the backfield.

Denver briefly answered after Bo Nix connected with Evan Engram for a 19-yard touchdown, tying the game. But Kansas City responded with an 80-yard drive that ended with Mahomes finding Rashee Rice , who powered through multiple Broncos defenders for a touchdown to give the Chiefs a 14-7 halftime lead.

Walker delivered the biggest play of the night early in the third quarter. Facing a fourth-and-1, he broke through the defense and turned the short-yardage play into a 60-yard touchdown run, sending Arrowhead into a frenzy.

The Chiefs and Broncos traded field goals later in the quarter, but Kansas City pulled away after Bo Nix lost a fumble, setting up another scoring opportunity.

Mahomes connected with rookie running back Emmett Johnson for a 26-yard gain to set up first-and-goal at the Denver 2-yard line. On a creative trick play, Mahomes lined up alongside backup quarterback Justin Fields, took the snap and flipped the ball to Walker, who scored untouched to put the game out of reach.

Broncos offense struggles in season opener

Denver’s offense struggled throughout the night in the first game with offensive coordinator Davis Webb calling plays.

Nix finished with just 131 passing yards , one interception and a lost fumble as the Broncos totaled only 176 yards of offense despite adding star receiver Jaylen Waddle during the offseason.

Waddle had just one catch for two yards, while Engram led Denver with four receptions for 43 yards and the team’s only touchdown.

Taylor Swift chooses Arrowhead over Emmys

Taylor Swift chose Arrowhead Stadium over the Emmy Awards to support husband Travis Kelce in the Chiefs’ season opener.

The pop superstar, who married Kelce on July 3 , watched the game from a suite alongside actor Tom Cruise . Swift had been nominated for outstanding variety special (pre-recorded) for “The Eras Tour: The Final Show,” but the award went earlier this month to “The Muppet Show.”

articles.title: The NFL gets its biggest star back nine months later: Patrick Mahomes' sweet return
articles.standfirst: Nine months and 274 days after the knee operation, Mahomes returned as the headline against the Denver Broncos
articles.summary: Nine months and 274 days after the knee operation, Mahomes returned as the headline against the Denver Broncos
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes returned after nine months out due to his ACL injury . and he did it in the sweetest way and with a new stellar partner, a Kenneth Walker, MVP of the last Super Bowl with Seattle , who tore apart the Denver Broncos and delivered the Kansas City Chiefs a 31-10 victory .

Walker rushed for 173 yards on 23 carries and scored a spectacular "touchdown" after a 60-yard run in his first official game with the Chiefs, following his extraordinary season that ended with the title with the Seattle Seahawks.

'It made life easier for Patrick Mahomes, who began his game with a fifteen-yard run to score the opening "TD." He threw for 184 yards (15 of 27 passing), with two touchdown passes and one interception.'

At the Broncos, quarterback Bo Nix was held to 131 yards, with one touchdown pass and one interception.

If Walker added 173 rushing yards, the Broncos did not exceed 61 in total.

Travis Kelce became the second player with the most receiving yards in the NFL

With his wife, pop star Taylor Swift, in the box, Travis Kelce became the second player with the most receiving yards in the NFL, surpassing Jason Witten's 13,046. Only Tony Gonzalez is ahead of him, with 15,127.

For the Chiefs' coach, Andy Reid, it was the eighteenth opening-game victory of his career for his teams, tying Bill Belichick's record.

Mahomes, the light at the end of the tunnel

Mahomes suffered a tear of the anterior cruciate ligament and lateral ligament in his left knee on December 14, 2025 , in the final moments of the loss to the Los Angeles Chargers. That injury ended his season and left Kansas City with a 6-8 record, out of the playoff race.

Nine months and 274 days after the operation, Mahomes returned as the starting quarterback this Monday against the Denver Broncos. The quarterback wore a protective knee brace on his left knee.

Denver also arrived affected by Bo Nix's physical issue, as he suffered an ankle fracture in the divisional round of last season's "playoffs" against Buffalo.

The injury occurred during an overtime run, required surgery, and prevented him from playing the rest of the postseason with the Broncos.

The first week of the NFL delivered an offensive showcase by the Chicago Bears, who defeated the Carolina Panthers 59-37 with 124 rushing yards and three rushing touchdowns from D"Andre Swift. Caleb Williams contributed two rushing touchdowns and two more through the air, in the third-highest scoring game in franchise history.

Josh Allen also stood out, decisive in the Buffalo Bills' 36-31 win over the Houston Texans with a 34-yard pass to Joshua Palmer in the final minute. Philadelphia edged Washington 24-22, Minnesota rolled past Green Bay 39-22, and Seattle opened with a 13-10 win over New England.

articles.title: Chiefs Kingdom holding its breath after dangerous hit on Patrick Mahomes triggers referee controversy
articles.standfirst: Denver linebacker Nik Bonitto could still face discipline after controversial hit on Mahomes
articles.summary: Denver linebacker Nik Bonitto could still face discipline after controversial hit on Mahomes
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes spent months fighting his way back from a torn ACL and LCL just to be ready for Week 1. His return ended with a comfortable Kansas City Chiefs victory, but one second-half hit now has the NFL facing a disciplinary decision.

Mahomes was attempting a short pass toward Travis Kelce when Denver Broncos linebacker Nik Bonitto arrived as the quarterback was going to the ground.

The pass fell incomplete, but replays appeared to show Bonitto making contact with Mahomes around the helmet area. Mahomes immediately looked toward the officials and gestured for a flag. None was thrown.

That spared Denver a 15-yard penalty in the moment, but the play is not necessarily finished from the league’s perspective. The NFL reviews game footage after every week and can issue fines even when officials don't penalize a player during the game.

Bonitto could still face punishment

NFL rules define roughing the passer as unwarranted physical contact against a player who is in a passing posture, including immediately after the ball is released.

The league will now determine whether Bonitto ’s hit crossed that line. If the NFL decides it did, a first roughing-the-passer offense carries a listed fine of $17,911. A second offense can result in a $23,882 fine.

That doesn't mean punishment is automatic. Bonitto wasn't flagged on the field, and the league’s review will determine whether there is enough evidence to impose discipline afterward. Those decisions are typically announced later in the week.

Mahomes looked comfortable

The controversy came during Mahomes ’ first regular-season game since suffering the serious left-knee injury that ended his previous campaign. He underwent surgery shortly afterward and spent the offseason rehabilitating with Week 1 as his target.

Mahomes wore a knee brace against Denver, but there was little indication that it was limiting him. He completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards, two touchdowns and one interception as Kansas City pulled away for a 31-10 victory over its AFC West rival.

The performance wasn't statistically dominant, but simply having Mahomes back on the field was significant for a Chiefs team that had spent the offseason waiting to see whether its franchise quarterback could return on schedule. He did.

The hit from Bonitto added one uncomfortable moment to an otherwise encouraging comeback. Kansas City now turns its attention to a Week 2 home game against the Indianapolis Colts .

Bonitto , meanwhile, will be waiting on a different kind of result. The officials decided there was nothing worth penalizing in real time. The NFL now gets another chance to make that judgment.

articles.title: Mahomes' triumphant return made even sweeter after Brittany and the kids' emotional tribute brought everyone to tears
articles.standfirst: Mahomes’ family tribute arrived hours before his first game back from ACL and LCL tears
articles.summary: Mahomes’ family tribute arrived hours before his first game back from ACL and LCL tears
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes had spent months talking about getting back for Week 1, but the most personal part of his comeback arrived before kickoff.

On the morning of Kansas City ’s season opener against the Denver Broncos , Brittany Mahomes shared a family video featuring messages from the couple’s children as their father prepared to play his first game since suffering a serious left knee injury in December.

“Daddy, I love you. I’m so happy you get to play football,” one of the children says in the video. “We’re so happy you get to play football again. And we get to watch you.”

Mahomes reposted the clip to his Instagram Stories with three red-heart emojis. There was no lengthy caption and no attempt to dress up the moment. After everything it took for him to get back on the field, the response was enough.

Fatherhood made early rehab especially difficult

Mahomes tore both the ACL and LCL in his left knee late last season and immediately began working toward a Week 1 return.

That process meant long days of rehabilitation, but Mahomes has said the hardest part initially had little to do with football.

“Honestly, the toughest part was at the beginning, not being able to get up and chase my kids around,” Mahomes said during training camp.

“I know it sounds crazy, but being a dad and being active, I always want to be around my kids and playing and stuff like that. That was tough.”

Being able to resume those everyday moments with Sterling, Bronze and Golden became another milestone in his recovery.

“But once I was able to do that, it kinda (sic) motivated me to keep getting better and better,” Mahomes said.

He also credited the people around him for helping make the return possible.

“It was a long offseason, a lot of work and a lot of great people around me, trainers, Brittany, and my family, supporting me,” Mahomes told reporters last week.

Mahomes had made his intentions clear months earlier.

“I don’t want to miss that game because that’s the team that won the division while we were gone and you want to be out there and ready to go with your teammates,” he said in July.

Brittany was at Arrowhead Stadium for the comeback and met Mahomes on the sideline before kickoff, where the couple shared a kiss before he returned to game action.

The night became even more emotional when Mahomes scored Kansas City’s first touchdown of the season.

Brittany posted the celebration from inside the stadium with a message that matched the moment: “HESSSSSS BACKKKKKKKK.”

Nine months earlier, Mahomes was facing surgery and an uncertain road back. By Monday night, his family was watching him play again.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' euphoric reaction to Patrick's first touchdown since his terrible injury
articles.standfirst: Brittany had been counting down to the moment after watching her husband spend months rehabbing his knee
articles.summary: Brittany had been counting down to the moment after watching her husband spend months rehabbing his knee
articles.body:
After spending months beside her husband through a grueling knee rehabilitation, Brittany Mahomes was inside Arrowhead Stadium when Patrick finally returned to the end zone. Brittany didn't try to hide what the moment meant.

Nine months after Patrick Mahomes suffered the knee injury that ended his 2025 season, Brittany watched from inside Arrowhead Stadium as her husband ran for the Kansas City Chiefs ’ first touchdown of the new campaign against the Denver Broncos. Her reaction came almost immediately.

“HESSSSSS BACKKKKKKKK,” Brittany wrote on Instagram Stories alongside video showing the celebration inside the stadium. It was the culmination of an offseason she had experienced from much closer than most.

Patrick underwent surgery after tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee against the Los Angeles Chargers in December, then committed himself to an intensive rehabilitation program aimed at getting back in time for Week 1.

Brittany had seen that process unfold at home as well as around the Chiefs ’ facility, making Monday night’s touchdown more than just another scoring play.

Counting down to Patrick’s return

Her anticipation was clear hours before kickoff. “I’m so ready for this!” Brittany posted earlier Monday as the Chiefs prepared to begin their season.

She was also on the sideline before the game and shared a kiss with Patrick before he took the field. When SportsCenter later posted footage of the moment with the caption “Family first,” Brittany responded in the comments with, “My baby.”

That sequence captured the personal side of a comeback that had otherwise been framed largely around medical timelines, football conditioning and Kansas City’s hopes of restoring Mahomes to the lineup.

Brittany and Patrick have been together since high school, long before his rise into one of the NFL’s biggest stars. She has been a constant presence throughout his career and has frequently shared the family’s biggest football moments with fans. Monday night was another one.

The work Brittany saw behind the scenes

Chiefs coach Andy Reid offered some perspective during training camp on just how much work Mahomes put into being ready.

“He spent his offseason here,” Reid said. “He didn’t go anywhere. Seven hours a day, he was there working... and it pays off for him.”

Brittany had a front-row seat to much of that journey. That made her first-quarter celebration particularly fitting when Mahomes kept the ball and crossed the goal line for Kansas City’s opening touchdown of the season.

She continued sharing Chiefs posts about the score afterward, turning her Instagram Stories into a running celebration of her husband’s comeback.

The touchdown itself belonged to Patrick . The emotion surrounding it belonged just as much to Brittany , who had spent months watching the work required to make the moment possible.

Brittany and Patrick have been together since high school, long before his rise into one of the NFL’s biggest stars. She has been a constant presence throughout his career and has frequently shared the family’s biggest football moments with fans. Monday night was another one.
The work Brittany saw behind the scenes
Chiefs coach Andy Reid offered some perspective during training camp on just how much work Mahomes put into being ready.
“He spent his offseason here,” Reid said. “He didn’t go anywhere. Seven hours a day, he was there working... and it pays off for him.”

Brittany had a front-row seat to much of that journey. That made her first-quarter celebration particularly fitting when Mahomes kept the ball and crossed the goal line for Kansas City’s opening touchdown of the season.
She continued sharing Chiefs posts about the score afterward, turning her Instagram Stories into a running celebration of her husband’s comeback.
The touchdown itself belonged to Patrick . The emotion surrounding it belonged just as much to Brittany , who had spent months watching the work required to make the moment possible.

articles.title: Kenneth Walker III had a spectacular debut with the Chiefs that overshadowed Patrick Mahomes' return
articles.standfirst: The running back put on an extraordinary performance to lead the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos: 173 yards and two touchdowns in the 31-10 victory over the Broncos
articles.summary: El corredor protagonizó una actuación extraordinaria para liderar a los Kansas City Chiefs ante los Denver Broncos: 173 yardas y dos touchdowns en la victoria 31-10 sobre los Broncos
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs celebrated Patrick Mahomes' return with a resounding 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos. The quarterback once again proved he's ready to lead the team, but the star of the night was another player: Kenneth Walker III.

The running back had the debut the Kansas City Chiefs were hoping for when they drafted him. His performance was extraordinary. Walker finished with 173 yards on 23 carries and two touchdowns—one on the ground and one on a reception. He also added 18 yards on three receptions for a total of 191 yards. It was his best rushing performance in an NFL game.

Mahomes' return had another star player

Walker made his presence felt right from the first drive . On seven carries, he gained 32 yards and helped move the chains as Kansas City began to build its lead. Mahomes also made an impact from the start: after a first touchdown run was nullified by a penalty, the quarterback ran again and scored a 15-yard touchdown.

The running back had already shown in Seattle that one of his greatest strengths is breaking through tackles and gaining yards after contact. He forced 61 missed tackles in 2025 and racked up more than 600 yards after contact. He also had 33 runs for double-digit yards, 10 of which were for more than 20 yards . The Chiefs had only three runs of more than 20 yards all of the previous season.

The most important play came at the start of the third quarter. On fourth down and one yard to go, Walker found an opening on the left side and ran 60 yards into the end zone. He finished with 191 yards from the line of scrimmage—more than the 176 total yards Denver gained throughout the entire game.

After that run, Walker helped seal the game early in the fourth quarter when the Chiefs pulled off a brilliant trick play.

The Chiefs ran a trick play in which Justin Fields handed the ball off to the running back, who went on to score his second touchdown of the night. The play allowed Kansas City to extend its lead even further and essentially seal the game.

Kansas City Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III signed a three-year, $43.05 million contract with the team after winning the Super Bowl MVP award, and he has added a new dimension to the Chiefs' offense that they haven't had in several years.

Mahomes Wins Again, and the Chiefs Find a New Weapon

Mahomes' return turned out to be a success , both in terms of the result and how his knee felt.

Kansas City secured a decisive victory over one of its main rivals in the AFC West and, at the same time, found in Walker a player capable of shouldering much of the offensive load.

Mahomes didn't need to put on a spectacular performance for the Chiefs to dominate the game. Walker made the difference on the ground, the defense held Denver to 176 total yards, and Kansas City closed out the game with a clear 31-10 lead.

The season has barely begun, but Walker's debut sent a clear message: if he keeps playing at this level , the Chiefs will have a player capable of complementing Mahomes and making their offense much harder to defend against.
