articles.title: Business First: The multimillion-dollar contract signed by Brittany Mahomes just before husband Patrick's big comeback
articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes entered the Kansas City Chiefs’ season opener with attention naturally centered on her husband’s return, but she used the hours before kickoff to underline how much her own profile has grown beyond football.
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes entered the Kansas City Chiefs ’ season opener with attention naturally centered on her husband’s return, but she used the hours before kickoff to underline how much her own profile has grown beyond football.

Brittany unveiled a new campaign with haircare company Divi , continuing a partnership that began last season with a brand reportedly valued at about $100 million.

The campaign introduced Divi’s new Soft + Strong Hairspray and featured Brittany alongside the company’s founder.

“Two is better than one… Meet SOFT + STRONG Hairspray!!” the announcement read.

The promotion described one option as providing an “effortless, brushable, every day hold,” while the stronger version was aimed at a more polished finish with “maximum hold.”

“You can be soft… You can be strong… You can be BOTH,” the campaign added.

The timing was hard to miss. Only hours later, Patrick Mahomes was due to take the field against the Denver Broncos in his first regular-season game since tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee late last season.

Brittany continues building business profile

Brittany has become an increasingly visible figure in the commercial space while remaining closely associated with the Chiefs and her husband’s career. Her work with Divi is part of that expansion.

The reported $100 million figure refers to the company’s valuation, not the value of Brittany ’s personal agreement, but the partnership still represents another significant endorsement for the entrepreneur.

She has appeared in multiple campaigns for the brand and has increasingly used her social media presence to promote products and business ventures of her own.

That made Monday an unusual intersection of two different storylines within the Mahomes household. Brittany launching a new campaign while Patrick completed the final stages of a difficult comeback.

Patrick Mahomes with strong medical update

The quarterback’s recovery had been one of the Chiefs ’ biggest offseason questions.

NFL insider Ian Rapoport said Mahomes had returned much faster than expected after surgery.

“He's coming back from a torn ACL, torn LCL far, far faster than anyone would have possibly thought it,” Rapoport said.

He also offered a positive assessment of how Mahomes looked during training camp.

“I saw the Kansas City Chiefs in training camp, and I gotta say, it was eye-popping how good Mahomes looked on the field,” Rapoport added.

“His strength is symmetrical from side to side. His function is the same side to side, and his graft is fully healed.”

That cleared the path for Mahomes to return against Denver. Brittany , meanwhile, had already made her own update before the game began.

The Chiefs quarterback was returning to work after months of rehabilitation. His wife was expanding hers.

articles.title: “You've got a job”: An inside look at strange suite conversation between Tom Cruise and Taylor Swift at the Chiefs game
articles.standfirst: Animated discussion drew attention before the pair later celebrated Kelce’s milestone together
articles.summary: Animated discussion drew attention before the pair later celebrated Kelce’s milestone together
articles.body:
T aylor Swift ’s return to Arrowhead Stadium already guaranteed plenty of attention. Then ESPN cameras found her in an animated conversation with Tom Cruise , creating one of the more unexpected side stories from the Kansas City Chiefs ’ season opener.

Swift was in the suite to support husband Travis Kelce as Kansas City opened its campaign against the Denver Broncos , while Cruise was among the high-profile guests watching from above the field.

The exchange between the singer and actor immediately drew curiosity because both appeared intensely engaged in the conversation.

No microphones captured what was being said, but professional lipreader Nicola Hickling later offered the Daily Mail her interpretation of the footage.

According to Hickling, Swift appeared to say: “It's the structure of the entire infrastructure of the audience that's what I love in a positive way.”

Part of Cruise ’s reply was missed when the broadcast cut away, but Hickling said he later appeared to tell Swift: “You may not know it, but you do have a job.”

Swift then nodded, placed her drink down and appeared to answer: “Right.”

Lipreading adds more to mysterious exchange

Hickling said Cruise later appeared to add: “I told her to stick to one and that it's the last time.” Swift again seemed to acknowledge the comment.

The interpretation suggests the pair may have been discussing something professional, although lipreading television footage cannot establish with certainty what either person actually said.

Whatever the topic, the two appeared relaxed together throughout the night.

Swift was later shown celebrating when Kelce passed Jason Witten on the NFL’s all-time receiving-yardage list among tight ends.

“Yes, oh my God,” she appeared to say while hugging her mother, Andrea.

She was also seen high-fiving Cruise and later embracing him as the atmosphere inside the suite became considerably more celebratory.

Swift chose Kelce’s opener over another major night

Swift attended the game with a large group that included her parents, Andrea and Scott, while Kelce’s mother, Donna , was also present.

Her appearance was notable because it marked her first Chiefs game since she and Kelce married over the summer.

It also came on the same night as the 2026 Emmy Awards, where Swift ’s concert film Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour - The Final Show had received multiple nominations earlier in the awards cycle. Instead, she chose Arrowhead.

Kelce , meanwhile, was beginning his 14th NFL season and has made clear he is not yet ready to walk away.

“I still have the desire to go out there and compete, and I still think I can compete at a high level,” Kelce previously told ESPN’s Chris Berman.

Swift has also spoken openly about how much she has embraced football.

“I fell in love with it,” she said on New Heights. “I became obsessed with it… It's so fun, it's so exciting.”

On Monday night, even a quiet conversation in a luxury suite became part of the spectacle.

articles.title: "Long live Mexico!": Patrick Mahomes' celebration after playing again with the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback celebrated the Chiefs' victory with an emotional message to Mexican fans.
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback celebrated the Chiefs' victory with an emotional message to Mexican fans.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes played an official game again nine months after suffering an injury that affected the anterior cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments in his left knee. The quarterback responded in his return with a victory for the Kansas City Chiefs, who defeated the Denver Broncos 31-10 in the first Monday Night Football game of the 2026 season.

But the night still had one last moment in store. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback closed his interview with ESPN alongside journalist John Sutcliffe with an enthusiastic “Long live Mexico!” . The phrase, aimed at Mexican fans and spoken just days before the celebration of Mexico's Independence, quickly drew attention on social media.

A return with victory and several protagonists

Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes (15) returned after nine months out with his ACL injury and did so in the sweetest way possible, winning.

Mahomes completed 15 of his 27 passes for 184 yards, with two touchdown passes and one interception. He also added another rushing touchdown, in a performance in which he did not appear limited by his surgically repaired knee.

The great offensive protagonist, however, was Kenneth Walker III . The MVP of the last Super Bowl ran for 173 yards on 23 carries and scored a spectacular "touchdown" after a 60-yard rush in his first official game with the Chiefs, following his extraordinary season that ended with the title with the Seattle Seahawks. Walker totaled 173 yards and broke his personal record.

On the other hand, Travis Kelce also left his name in the NFL record books . The tight end surpassed Jason Witten and moved into second place among the tight ends with the most receiving yards in league history, behind only Tony Gonzalez.

All of these ingredients made it a special game and it ended with a celebration that got a reaction from all the fans.

Mahomes focuses on what's next

The quarterback wanted to downplay the importance of his individual return and emphasized the collective effort.

"They're a good football team. They reached the AFC final for a reason," Mahomes said about Denver. "Us coming out and winning like that is the first step. It shows that all the work in training camp was worth it. But how can we improve?"

Kansas City's response was emphatic. The Chiefs finished with 392 total yards, including 220 on the ground, while Denver managed just 176 yards of offense. The home defense also pressured Bo Nix and forced two turnovers.

For Mahomes, the day meant competing again after a long recovery and doing so with a victory. For the Chiefs , it was also a way to begin the season against a divisional rival that had finished 2025 with 14 wins and had reached the AFC championship.

And after all that came the moment that ended up spreading beyond the field. Mahomes, still riding the emotion of his return and the victory, used his interview to deliver his “Viva Mexico!” . A brief phrase that capped an important night for Kansas City and drew an immediate response from Mexican fans.

articles.title: “He stood us up”: Jason Kelce calls out Marcus Spears live on ESPN for missing Travis and Taylor's wedding
articles.standfirst: Kelce couldn't resist teasing Spears after the ESPN star missed his brother's lavish wedding
articles.summary: Kelce couldn't resist teasing Spears after the ESPN star missed his brother's lavish wedding
articles.body:
Jason Kelce couldn't resist giving his ESPN colleague Marcus Spears some grief after the former Dallas Cowboys star missed one of the biggest weddings of the year.

During ESPN's Monday Night Countdown coverage ahead of the Kansas City Chiefs' season opener against the Denver Broncos, Kelce revealed that Spears had been invited to his brother Travis Kelce's wedding to Taylor Swift but didn't turn up.

Jason , who served as Travis ' best man, pointed directly at Spears while discussing the guest list and joked that the analyst had effectively abandoned the group.

“There wasn't another person on the desk invited, but he did no show us,” Kelce said, adding that he still wasn't entirely sure why Spears had been absent.

Spears quickly offered an explanation, saying he had a family obligation involving his son, though things were clearly lighthearted, as Kelce laughed before turning his attention back to the extraordinary celebration.

Swift and Travis married on July 3 at New York's Madison Square Garden, bringing together a remarkable mixture of celebrities, athletes, NFL figures and longtime friends. Jason was officially Travis ' best man, while Swift's brother Austin served as her man of honor.

A wedding that brought together Hollywood and football

Kelce described the occasion as a genuine mixture of worlds, recalling how guests came from professional football, entertainment, Nashville's music scene and the couple's personal circles.

The celebration reportedly featured an enormous guest list, with major names from music, film and the NFL joining the couple for their special day. Among those linked to the festivities were Selena Gomez, Gigi Hadid, Bradley Cooper, Emma Stone, Paul Rudd, Ed Sheeran and Sabrina Carpenter.

Kelce also praised the ceremony itself, describing it as gorgeous and saying those involved had done an incredible job.

“It was insane, and the ceremony was gorgeous. They did such an incredible job,” added Jason .

After the formal proceedings, the wedding reportedly transformed into a huge party. Guests were treated to elaborate entertainment, food and drinks, creating an atmosphere that Jason remembered fondly when speaking about the event on ESPN.

The celebration was particularly significant for Jason , who had the responsibility of standing beside his younger brother as best man.

Travis and Taylo r have since moved into married life while balancing demanding professional schedules. Swift has continued her music career, while Travis returned to the NFL with the Chiefs.

Swift was also spotted supporting Travis during Kansas City's Week 1 matchup with Denver at Arrowhead Stadium. The Chiefs went on to secure a 31-10 victory, giving Travis a winning start to the season in front of his wife.

articles.title: Travis Kelce doesn't want to end up like Tom Brady: The master plan for his retirement and future family with Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: Kelce's retirement decision could hinge on one final Super Bowl run
articles.summary: Kelce's retirement decision could hinge on one final Super Bowl run
articles.body:
Travis Kelce's 14th NFL season has arrived with more questions than ever about what comes next for the Kansas City Chiefs tight end.

At 36, Kelce isn’t chasing another Super Bowl as he's entered a new chapter of his life after marrying Taylor Swift on July 3 at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

The couple's wedding marked a major milestone, but it also intensified speculation that Kelce could soon trade the football field for family life and his growing entertainment career.

Swift has already been enthusiastically supporting her husband from the stands. At Kansas City's season opener against the Denver Broncos, she was seen cheering from the Arrowhead Stadium suite while proudly displaying her wedding and engagement rings.

The Chiefs went on to win 31-10, giving Kelce and his teammates an encouraging start.

However, his future remains uncertain. Kelce hasn't officially announced that this will be his final season, and he appears determined to make the decision himself rather than allowing age or expectations surrounding his marriage to dictate the timing.

That approach could help him avoid a situation similar to Tom Brady's complicated retirement story.

Kelce wants to leave football on his own terms

Brady initially announced his retirement after the 2021 season, only to reverse course just 40 days later and return for another campaign with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. He eventually retired again following the 2022 season, bringing an extraordinary 23-year career to a close.

Kelce appears keen to avoid such uncertainty. After a difficult 2025 campaign in which Kansas City missed the playoffs, the veteran tight end has another opportunity to decide how his story ends.

His performance, physical condition, the Chiefs' success and the team's ability to compete for another championship could all influence whether he returns in 2027.

There's also a personal motivation behind his approach. Kelce reportedly wasn't satisfied with how last season ended, particularly after Kansas City struggled and Patrick Mahomes suffered a serious injury.

Instead of walking away on a low note, he wants to see what he can accomplish with Mahomes back and the team healthy.

His life away from football is already offering plenty of alternatives. Kelce has expanded into television and movies, appearing in projects including Grotesquerie and Happy Gilmore 2, while also exploring opportunities that could eventually lead to a career in broadcasting.

Then there's his future with Swift . Reports have suggested the pop superstar is ready to start a family, although she doesn't want Kelce to feel pressured into retirement.

The couple have already spent years navigating demanding schedules, with Swift touring internationally while Kelce traveled for NFL games.

That could mean retirement isn't necessarily a prerequisite for their next step together.

The perfect ending for Kelce may be to give football everything he has left, chase another championship and then walk away because he's genuinely ready. After three Super Bowl victories, a fourth, or even a fifth, could provide the fairytale finale.

Rather than repeating Brady's back-and-forth retirement saga, Kelce seems to be positioning himself for a cleaner transition.

Brady initially announced his retirement after the 2021 season, only to reverse course just 40 days later and return for another campaign with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. He eventually retired again following the 2022 season, bringing an extraordinary 23-year career to a close.
Kelce appears keen to avoid such uncertainty. After a difficult 2025 campaign in which Kansas City missed the playoffs, the veteran tight end has another opportunity to decide how his story ends.
His performance, physical condition, the Chiefs' success and the team's ability to compete for another championship could all influence whether he returns in 2027.

There's also a personal motivation behind his approach. Kelce reportedly wasn't satisfied with how last season ended, particularly after Kansas City struggled and Patrick Mahomes suffered a serious injury.
Instead of walking away on a low note, he wants to see what he can accomplish with Mahomes back and the team healthy.

His life away from football is already offering plenty of alternatives. Kelce has expanded into television and movies, appearing in projects including Grotesquerie and Happy Gilmore 2, while also exploring opportunities that could eventually lead to a career in broadcasting.
Then there's his future with Swift . Reports have suggested the pop superstar is ready to start a family, although she doesn't want Kelce to feel pressured into retirement.
The couple have already spent years navigating demanding schedules, with Swift touring internationally while Kelce traveled for NFL games.
That could mean retirement isn't necessarily a prerequisite for their next step together.

The perfect ending for Kelce may be to give football everything he has left, chase another championship and then walk away because he's genuinely ready. After three Super Bowl victories, a fourth, or even a fifth, could provide the fairytale finale.
Rather than repeating Brady's back-and-forth retirement saga, Kelce seems to be positioning himself for a cleaner transition.

articles.title: Taylor Swift appears annoyed with NFL broadcasters for making her the center of attention
articles.standfirst: Swift reportedly wants the focus to stay on Travis Kelce and the Chiefs, but the cameras keep finding her
articles.summary: Swift reportedly wants the focus to stay on Travis Kelce and the Chiefs, but the cameras keep finding her
articles.body:
When Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce got married, reports from sources close to the couple revealed that the singer had a genuine concern about becoming Kelce’s wife . Swift was reportedly anxious about attending Chiefs games because of how much attention she attracts simply by being there.

For Swift, t he priority was reportedly to go unnoticed as much as possible so the attention could remain on what actually mattered at the time: the game, the NFL and, above all, her husband. This came as waves of fans had already expressed frustration over football becoming more focused on celebrity than the sport itself.

A moment from the Chiefs’ first game may have added weight to those reports

The rumors had been circulating online, but an image from the Chiefs’ first game appeared to support the idea that Swift does not want to be the center of attention when Travis and the Chiefs should be the focus. When the live broadcast switched to Taylor in the family suite, lip-readers claimed she appeared to ask for the cameras to stop showing her and to take her off the screen.

Even if Swift is the one asking not to be shown, it is clear that her presence naturally draws attention. As someone outside the NFL, she remains an easy choice for broadcasters looking to attract viewers who may not necessarily be watching the game strictly for the sport , but also want a glimpse of the singer.

The NFL’s expansion plans could make Swift’s wish for privacy difficult to achieve

The NFL wants to continue expanding and reaching new markets, and if Swift can indirectly help with that goal, it is safe to assume that wherever she goes to watch a game, she will likely appear on the screen, no matter how discreet she wants to be.

But beyond the business side, Swift has also delivered viral moments that make her difficult to ignore . Her reactions to some of the biggest plays have become part of the viewing experience , making it almost impossible for cameras and fans not to turn their attention toward her.

For many fans, Taylor has simply become part of the game . Even if she would rather let Travis Kelce and the Chiefs have the spotlight, her presence continues to create a separate storyline every time she walks into the stadium.

articles.title: The NFL kickoff frenzy: Brittany Mahomes and other WAGs heat up the new season with their iconic SI bikini shoots
articles.standfirst: The NFL’s biggest WAGs bring the heat with their Sports Illustrated Swimsuit return
articles.summary: The NFL’s biggest WAGs bring the heat with their Sports Illustrated Swimsuit return
articles.body:
The NFL season is finally back, and Brittany Mahomes and a group of high-profile football WAGs are already stealing plenty of attention away from the gridiron.

As players returned to action for the opening week, Sports Illustrated Swimsuit revisited one of 2026’s most talked-about features, putting the spotlight back on six women who shared its February digital cover.

Brittany Mahomes, Claire Kittle, Ronika Love, Haley Cavinder, Christen Goff and Normani were photographed together for the special issue on Captiva Island, Florida.

The shoot brought together women from sports, entertainment, business and digital media, all of whom happen to have connections to NFL stars. SI presented the group by highlighting their individual careers, businesses and influence.

When SI Swimsuit recently shared throwback bikini images from the February digital edition on Instagram, the post quickly attracted attention from the featured women themselves.

Brittany responded with three emojis - a heart-eyes face, fire and heart hands - while Claire Kittle enthusiastically commented, “Nothing better!”

Ronika Love also joined the conversation with a playful “I peaked here,” while Haley Cavinder called it “the best time of the year.” The reactions added to a fun shoot that had already generated significant buzz when the six digital covers were unveiled in February.

Brittany Mahomes steals the spotlight again

Mahomes had another reason to celebrate as her husband, Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, made his much-anticipated return to NFL action.

The quarterback missed the latter part of the previous campaign after suffering a season-ending knee injury, making his appearance in the Chiefs’ season opener an especially significant moment.

Brittany marked the occasion with a standout denim game-day outfit and shared an emotional message on Instagram celebrating her husband’s return. Fans quickly flooded the comments with praise for her look and excitement about seeing Patrick back on the field.

The comeback proved successful for the Chiefs, who defeated the Denver Broncos 31-10. Mahomes completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards and two touchdowns, while also rushing for 23 yards and another score. His 15-yard rushing touchdown was particularly meaningful, giving him confidence that his recovery work had paid off.

Meanwhile, Claire Kittle has been enjoying her own football-related celebrations. Her SI Swimsuit debut has placed her alongside Mahomes and four other prominent women, while she continues working as a content creator and brand founder. She also celebrated husband George Kittle’s return to the field during San Francisco’s opening-week victory.

With football officially back, the attention surrounding these women shows how much the modern WAG conversation has changed.

articles.title: ‘Refs helping Mahomes’: NFL fans outraged over perceived bias toward Chiefs
articles.standfirst: A disputed Travis Kelce holding call has reignited accusations that officials favor Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs
articles.summary: A disputed Travis Kelce holding call has reignited accusations that officials favor Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs
articles.body:
NFL fans have wasted no time questioning the officiating surrounding the Kansas City Chiefs after Patrick Mahomes and his teammates opened the 2026 season with a convincing 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos.

Although Kansas City dominated for much of Monday night's contest, one play during the opening touchdown drive quickly became the center of an online debate.

Mahomes made a successful return from his knee injury, helping guide the Chiefs to a comfortable win in their first game of the campaign. New running back Kenneth Walker III was arguably the biggest star of the night, delivering an explosive debut after joining Kansas City.

Walker finished with 173 rushing yards and two touchdowns, while Mahomes contributed through both the air and on the ground.

The Chiefs' defense also played a major role in the victory, forcing turnovers and limiting Denver's offense throughout the evening. However, the discussion away from the final score focused heavily on a perceived missed holding penalty involving Travis Kelce.

The incident occurred during Mahomes ' rushing touchdown. As the quarterback made his way into the end zone, Kelce appeared to grab and restrict a Broncos defender. Several viewers believed the contact was significant enough to warrant a holding penalty, but no flag was thrown.

That immediately fueled accusations on social media that Kansas City continues to benefit from favorable officiating.

Former NFL tight end Shannon Sharpe criticized the decision, while television personality Skip Bayless also referenced Kelce's recent wedding when commenting on the missed call. Fans piled on, with some suggesting that officials were once again helping Mahomes and the Chiefs.

One frustrated supporter described the alleged holding as obvious, while another claimed Kansas City gets away with an unusually high number of such penalties.

“The amount of holding they let Chiefs get away with is mind boggling,” wrote one viewer.

Others took a more measured view, arguing that missed calls happen throughout the NFL and aren't evidence of favoritism.

Why Chiefs officiating complaints keep returning

The latest controversy has revived a familiar argument surrounding Kansas City. The Chiefs have repeatedly faced accusations from opposing fans who believe Mahomes receives favorable treatment from officials, particularly during important games.

Similar complaints emerged during Kansas City's playoff meeting with the Houston Texans in January 2025. Some viewers felt penalties involving Mahomes were called too aggressively, leading to renewed speculation that the quarterback and the Chiefs were receiving preferential treatment.

ESPN's Stephen A. Smith even discussed whether Mahomes ' popularity, combined with Kelce's relationship with Taylor Swift , could contribute to the perception that Kansas City receives favorable calls.

It should be noticed there’s no evidence that NFL officials have intentionally manipulated games to help the Chiefs, nor has any investigation established that Kansas City has received special treatment.

Missed penalties are an unavoidable part of football, and the Chiefs aren't the only team to benefit from an official failing to see an infraction.

Kansas City's opening-night performance gives critics plenty to debate, but it also gives the defending AFC contenders legitimate reasons to be optimistic.

Mahomes looked healthy, Walker provided a major offensive boost and the defense controlled Denver. The Chiefs will now turn their attention to the Indianapolis Colts, whom they'll face at home on September 20.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes is rewriting the NFL record book putting his first 10 seasons alongside Tom Brady and Peyton Manning
articles.standfirst: This is Mahomes's 10th season, but his ninth as a starter. He has played in five Super Bowls
articles.summary: This is Mahomes's 10th season, but his ninth as a starter. He has played in five Super Bowls
articles.body:
Following a decisive 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos , it is safe to declare that the Kansas City Chiefs are officially back, leaving their dismal 6-11 record from last year—the franchise's worst finish since 2012 , firmly in the rearview mirror.

Heading into the 2026 NFL season opener, all eyes were fixated on the highly anticipated return of Patrick Mahomes , who was stepping back onto the gridiron after suffering a devastating season-ending injury a year ago.

While the superstar quarterback looked solid, throwing for 184 passing yards alongside two touchdown passes and a rushing score (despite tossing a costly red-zone interception), his comeback was surprisingly overshadowed by the spectacular debut of off-season acquisition Kenneth Walker III .

The reigning Super Bowl MVP exploded for a career-best 173 rushing yards and 191 total yards from scrimmage , finding the end zone twice and setting the mark for the most rushing yards in a single game for Kansas City since Mahomes took over the offense in 2018 .

Patrick Mahomes Historic First Decade in the NFL

If there is one absolute truth established during Mahomes' tenure under center, it is that a healthy number 15 instantly makes the Chiefs perennial Super Bowl contenders and the undisputed team to beat in the AFC .

The evidence is staggering: across his first eight seasons as the primary starter, he remarkably led Kansas City to seven AFC Championship games and five Super Bowl appearances .

Now entering his 10th NFL season , though only his ninth as the full-time guy, having started just one meaningless Week 17 game during his rookie campaign, the historic trajectory of his career becomes even more evident when stacking his regular-season win totals against the all-time greats.

To truly appreciate his unprecedented pace, simply compare his win column to the most successful quarterbacks in league history through their first ten years. Hall of Famer Peyton Manning currently holds the record with 105 wins , achieving a 105-55 record over 160 games during his early days in Indianapolis.

Just behind him sits Russell Wilson with 104 victories in 158 games ( 104-53-1 ), followed by the legendary Tom Brady , who secured 97 wins across 129 games ( 97-32 ) after also spending his rookie year holding a clipboard on the sidelines.

Following Monday night's triumph against Denver, Mahomes now boasts an astonishing 96 wins in just 127 games (96-31) . This means that if he secures victories in his next two matchups, he will officially surpass Brady's win total playing the exact same number of games.

Furthermore, if he hits the 10-win mark this year, he will shatter Manning's decade-long benchmark in nearly 20 fewer games . There is a legitimate, statistically backed reason why Mahomes is firmly on track to be crowned the greatest quarterback of all time.

Playoff Dominance and the Path to the Week 5 Bye

When the lights shine brightest in January and February, the separation between Mahomes and the rest of the league becomes even more apparent. In postseason play, only Tom Brady stands above him, holding the ultimate NFL record of 35 playoff wins , while Mahomes already sits securely in second place with 1 7 playoff victories before even completing his first ten years in the league.

As he continues to rewrite the NFL record books, the immediate focus shifts to capitalizing on this early momentum. Looking ahead, Kansas City will head back to Arrowhead Stadium for a blockbuster Sunday Night Football clash against the Indianapolis Colts , which will be followed by a pair of tricky road trips against Miami and Las Vegas.

Given their dominant, well-rounded performance in the opening week, the Chiefs have a highly realistic shot at hitting their Week 5 bye with a flawless undefeated record.

Achieving that feat would push Mahomes even closer to toppling Manning's milestone as the winningest quarterback through his first ten seasons, a monumental task that is, of course, much easier said than done.

articles.title: Taylor Swift turns Jason Kelce into her punching bag during Travis Kelce’s historic night
articles.summary: The family bond Taylor Swift has built with the Kelces continues to grow, and she made it clear during Travis Kelce’s first game of the season. Swift was there with her family, including her mother, as the entire group watched Travis continue to climb the NFL record books against the Broncos.
articles.body:
T he family bond Taylor Swift has built with the Kelces continues to grow , and she made it clear during Travis Kelce’s first game of the season. Swift was there with her family, including her mother, as the entire group watched Travis continue to climb the NFL record books against the Broncos.

Taylor and Jason Kelce sat next to each other throughout the game , and their interaction showed just how comfortable Swift has become with Travis’ family. At this point, Swift has also become familiar with the way the game works . She has previously revealed that she has studied football to understand what is happening on the field , meaning her emotions during Travis’ games are not only about supporting her husband but also about following the action .

Travis made NFL history right in front of his wife

In front of his family, Travis moved past one of the greatest tight ends in league history and into second place on the NFL’s all-time receiving-yards list for the position . His 59-yard catch helped him reach the milestone, and Taylor could not contain her excitement after the play.

Swift immediately turned to Jason and grabbed him, using her brother-in-law as her punching bag in the middle of the celebration . The moment was captured on video and quickly became one of the most viral moments of the night.

Taylor’s reactions showed how invested she has become in Travis’ career

Travis entered the 2026 season already holding numerous NFL records and had accumulated 13,002 receiving yards through the end of the 2025 season . Now, he added another milestone to his career with his wife watching from the stands .

Taylor enjoyed every moment of the game alongside Jason, even if he had to take the full force of her emotions whenever Travis made a big play . Their moment also showed how natural Swift’s relationship with the Kelce family has become as she continues to embrace the world surrounding her husband’s career.

articles.title: Andy Reid delivers brutal truth on Travis Kelce after Chiefs’ Denver rout
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce silenced the doubters in the Chiefs’ opener, and Andy Reid had a strong message for everyone already talking about his retirement.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce silenced the doubters in the Chiefs’ opener, and Andy Reid had a strong message for everyone already talking about his retirement.
articles.body:
The end of Travis Kelce ’s career is not part of Andy Reid ’s plans just yet. The head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs made it clear that he is not ready to put a timeline on the retirement of one of the greatest players in franchise history.

What a start for Travis Kelce on Monday Night Football

Kelce started the 2026 season in the best way possible, proving he still has plenty left to offer. The tight end recorded three receptions for 71 yards in the Chiefs’ 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos on Monday Night Football , including an explosive 59-yard catch, his longest reception in five years. Best of all, he did it in front of his wife, Taylor Swift.

The performance came amid continued questions about how much longer Kelce will continue playing, as the veteran turns 37 years old in October . Although he has not announced any retirement plans, Reid highlighted the impact Kelce can still make on the field.

“Kelce, he dusted it off, right? Three for 71 yards. Pretty good for an old man that people look crosseyed at,” Reid told reporters after the game.

The 59-yard reception was only one example of Kelce’s importance in Kansas City’s win. He also made a six-yard catch on a key third down that kept a drive alive against the reigning AFC West champions.

Travis Kelce is still not thinking about retirement

articles.title: Chiefs billionaire family breaks the owner-player barrier in unexpected postgame scene
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs kicked off the season with a solid 21-point victory over the Broncos, led by their new addition, Walker III
articles.summary: The Chiefs kicked off the season with a solid 21-point victory over the Broncos, led by their new addition, Walker III
articles.body:
For the Chiefs, this campaign is entirely about mounting a strong rebound after enduring their worst season since 2012 , marking the first time in Patrick Mahomes ' career that the franchise missed the playoffs following eight consecutive seasons as starters highlighted by three Super Bowl titles .

The entire organization acknowledges they are under the microscope following a rare down year relative to their historic standard of success, which is why a statement victory over a high-caliber divisional rival like Denver carries immense weight, resonating deeply even with team ownership.

A viral postgame video captured owner Tavia Hunt , wife of Clark Hunt , waiting patiently outside the locker room to embrace multiple players who were still drenched in sweat.

This moment highlighted the profound mutual respect running through the franchise and illustrated how closely connected the Chiefs' leadership group feels toward the roster. Such a tight-knit culture serves as a foundational reason behind why they have reigned as the league's premier powerhouse since Mahomes took the reins in 2018 .

The Reigning Super Bowl MVP had Historic Debut with the Chiefs

What a debut for the reigning Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III with his new team the Kansas City Chiefs , tallying two touchdowns, a career-high 173 rushing yards, and 191 total yards , outgaining the entire Denver Broncos offense while recording the most rushing yards in a single game since Patrick Mahomes became the full-time starter in 2018.

The Chiefs cruised past the Broncos 31-10 in a game that also marked Mahomes' official return to the gridiron following a nine-month recovery from injury , though Walker's dazzling performance slightly overshadowed the star quarterback, who finished with 184 passing yards , two touchdown passes, and one rushing score alongside an ugly red-zone interception that Denver failed to capitalize on.

Looking ahead, the Chiefs return home for a high-stakes Sunday Night Football clash against the Indianapolis Colts, followed by consecutive road trips to face Miami and Las Vegas.

Judging by their dominant opening-week display, Kansas City possesses a legitimate path to charging into their Week 5 bye week with an unblemished, undefeated record, which would undoubtedly provide a massive psychological boost for the journey ahead.

articles.title: Are the Chiefs back? Kansas City’s defense stuns experts with a terrifyingly dominant performance against the Broncos
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs sent a message in Week 1, and it wasn’t just because of Kenneth Walker III. Kansas City’s defense looked like a championship-caliber unit and left NFL experts stunned.
articles.summary: The Chiefs sent a message in Week 1, and it wasn’t just because of Kenneth Walker III. Kansas City’s defense looked like a championship-caliber unit and left NFL experts stunned.
articles.body:
Although the Kansas City Chiefs ’ Week 1 victory over the Denver Broncos will be remembered as Kenneth Walker III’s night, after the running back exploded for 173 rushing yards and a touchdown on 23 carries, Andy Reid ’s team made an early statement about its ambitions for the season.

Beyond Walker’s offensive explosion, Kansas City dominated in nearly every area of the game and showcased a defense that could become the key factor in helping the Chiefs return to championship contention.

The performance of the defense was one of the biggest surprises. Dan Orlovsky was particularly impressed by the way Steve Spagnuolo ’s unit attacked Denver’s new offensive coordinator, Davis Webb, from the opening snap during his analysis on NFL Live .

“I’d also say this. I was shocked how good the defense was in Kansas City last night. This was not all about, ‘Oh my gosh, Davis Webb can’t call plays, and Sean Payton should come save the day.’ That’s going to be a conversation. But the first snap of the game, Spags sends both corners blitzing. Of course he does. I thought the linebackers were outstanding against the run. The coverage on the perimeter. I texted you during the game going, who’s No. 20?” Orlovsky said while discussing Nohl Williams, the Chiefs’ 2025 third-round draft pick.

The former NFL quarterback acknowledged that there were questions about the true level of Kansas City’s defense entering the season, but the performance against Denver completely changed his perspective.

“I was hopeful that they would run the football. I was. I was way more, I guess, question-mark-centric about the defense. What I watched last night, it felt like a defense that could carry them early on as the offense really starts to settle in. And no question, it’s a championship-caliber defense, at least from what we saw last night.”

During the 2025 season, the Broncos’ offense was one of the strengths of Sean Payton’s team, finishing 14th in the NFL in points scored, 11th in passing yards, and 16th in rushing yards.

That is why holding that offense — which also added Jaylen Waddle — to 13.6 points below its previous season average represents a major statement from a Chiefs team that looks more complete, balanced and dangerous in its pursuit of another championship.

articles.title: Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift have their first neighborhood issue at their new mansion
articles.standfirst: What happened?
articles.summary: What happened?
articles.body:
After a wedding that is still keeping many details private, Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift seem to be enjoying a much quieter chapter with a new acquisition: a massive property.

The house cost $5.35 million and has everything needed to become a private retreat , although there is one small detail that kept their arrival in the neighborhood from going completely unnoticed.

A mansion overlooking Lake Erie

The property is in Bratenahl, Ohio, a small lakeside village just outside Cleveland and only a few miles from Cleveland Heights, where Kelce grew up alongside his brother Jason .

The estate spans 3.5 acres along Lake Erie, with an approximately 21,000-square-foot home spread across three levels. It also features a heated pool, spa, gym, wine cellar, private movie theater and an entertainment area.

In other words, privacy and space don't exactly seem to be an issue. But for a couple at this level, privacy has to be complete.

The fence that didn't sit well with neighbors

The property's security plan included a perimeter fence. The measure, however, raised concerns among nearby residents , particularly because of how it could affect the landscape views from some neighboring properties.

The situation was discussed with residents in the area, and the project ultimately changed: the section of the fence that extended toward the shoreline was scrapped .

And while the property belongs to the Kelces and the installation required the appropriate permits, there was one detail that went beyond the boundaries of their land: the views and landscape are also part of what makes the area appealing and, generally speaking, aren't owned by any one person .

Kelce's life continues between two worlds

And while all of this is happening away from the spotlight, the Kansas City Chiefs officially began their 2026 season yesterday, with Kelce back for his 14th season.

The start couldn't have been more notable: Kansas City defeated the Denver Broncos 31-10, and Kelce finished the game with 71 receiving yards , enough to surpass Jason Witten and become the second tight end with the most receiving yards in NFL history, behind only Tony Gonzalez.

articles.title: Chiefs dodge major disaster following game-day injury scare with Mansoor Delane
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs thought they found their next defensive star… until his dream debut turned into an injury scare that could change Kansas City’s plans.
articles.summary: The Chiefs thought they found their next defensive star… until his dream debut turned into an injury scare that could change Kansas City’s plans.
articles.body:
M ansoor Delane had a debut of highs and lows with the Kansas City Chiefs . The rookie cornerback experienced a dream moment when he recorded the first interception of his NFL career, but the celebration was short-lived. Minutes later, he left the game with a shoulder injury that immediately raised concerns within the organization.

The play came on the third snap of the matchup against the Denver Broncos , when Delane intercepted quarterback Bo Nix for his first major highlight as a professional. However, after making the tackle, he landed hard on his right shoulder, forcing him out of the game, according to Josh Alper of NBC Sports.

The cornerback did not return after heading to the locker room during Denver’s second offensive possession. Despite his absence, Kansas City rolled to a convincing 31-10 victory .

Chiefs hoping for positive news on Mansoor Delane’s shoulder injury

The injury creates concern for a Kansas City defense that revamped its cornerback group during the offseason. If Delane is forced to miss multiple games, veteran L’Jarius Sneed could become the primary replacement after returning to the Chiefs in June following two seasons with the Tennessee Titans .

The initial reports provided some optimism. NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reported that the Chiefs scheduled an MRI for Tuesday after X-rays taken the night of the game did not reveal any significant damage.

Garafolo noted that the team remains hopeful Delane suffered only a sprain, especially considering his previous issues in the same area.

Meanwhile, Ian Rapoport reported on NFL Network that both the X-rays and CT scan came back negative.

“He made the interception, landed on that shoulder, and actually suffered an injury earlier in the spring and summer on that scapula — landed right on that. He’s had some tests. X-ray negative — that is a good sign. CT scan negative. Not out of the woods yet, but there’s a lot of positivity that this is a short-term injury,” Rapoport said.

The reporter added that the expectation around the Chiefs is that Delane could miss minimal time.

This is not the first time in 2026 that the rookie’s shoulder has limited him. During much of spring practices, he worked in a non-contact jersey after suffering an injury to the same area during organized team activities (OTAs), and he was not cleared for full contact until the final weeks of training camp.

From LSU star to key piece of Kansas City’s future

The Chiefs made a major investment in Delane during the 2026 NFL Draft. Kansas City traded up from the No. 9 pick to No. 6 overall to select the LSU cornerback , a move that came after sending Trent McDuffie to the Rams and losing Jaylen Watson in free agency, according to Pro Football Rumors .

The organization viewed Delane as the top cornerback prospect in the draft class.

After three seasons at Virginia Tech , Delane transferred to LSU in 2025 and turned his lone season with the Tigers into a standout campaign. He was named a unanimous All-American after recording 45 tackles, two interceptions and 11 passes defended, while finishing second in the SEC in that category.

The Maryland native played high school football at Archbishop Spalding before joining Virginia Tech. He finished his college career with 191 tackles, eight interceptions and 27 passes defended across 44 games.

articles.title: Andy Reid admits Chris Berman sent him the play that the Chiefs used to surprise the Broncos
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs reached deep into football history for one of their most creative touchdowns of Week 1
articles.summary: The Chiefs reached deep into football history for one of their most creative touchdowns of Week 1
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs spent much of Monday night showing what their offense could look like with a new feature back. One of their most memorable touchdowns, though, came from a play that was anything but new.

Late in a 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos , Patrick Mahomes lined up with backup quarterback Justin Fields beside him and helped sell a sequence that looked designed to go in several different directions.

Fields moved left as if he might take the ball. Mahomes instead flipped a short forward pass to Kenneth Walker III, who crossed the formation and finished the 2-yard touchdown.

The play had all the hallmarks of an Andy Reid special with the Chief's head coach later revealing the source.

“Chris Berman sent me that play, so that’s a 1936’er right there,” Reid told reporters Tuesday. “Honestly, it was a great play. They executed it well. … We’ve run it before, just not that smooth.”

Walker had to learn play from ancient film

The age of the concept apparently made preparing for it an experience in itself.

Walker joked after the game that Kansas City’s film study hardly resembled the high-definition footage NFL players are accustomed to seeing.

“The film we watched was probably from 1900, so it was hard to see,” Walker said. “But we worked it over and over in practice, and we felt like that was going to work... and it did.”

That touchdown capped a remarkable Chiefs debut for Walker . The former Seattle Seahawks running back finished with 173 rushing yards and 191 yards from scrimmage, both career highs, while scoring twice.

His biggest play came on a 60-yard touchdown run after he recognized Denver crashing inside.

“I knew they were going to crash in, so when they crashed in, I just bounced it out,” Walker said. “I was one-on-one with the corner, I outran him and it was off to the races from there.”

Walker changed shape of Kansas City offense

Mahomes has spent much of his career carrying a Chiefs attack that rarely leaned heavily on the running game. Walker’s arrival may alter that equation.

“I told you all, literally, like first press conference,” Mahomes said. “Y'all were asking, what's the difference with our offense? And I said, K9. Like, it's just that simple.”

Walker forced 14 missed tackles and produced 101 rushing yards over expectation, according to NFL Pro, giving Kansas City exactly the kind of explosive ground threat it has often lacked.

Reid described his performance as “spectacular.” The Chiefs may not need a trick play from 1936 every week. But after Berman ’s suggestion helped produce a touchdown, Reid might not mind receiving another history lesson.

articles.title: Troy Aikman makes claim that would suggest the Chiefs are breaking NFL rules
articles.standfirst: Analyst immediately flagged Aikman’s claim that Kansas City practiced in pads for six straight days
articles.summary: Analyst immediately flagged Aikman’s claim that Kansas City practiced in pads for six straight days
articles.body:
Troy Aikman spent Monday night analyzing what the Kansas City Chiefs were doing on the field against Denver and one comment about what they supposedly did weeks earlier in training camp may now draw more attention.

During ESPN’s broadcast of Kansas City’s 31-10 Week 1 NFL victory over the Broncos , Aikman said the Chiefs had practiced in pads for six consecutive days during camp.

That immediately caught the attention of NFL analyst Marcus Mosher , who suggested Aikman may have inadvertently raised a compliance issue.

“Uhh... Troy Aikman probably just got the Chiefs in trouble,” Mosher wrote on X. “He just said that the Chiefs practiced in pads six days in a row. You can't practice more than 3-straight days with pads in camp.”

NFL training-camp rules place restrictions on consecutive padded practices as part of player workload protections, meaning Aikman ’s description sounded notable if taken literally.

No violation has been established at this point. Aikman may have been speaking loosely, and it remains unclear whether every session he referenced would meet the league’s definition of a padded practice.

Aikman’s wording under scrutiny

The remark stood out because it came during a nationally televised game rather than through an anonymous report or offseason rumor.

If Aikman’s account was accurate, the league could review exactly how the Chiefs structured those practices. If it was simply an imprecise description, the issue may go no further.

Mosher ’s response reflected that uncertainty while pointing out why the statement immediately sounded problematic. Kansas City had considerably better things to discuss on the field.

Patrick Mahomes , returning from the ACL and LCL injuries that ended his previous season, completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards, two touchdowns and an interception. He also rushed for 23 yards and another score.

Kenneth Walker III supplied the biggest offensive performance, rushing for 173 yards as the Chiefs controlled the game.

Aikman drawing attention from Chiefs fans

The training-camp remark wasn't Aikman ’s only talking point Monday. He also highlighted a possible missed holding call on Travis Kelce during a Mahomes touchdown run.

“Travis Kelce might have gotten away with a hold,” Aikman said while reviewing the play.

ESPN rules analyst Russell Yurk agreed, saying Kelce ’s arm appeared to restrict Broncos safety Talanoa Hufanga and prevent him from reaching Mahomes .

Some Kansas City fans responded angrily online, accusing Aikman of being overly critical of the Chiefs . That debate will likely fade quicker than the training camp comment if the NFL decides it warrants attention.

Kansas City left Monday night with a convincing win. Whether Aikman accidentally left the Chiefs with something else to answer remains to be seen.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes calls out the experts on ESPN's Sunday NFL Countdown for underestimating the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: The pregame panel leaned toward Denver, but Kansas City answered with a statement victory at Arrowhead
articles.summary: The pregame panel leaned toward Denver, but Kansas City answered with a statement victory at Arrowhead
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes didn't need a long caption to make her point after the Kansas City Chiefs opened the 2026 NFL season with a dominant win.

Before kickoff, several members of ESPN’s pregame crew had picked the Denver Broncos to beat Kansas City at Arrowhead Stadium.

By the end of the night, the Chiefs had won 31-10, snapped a three-game losing streak to their division rival and looked far more balanced than they had for much of the previous season.

Brittany waited until afterward to revisit those predictions. She shared a screenshot showing Mike Greenberg, Dominique Foxworth, Tedy Bruschi and Rex Ryan all backing Denver and added a one-word message: “Oopsies.”

It was a playful jab, but it landed because of how thoroughly Kansas City had controlled the game.

Kansas City gave Brittany plenty to celebrate

The Chiefs finished with nearly 400 yards of offense while holding Denver to fewer than half that total. Patrick Mahomes , returning from the ACL and LCL injuries that ended his previous season, didn't have to carry the offense on his own.

Kansas City instead leaned heavily on new running back Kenneth Walker III , who immediately changed the shape of the attack. Walker rushed for 173 yards and scored twice in his Chiefs debut, including a 60-yard touchdown run.

That performance gave Mahomes the luxury of playing within the offense rather than having to create something extraordinary on every drive.

Kansas City’s defense also made life difficult for Denver, limiting the Broncos to 10 points and preventing them from finding any sustained rhythm.

The result made the pregame predictions look especially vulnerable once the final whistle arrived.

Mahomes comeback made moment even sweeter

The win carried extra significance for Brittany because it was Patrick’s first regular-season game since undergoing major knee surgery. Much of the offseason had been built around whether he would be ready for Week 1 at all.

Mahomes returned wearing a brace but looked comfortable enough to guide Kansas City through a convincing opening-night performance. The larger takeaway may have been how little the Chiefs needed him to dominate statistically.

Walker ’s arrival gave them a running threat capable of taking pressure off their quarterback, while the defense supplied the kind of control that allowed Kansas City to dictate the game.

One performance doesn't settle how good either team will be this season, but it gave the Chiefs exactly the kind of start they wanted. It also gave Brittany the chance to revisit what ESPN’s panel had said only a few hours earlier.

articles.title: The Chiefs make a cut after beating the Broncos: Mahomes loses a teammate
articles.standfirst: Kansas City began the season with a spectacular victory over Denver, but the next day management made a decision that completely changes their roster.
articles.summary: Kansas City began the season with a spectacular victory over Denver, but the next day management made a decision that completely changes their roster.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs did not take long to make moves after securing a big 31-10 victory for the team this Monday. Although the outcome was celebrated, it also raised concerns about the lack of depth on the roster after the injuries to rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane and linebacker Cooper McDonald .

The team released a defensive back from its practice squad this Tuesday , in a move recorded just one day after the win at Arrowhead Stadium. The move affects a player who had already had a particular path between Kansas City and Denver .

Who is the player who left the Chiefs?

While Patrick Mahomes celebrated his long-awaited return to the NFL, the franchise made a change to its roster that went practically unnoticed amid the aftermath of the game.

The central figure in the decision is Tanner McCalister, a 26-year-old defensive back who had returned to Kansas City in February 2026 on a reserve/future contract. He had previously spent time with the Broncos and the Cleveland Browns , in addition to an earlier stint on the Chiefs ' practice squad.

McCalister was not part of the active roster that played in the game against Denver. In fact, Kansas City had temporarily elevated two other players from its practice squad, Marcus Harris and Ben VanSumeren , for the matchup. Both later returned to the practice squad, while McCalister was released.

Tanner has recorded three total tackles over the course of his NFL career , taking advantage of his high football IQ and excellent ability to read the backfield during his limited opportunities as a player.

The event occurs after an especially important night for the Chiefs in which the team defeated the Broncos 31-10 in the season opener and Keneth Walker III shined by improving his own personal record in rushing yards.

The win also produced another historic moment: Travis Kelce surpassed Jason Witten and became the second tight end with the most receiving yards in NFL history, reaching 13,073.

Kansas City is already preparing for the second week of the season and continues adjusting its roster. McCalister was the first player released by the Chiefs after the win over Denver.

articles.title: Andy Reid was celebrating the Chiefs’ first win when Clark Hunt surprised him in the locker room
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs owner interrupted the postgame celebration
articles.summary: The Chiefs owner interrupted the postgame celebration
articles.body:
Andy Reid entered the Kansas City Chiefs’ locker room after their dominant 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos ready to celebrate his players. He did not know the most important announcement of the night would be about him.

Chiefs owner Clark Hunt stood before the team and explained that although many players deserved the game ball, two people inside the organization had just reached major career milestones.

“There are a lot of players in here who deserve the game ball today, but two very special people are celebrating significant milestones,” Hunt said.

Clark Hunt reveals Andy Reid’s milestone

Hunt announced that the victory was Reid’s 150th regular-season win as head coach of the Chiefs. He then placed the game ball in the veteran coach’s hands.

The owner had another surprise. General manager Brett Veach had also reached his 200th NFL victory , giving the Chiefs two reasons to celebrate beyond their impressive performance on the field.

Mahomes completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards and two touchdowns in his return from ACL and LCL tears in his left knee. He also rushed for 23 yards and scored another touchdown, while newcomer Kenneth Walker III produced 173 rushing yards and two total scores.

Travis Kelce also passed Jason Witten for the second-most receiving yards by a tight end in NFL history. Taylor Swift watched his achievement from a star-filled suite alongside Tom Cruise, Pat McAfee, Andrea Swift, Donna Kelce and Jason Kelce.

Kansas City Chiefs owner Clark Hunt is a billionaire who remains close to the people. Rain or shine, he takes the time to shake hands with fans, just like his wife, Tavia Hunt . He also embraces the players in the tunnel after victories. The Chiefs appear to be rising again, and their owners are there to celebrate every step of the way.

articles.title: Travis Kelce reveals the habit Jason Kelce’s daughters had to break with Taylor Swift
articles.summary: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s daughters had to adjust to a new way of addressing Taylor Swift when she became part of their family circle.
articles.body:
Jason and Kylie Kelce’s daughters had to adjust to a new way of addressing Taylor Swift when she became part of their family circle.

Travis Kelce revealed that when the girls first met Taylor, they naturally called her “Taylor Swift,” simply because that was the name they knew her by.

Jason even recreated the adorable moments, imagining his daughters asking, “Taylor Swift, can I do this?” The brothers laughed about the habit, with Travis calling it adorable, while Jason reassured his daughters that they could simply call her Taylor.

Now, the girls have gotten used to having Aunt Tay Tay in their lives.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes reacts after winning betting fan $2100 with opening touchdown against Broncos
articles.standfirst: Mahomes secured the opening touchdown of the night against the Denver Broncos.
articles.summary: Mahomes secured the opening touchdown of the night against the Denver Broncos.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes ’ return to the Kansas City Chiefs came with a reminder of why his biggest moments often arrive when they are least expected: a 15-yard touchdown run turned one bold bet into a $2,100 payday. The bettor backed Mahomes at +2000 to score the first touchdown against the Denver Broncos , and the wager landed during Kansas City ’s opening drive of Monday night’s 31-10 victory at Arrowhead Stadium .

The bettor’s reaction was shared on X by Gavin McHugh, who posted a video captioned “Patrick Mahomes first TD +2000 Live reaction” The clip eventually reached Mahomes himself. Mahomes responded with six laughing-face emojis, adding a fitting coda to a wager that required him to finish the drive rather than create the touchdown with his arm or hand the ball off. The quarterback reached the end zone on a 15-yard scramble, one play after an earlier touchdown was wiped out by a holding penalty on rookie left tackle Kahlil Benson , who had never played the role before. The score was also a personal milestone after Mahomes spent nine months recovering from torn ACL and LCL ligaments in his left knee. He underwent surgery the day after the December 2025 injury. Mahomes said the touchdown offered a tangible sign that the long rehabilitation had produced the progress he wanted. “That was definitely the moment physically,” Mahomes said. “Where that kind of said all my rehabilitation work paid off. I didn’t feel anything. “And it’s still a process; I still have to keep getting better and better and stay on top of it. But this is obviously a great first week.” The comeback came against a Denver team that had swept Kansas City last season on its way to a 14-3 record, while the Chiefs entered after missing the NFL Playoffs for the first time since 2014.

Is the swashbuckling brand of Patrick Mahomes football gone forever?

Kenneth Walker II I supplied most of the offensive spark on the night by rushing for 173 yards and two touchdowns as Kansas City piled up 392 total yards whilst the Chiefs ’ defense also held Denver to 176 yards. And Mahomes was efficient enough to help Kansas City control the game, completing 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards and two touchdowns while adding 23 rushing yards and the score on the ground. Despite the emphatic result, a Fox Sports radio host argued that Mahomes ’ reputation still exceeds his recent regular-season production, urging listeners to temper expectations after Week 1. “People have to be realistic about what to expect,” Jason Smith said. “He’ll be a good quarterback again. He won’t be great because he hasn’t been great in four years. What he has been is a clutch quarterback, and there’s a difference.” The mind-blowing style of Mahomes that once passed for 5000 yards hasn’t been seen since 2022, but if the Kansas City Chiefs keep winning games 31-10, then few will mind.

articles.title: Travis Kelce had to break a family habit to make Taylor Swift feel part of the Kelces
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift went from a worldwide superstar to Aunt Tay Tay inside the Kelce family
articles.summary: Taylor Swift went from a worldwide superstar to Aunt Tay Tay inside the Kelce family
articles.body:
I t may not have taken long for Taylor Swift to be considered part of the Kelce family. She has clearly earned her place as Aunt Tay Tay, and Jason and Kylie Kelce’s daughters adore her. But there was a time when, just like the rest of the world, the girls knew her simply as Taylor Swift.

The girls may not have understood the magnitude of that name or just how famous the singer is around the world , but they knew one thing: she was Taylor Swift. That was the name they recognized, so naturally, that was what they called her when they first met her.

From Taylor Swift to just Taylor

In a way, Taylor Swift will always be Taylor Swift to the rest of the world . Her name has become so iconic in entertainment that simply saying Taylor can often be enough for people to know exactly who you mean. But inside a family, calling someone by their full name when that name also happens to be their stage name can become a habit worth breaking.

For Travis, Taylor was going to be part of his family, and that meant she also had to feel like part of the Kelces . Jason and Travis eventually had to help the girls move away from calling her by her full name. Travis explained that when the girls first met their future aunt, they would naturally say “Taylor Swift” whenever they wanted to talk to her.

The Kelce daughters made it even more adorable

Jason remembered the moments by imitating his daughters asking Taylor for permission to do something, still addressing her as “Taylor Swift.” He and Travis laughed about the habit, with Travis calling it adorable.

Jason then reassured the girls that they could simply call her Taylor , helping them make that shift from seeing her as the superstar they knew from the outside to someone who was becoming part of their family.

After everything Travis and Taylor have experienced together, the girls no longer need to call her Taylor Swift. She is not just Taylor, Tay or even Tay Tay to them. She is Aunt Tay Tay, the name that now reflects her place in the family.

articles.title: "Bring Him Back!" - Chiefs Kingdom reacts to rumors of October Tyreek Hill signing
articles.standfirst: Hill left Kansas City at the end of 2021 to join the Miami Dolphins.
articles.summary: Hill left Kansas City at the end of 2021 to join the Miami Dolphins.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs opened their 2026 NFL campaign with a convincing 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos , but the performance has sparked another conversation among fans: could Tyreek Hill be coming back? Patrick Mahomes returned from an ACL injury, and although he did not appear fully healthy, Kansas City found other ways to control Monday Night Football . Its defense and running game helped deliver an emphatic opening-week victory.

The Chiefs ' receiving corps, however, remains a talking point heading into the season. With questions surrounding the group's depth and explosiveness, a familiar face could provide the kind of boost Kansas City needs. ESPN insiders Jeremy Fowler and Dan Graziano have now raised the possibility of Hill returning to the team during the season with the former Chiefs wide receiver remains a free agent as he continues recovering from a serious injury. “Free agent receiver Tyreek Hill remains fond of the Chiefs, and a potential in-season signing would make a lot of sense. He should be closer to playing around October,” Fowler and Graziano reported. The reaction from Chiefs fans has centered on the possibility of bringing back a player who helped define the team's explosive offense. Hill 's speed and familiarity with Mahomes make the idea particularly appealing. Kansas City could benefit from another experienced receiver, especially while Mahomes works his way back from injury. Hill 's return would also reunite the quarterback with a former teammate who knows the offense. Travis Kelce provided a reminder of the team's existing playmaking ability against Denver , producing a significant gain that nearly ended in a touchdown. A healthy Hill could offer another explosive option if a deal materializes. However, Kansas City has reasons to remain patient. Hill is still recovering, and the ESPN report suggests October is a potential return window rather than a confirmed date. For now, the Chiefs have only opened the season with a statement win, while Hill remains unsigned. But with ESPN insiders raising the possibility and fans calling for a reunion, the conversation around his future is unlikely to disappear.

Did Hill Drop Latest Hint of a Move Back to Kansas City?

Hill 's potential availability has given Chiefs fans something to discuss, particularly after the team's dominant performance against Denver . The possibility of adding his speed to Mahomes ' offense has quickly captured attention. The wide receiver last played for Kansas City during the 2021 season, when he won his second Super Bowl alongside Mahomes . The Chiefs subsequently traded him to the Miami Dolphins in 2022. Hill enjoyed some of the most productive individual seasons of his career in Miami , twice surpassing 1,700 receiving yards. However, the Dolphins did not experience the same postseason success he had enjoyed in Kansas City . His time in Miami took a difficult turn after the team struggled during the 2024 season. Hill then suffered a significant leg injury in 2025, leaving his immediate playing future uncertain. Now recovering as a free agent, Hill could choose his next destination once he is ready to return and he also appeared to take notice of Kansas City 's Monday night performance. While watching the game, the former Chiefs star posted a brief message on X.com, formerly Twitter, that quickly attracted attention, “hm”. The two-letter post was enough to get some fans wondering whether Hill was hinting at a possible return, although this is not confirmed.

articles.title: Cue the "Refs Love the Chiefs" tweets: Travis Kelce admits officials botched missed flag
articles.standfirst: Kelce admits he got lucky with a holding call against the Denver Broncos.
articles.summary: Kelce admits he got lucky with a holding call against the Denver Broncos.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelc e has given NFL fans another reason to debate the officiating after admitting he was fortunate to escape a holding penalty during the Kansas City Chiefs ' 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos . The tight end addressed the controversial play with his brother Jason and his comments have reignited the familiar debate about whether Kansas City receives favorable treatment.

The incident occurred during a scoring drive after the Chiefs intercepted Bo Nix as Patrick Mahomes subsequently found the end zone, but Kelce 's block became a major talking point among viewers. The Chiefs had opened their 2026 season with an emphatic victory, offering encouragement after missing the playoffs entirely in 2025. However, the apparent missed penalty quickly shifted attention toward the officials. Kelce did not dismiss the controversy when discussing the play. Instead, the veteran tight end acknowledged that the block was questionable and admitted he was relieved when no flag appeared. “It was definitely a questionable play,” Kelce said on New Heights . “That's one of those where you get up slowly, like ‘please don't let there be any laundry on the field’”. The Chiefs star also acknowledged the nature of the contact, admitting that his opponent had been caught in an awkward position during the block. “Had a man up by his neck. Can't do it. Almost cost us,” Kelce continued, recognizing that the incident could have changed the outcome of the scoring opportunity. He explained that a holding penalty would have had significant consequences for Kansas City 's drive too. “And, to be honest, that would have been Pat Mahomes' second rushing touchdown called back in two plays because we literally did the same thing,” Kelce said. “That would have taken us out of the red zone. “That was risky business, right there. Technically I didn't grab anything, I just kind of hugged him.” Skip Bayless also weighed in, joking that the officials had given Kelce a belated wedding present by overlooking the apparent hold whilst others expressed frustration with the officiating.

Injured Chiefs star receives positive update

The Chiefs also received encouraging news on the injury front, with head coach Andy Reid confirming that rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane would return to practice Wednesday. Reid also suggested there was a strong possibility Delane would be available for Sunday's game, although his participation in practice would help determine his status. “Delane is back, and he'll be out there today doing his thing,” Reid said, raising hopes that the first-round pick could feature against the Indianapolis Colts . “Yeah, there's a pretty good chance he'll be back out there. He's going to go today.” Delane had left the season opener with a shoulder injury after recording an interception on his third snap. His potential return would provide a boost to Kansas City 's defense. The Chiefs are still monitoring other injuries, with left tackle Josh Simmons and safety Chamarri Conner expected to remain sidelined.

The tight end addressed the controversial play with his brother Jason and his comments have reignited the familiar debate about whether Kansas City receives favorable treatment.

The incident occurred during a scoring drive after the Chiefs intercepted Bo Nix as Patrick Mahomes subsequently found the end zone, but Kelce 's block became a major talking point among viewers. The Chiefs had opened their 2026 season with an emphatic victory, offering encouragement after missing the playoffs entirely in 2025. However, the apparent missed penalty quickly shifted attention toward the officials. Kelce did not dismiss the controversy when discussing the play. Instead, the veteran tight end acknowledged that the block was questionable and admitted he was relieved when no flag appeared. “It was definitely a questionable play,” Kelce said on New Heights . “That's one of those where you get up slowly, like ‘please don't let there be any laundry on the field’”. The Chiefs star also acknowledged the nature of the contact, admitting that his opponent had been caught in an awkward position during the block. “Had a man up by his neck. Can't do it. Almost cost us,” Kelce continued, recognizing that the incident could have changed the outcome of the scoring opportunity. He explained that a holding penalty would have had significant consequences for Kansas City 's drive too. “And, to be honest, that would have been Pat Mahomes' second rushing touchdown called back in two plays because we literally did the same thing,” Kelce said. “That would have taken us out of the red zone. “That was risky business, right there. Technically I didn't grab anything, I just kind of hugged him.” Skip Bayless also weighed in, joking that the officials had given Kelce a belated wedding present by overlooking the apparent hold whilst others expressed frustration with the officiating.
Injured Chiefs star receives positive update

The Chiefs also received encouraging news on the injury front, with head coach Andy Reid confirming that rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane would return to practice Wednesday. Reid also suggested there was a strong possibility Delane would be available for Sunday's game, although his participation in practice would help determine his status. “Delane is back, and he'll be out there today doing his thing,” Reid said, raising hopes that the first-round pick could feature against the Indianapolis Colts . “Yeah, there's a pretty good chance he'll be back out there. He's going to go today.” Delane had left the season opener with a shoulder injury after recording an interception on his third snap. His potential return would provide a boost to Kansas City 's defense. The Chiefs are still monitoring other injuries, with left tackle Josh Simmons and safety Chamarri Conner expected to remain sidelined.
