articles.title: Andy Reid drops terrifying reality check on Chiefs rookies immediately after Week 1 victory
articles.standfirst: Chiefs rookies shine in opener, but Andy Reid sends a clear message.
articles.summary: Chiefs rookies shine in opener, but Andy Reid sends a clear message.
articles.body:
There was little to worry about for the Kansas City Chiefs after their dominant 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos in Week 1 of the NFL season.

Andy Reid ’s team showed strength on both sides of the ball in its season opener, but one of the biggest reasons for optimism was the immediate impact from its rookie class. The early returns from the Chiefs’ 2026 NFL Draft class have been extremely encouraging.

Andy Reid sends warning to his rookies

Although Reid was pleased with the performance of his young players against Denver, he knows the real challenge is just beginning. During his Wednesday press conference, as the Chiefs began preparing for their Week 2 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts , the coach reminded his rookies that opposing teams now have plenty of film to study them.

“Brett (Veach) did a nice job of bringing the guys in and drafting them,” Reid said of his rookies. “It was good to see. The thing I mentioned to them, there’s tape out there now. Whatever hiccups you had, you got to fix those. You know these other coaches are pretty creative people, and the players study you.”

The next step for Kansas City’s rookies will be responding to the adjustments made by the rest of the league. The ease with which they made an impact against the Broncos does not guarantee the same results moving forward, especially when they face defenses that already know their strengths and weaknesses.

Chiefs’ rookies generating excitement

During the offseason, Kansas City focused on a youth movement, particularly on defense. Cornerback Mansoor Delane and defensive linemen R. Mason Thomas and Peter Woods have emerged as players with the potential to become long-term pillars of the unit.

Delane enjoyed a dream debut before suffering a shoulder injury, intercepting Bo Nix on Denver’s opening drive and showing why the Chiefs are so high on him.

Thomas also made an immediate impact, finishing his first game with two tackles, two quarterback pressures, and a sack, while Woods contributed two tackles, one quarterback pressure, and a pass defended.

On offense, running back Emmett Johnson made the most of his opportunities as the backup to Kenneth Walker III . The rookie finished the game with eight carries for 24 yards and added two receptions for 44 yards .

With a new generation beginning to emerge, the Chiefs appear to have found important pieces to help support Patrick Mahomes for years to come.

articles.title: Travis Kelce turns into an absolute bully before the Denver Broncos' kickoff
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce wasn't in the mood to share. The Chiefs star grabbed two Broncos footballs during pregame warmups and launched them away.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce wasn't in the mood to share. The Chiefs star grabbed two Broncos footballs during pregame warmups and launched them away.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce once again stole the spotlight before kickoff. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end sparked an unusual and controversial moment during pregame warmups against the Denver Broncos , grabbing two of Denver's footballs and sending them far out of reach.

ESPN's Steve Coughlin revealed on Scott Van Pelt 's podcast that the incident immediately reminded him of Kelce's famous confrontation with kicker Justin Tucker before the 2024 AFC Championship Game against the Baltimore Ravens .

According to Coughlin, the Broncos' punting drills began spilling into the area where Patrick Mahomes , Kelce, and Kansas City's receivers were going through their pregame routine. The veteran tight end quickly grew frustrated.

"I know how the Justin Tucker-Kelce confrontation happened a couple years back, because it almost happened last night," Coughlin told Van Pelt.

Kelce loses his cool during warmups

According to Coughlin, Denver's warmup schedule got out of sync, causing punts to land in the area being used by the Chiefs' offense.

"The Broncos sort of messed up their timing. I don't know if they got out there late or the timing of where they started was, because the receivers and tight ends are running routes on air with Mahomes and the quarterbacks," Coughlin said. "The receivers are running for the Chiefs from the goal line out, and the punts are coming over the 50-yard line."

That's when Kelce spotted the first football.

"Travis' eyes lit up, and he sees the ball," Coughlin said . "It's a Broncos ball, and it goes over towards the Broncos sideline. He catches his route, runs over to the ball, takes the Broncos ball and punts it almost to the second deck. Good punter."

"And then now he's looking for another one. Sure enough, he goes back, gives the ball up, goes back, runs his route, and he's just steaming. You can see it. Here comes another one," Coughlin added.

This time, a Broncos ball boy raced over to retrieve it, but Kelce got there first.

"So now the Broncos ball boy is running over because he saw what Travis did. Travis is like, 'Nope.' He beats him to the ball, takes the Broncos ball, chucks it up into the stands," Coughlin said. "I'm like, 'All right, we're back here.'"

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce face security issues at their Ohio mansion
articles.standfirst: The couple reportedly wanted an 8-foot privacy fence, but strict lakefront rules forced a rethink
articles.summary: The couple reportedly wanted an 8-foot privacy fence, but strict lakefront rules forced a rethink
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce reportedly wanted to make their new Ohio home considerably more private, but a local zoning rule has forced the couple to scale back part of their security plan.

The pair sought permission to install an 8-foot fence around their lakefront estate in Bratenahl, according to reports, only to run into village restrictions that limit fences along the water to roughly 2.5 feet unless they are at least 75 percent transparent.

Those rules are designed to protect lake views and nearby property values, and the proposal was either rejected or left unresolved during multiple meetings of the Bratenahl Architectural Review Board .

After discussions with neighbors and local officials, Swift and Kelce reportedly agreed to a shorter fence that wouldn't fully enclose the property. Kelce was described as “gracious” while dealing with the village over the request.

Security remains major priority

The fence setback doesn't mean the couple has abandoned efforts to protect the property. A separate security system has already been installed around the home and is reportedly capable of issuing verbal warnings when someone approaches too closely.

“A neighbor approached the house and got a voice warning about not passing onto the property after getting too close to the house,” a nearby resident said.

The scale of the property makes privacy especially significant. Built in 1895, the home spans more than 21,000 square feet and includes several fireplaces, a media room, a five-car garage and a resort-style swimming pool and spa.

Kelce purchased the mansion in March for $5.35 million, well below its original $6.99 million asking price. The estate sits only a few miles from Cleveland Heights, where the Kansas City Chiefs star grew up alongside his brother Jason Kelce .

Growing attention on their private life

Swift and Kelce have faced intense public interest throughout their relationship, and that attention has only increased since their July wedding at Madison Square Garden.

The Bratenahl property is part of an expanding real-estate portfolio that includes homes in Kansas, New York, Tennessee, Rhode Island and California . Despite the couple’s high profile, local residents have reportedly said their arrival has caused little disruption.

Real-estate agent Patricia Knight Gary said she hadn't been aware of any special village-wide fencing changes and noted that many residents learned about the couple’s move only when it became public.

The taller fence may not be going ahead as planned, but with Swift and Kelce continuing to make privacy a priority, even if the rules surrounding their new home mean finding a different way to achieve it.

articles.title: Brad Pitt lost girlfriend, Ines de Ramon, at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding because of the bride and groom
articles.standfirst: The actor praised the couple’s strict privacy rule after attending the star-studded Madison Square Garden ceremony
articles.summary: The actor praised the couple’s strict privacy rule after attending the star-studded Madison Square Garden ceremony
articles.body:
Brad Pitt says Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ’s wedding delivered exactly what the couple wanted which was privacy, spontaneity and a room full of guests actually living in the moment.

It also briefly left him unable to find his own girlfriend. Pitt attended the July 3 wedding at Madison Square Garden with Ines de Ramon and later recalled just how immersive the celebration became once hundreds of guests were inside without their phones.

“Let me tell you, that was such an amazing night,” Pitt said in an interview with Entertainment Tonight. “I think we were there 10 hours, maybe 12. It was so thoughtful and well planned, and really moving, and great fun.

“And yeah, but it was big,” Pitt added. “Yeah. And yeah, at one point, I lost her in the melee on the dance floor.”

The separation was brief, with Pitt clarifying that he found de Ramon again soon afterward.

No-phone rule was deliberate

Kelce had already explained that he and Swift wanted guests to stay off their phones during the wedding. Speaking on New Heights, Kelce said the absence of cameras helped change the atmosphere.

“It was so cool to see how everybody interacted, and with no phones comes people not having to be on guard and feel whatever that feeling is for everyone,” Kelce said. “It makes everyone be in the moment and be present.

“That’s what we wanted it to be,” he added. “We wanted it to be a beautiful ceremony, but we also wanted to make sure that everybody left there having some fun. And it was a magical night, man.”

The policy appears to have worked. Despite the size of the guest list and the number of high-profile attendees, relatively little from inside the celebration has emerged publicly.

A star-filled wedding that felt private

The wedding blended Hollywood, music and the NFL. Austin Swift served as his sister’s man of honor, while Jason Kelce was Travis’ best man. Adam Sandler officiated.

Reported guests included Jennifer Lawrence, Ed Sheeran, Zoe Kravitz, Bradley Cooper, Gigi Hadid, Patrick Mahomes, Tom Brady, Andy Reid and Matthew Stafford .

Pitt ’s account suggests that even with the highly controlled environment, the party itself was anything but stiff. He and de Ramon have been together since 2022 and have appeared more frequently in public together in recent years.

Pitt has previously pushed back on the idea that their public appearances are carefully staged. “No, life just evolves,” he told GQ in 2025. “Relationships evolve.”

At Swift and Kelce ’s wedding, that evolution apparently included a few frantic moments on a crowded dance floor. Pitt still came away with a glowing verdict.

articles.title: Travis Kelce, victim of a Ponzi scheme of more than $35 million dollars
articles.standfirst: According to prosecutors, Siddharth Jawahar defrauded 64 victims, including the Kansas City Chiefs tight end.
articles.summary: According to prosecutors, Siddharth Jawahar defrauded 64 victims, including the Kansas City Chiefs tight end.
articles.body:
Travis Kelce was identified as one of the victims of a Ponzi scheme that moved more than $35 million through the investment firm Swiftarc Capital LLC.

The Kansas City Chiefs player's name appeared on Tuesday, September 15, during the sentencing of Siddharth Jawahar, who was sentenced by St. Louis federal judge Zachary Bluestone to 11 years in prison and to the payment of $31.35 million in compensation to the victims.

His relationship with the firm had already come to light in 2021, when Forbes included him among the athletes who had invested in a fund linked to Swiftarc.

Jawahar, 38, and founder of Swiftarc Capital , began in 2015 that his clients' money would be concentrated in an investment related to Philip Morris Pakistan. According to the United States Department of Justice, he ended up placing 99% of his clients' funds in that asset.

When its value fell, Jawahar concealed the losses and continued telling investors that his positions were generating profits. Instead, he falsely told them that their investments were making money.

The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of Missouri stated that, between July 2016 and December 2023, Jawahar received more than $35 million from investors in his company, Swiftarc Capital LLC , but invested only about $10 million of that amount.

The court documents cited by the prosecution describe trips on private planes, stays at luxury hotels, apartments in New York and Austin, private club fees, clothing purchases, and meals at expensive restaurants. The investigation also concluded that Jawahar tried to obstruct the process after being charged: prosecutors argued that he attempted to influence a victim's testimony, lied about his immigration status, and tried to have evidence deleted from his phone.

Kelce, among the 64 affected

The Department of Justice counted 64 victims in the case. Kelce was not the only athlete linked to Swiftarc: a report published by Forbes in 2021 had also identified NBA players Gary Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr., and Mason Plumlee as investors. The amounts that any of them lost as a result of the fraud have not been reported, but it is possible that they also fell for the scam.

Robert Patrick, spokesperson for the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of Missouri, stated that there were a total of 64 victims, but declined to answer questions about Kelce's connection to the case.

Jawahar was formally charged by a grand jury in 2023 and pleaded guilty in January to three counts of wire fraud.

The defense of Jawahar acknowledged the seriousness of the facts after the sentencing. His lawyer, Doug Passon, argued that his client had committed "very wrong things" and serious crimes, and noted that he had taken responsibility. The prosecution, for its part, highlighted the duration of the fraud and the losses caused to investors as determining factors in the sentence.

The exact amount Kelce allocated to Swiftarc and the money he may have lost have not been made public. The player remains with the Kansas City Chiefs after beginning his fourteenth NFL season with a 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos.

articles.title: Travis Kelce practically admits refs turned blind eye in Chiefs win over Broncos
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs tight end absolutely got away with one on Patrick Mahomes' rushing touchdown.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs tight end absolutely got away with one on Patrick Mahomes' rushing touchdown.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs got off to the best possible start in Week 1 . Taking the national stage for Monday Night Football , Andy Reid 's team dismantled the Denver Broncos , a Super Bowl contender in many analysts' eyes.

The Chiefs defense and running back Kenneth Walker were the stars of the show, but it was extremely encouraging that Patrick Mahomes didn't appear hindered by the knee injury he suffered near the tail end of last season. In fact, he rushed seven times in total and even scrambled for a 15-yard touchdown .

Travis Kelce clearly committed a holding penalty that wasn't called on Patrick Mahomes' rushing touchdown

That touchdown was quite controversial, though. Mahomes had a different rushing touchdown, a five-yarder, called back on the previous play due to a holding penalty by left tackle Kahlil Benson . Then, on the touchdown that counted, tight end Travis Kelce quite clearly committed a holding penalty on Broncos safety Talanoa Hufanga , who was getting into position to tackle Mahomes before he reached the end zone.

Kelce got away with it, although social media went crazy over the missed call - once again fueling conspiracy theories. Even Kelce himself couldn't help but admit the refs totally missed it .

It was definitely a questionable play. That's one of those where you get up slowly like, 'please don't be any laundry on the field'. Had the man up by his neck. Can't do it. Can't do it. Almost cost us. And to be honest, that would've been Pat Mahomes' second rushing touchdown called back in two plays... And that would've taken us out of the red zone.

Travis and his brother Jason Kelce couldn't help but laugh at the Chiefs tight end outright admitting he benefitted greatly from the refs turning a blind eye to a clear hold. Fans probably won't think it's that funny, though.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes congratulates Patrick on his birthday with a message dedicated to his family
articles.standfirst: The wife of the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback posted several photos of the celebration on Instagram and highlighted the way Mahomes takes care of his family.
articles.summary: The wife of the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback posted several photos of the celebration on Instagram and highlighted the way Mahomes takes care of his family.
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes took advantage of Patrick Mahomes' birthday to dedicate a message to him on social media. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback turned 30 on September 17, 2025, and received a birthday greeting from his wife accompanied by several photographs from the celebration.

'"!! Happy 30th birthday!!! You are very special to us, and we love you forever and beyond!” , Brittany wrote on Instagram. In the same post, she highlighted the way Patrick relates to his family and added: “The way you love us is so comforting, and the way you live life is so inspiring! Keep being YOU".'

Brittany's message to Patrick

The post was accompanied by images from the quarterback's birthday. Among them were photos of the celebration and a snapshot showing an ice sculpture dedicated to Mahomes .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes tops the list of the NFL's highest-paid players: Here's the ranking
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs star will make around $86 million in the 2026 NFL season.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs star will make around $86 million in the 2026 NFL season.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes remains the highest-paid player in the NFL with projected earnings of $86 million as the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback combines $56m in football earnings with an estimated $30m from endorsements and other business ventures.

His commercial portfolio includes long-running partnerships with Adidas , Hublot and State Farm , helping him maintain a substantial lead in projected off-field earnings. His contract with Kansas City also underpins his place among the league’s biggest earners.

Mahomes tops Forbes ’ ranking, published September 13, for the second consecutive year, as the publication projects the NFL ’s 10 highest-paid players will earn a combined $598 million before taxes and agent fees—and all 10 are quarterbacks.

The Chiefs extended Mahomes ’ deal in June 2026, adding two seasons and keeping him under contract through 2033, and the revised package is reported to include $397 million in guaranteed money.

His earnings come as he continues to deliver on the field after he opened the Chiefs ’ game against their AFC Wes t rival, the Denver Broncos, with a rushing touchdown, helping set the tone in a 31-10 victory in Week 1.

Mahomes ’ early rushing touchdown against Denver demonstrated just how dangerous he is beyond passing opportunities, proving he is capable of using his legs and it’s no surprise most of the quarterbacks on the list are dual threats.

Kenneth Walker III stole the headlines on the night as the running back carried for almost 200 yards but part of why he had so much space is because of Mahomes ’ arm talent, highlighting the QB’s value beyond tangible statistics.

How do they rank behind Patrick Mahomes?

Josh Allen follows Mahomes with projected earnings of $73 million, made up of $55 million in football earnings and $18 million off the field. He is entering the second year of his six-year, $330 million contract with the Buffalo Bills , signed in March 2025.

Allen ’s endorsements include Delta Air Lines , New Era and Pizza Hut . He also moved from Nike to New Balance in 2025 and launched Out of Pocket Studios on September 1, 2026, taking on the roles of CEO and executive producer.

Jared Goff is third with an estimated $60 million: $55 million from football and $5 million from outside ventures. The Detroit Lions quarterback signed a four-year, $212 million extension in 2024, with reported guarantees including $113 million fully guaranteed.

Goff ’s commercial partners include Ford Motor , Little Caesars , Panini , Topps , Old Spice , Procter & Gamble , Netflix , Fanatics and Abercrombie & Fitch .

The remainder of Forbes ’ Top 10 are Jalen Hurts ( Philadelphia Eagles ), Tua Tagovailoa ( Atlanta Falcons ), Jordan Love ( Green Bay Packers ), Lamar Jackson ( Baltimore Ravens ), Baker Mayfield ( Tampa Bay Buccaneers ), Dak Prescott ( Dallas Cowboys ) and Daniel Jones ( Indianapolis Colts ).

articles.title: Private Jets, Gucci, and Prada: Inside the wild spending spree of Travis Kelce's scammer
articles.standfirst: Kelce was among the investors caught in Siddharth Jawahar’s multimillion-dollar ponzi scheme.
articles.summary: Kelce was among the investors caught in Siddharth Jawahar’s multimillion-dollar ponzi scheme.
articles.body:
Scammer Siddharth Jawahar allegedly turned millions of dollars raised from investors such as Travis Kelce into the lifestyle of his dreams. The spending came from a scheme that raised more than $35 million from defrauded investors between 2016 and 2023, whilst prosecutors said Jawahar invested around $10 million.

As per TMZ, he used much of the remaining money to finance his personal lifestyle which includes purchases at Gucci , Louis Vuitton , Prada , Neiman Marcus , Bloomingdale’s and other high-end retailers. Prosecutors also said Jawahar spent heavily on luxury apartments in New York and Texas after scamming Kelce among others, although the amount the Kansas City Chiefs star allegedly lost has not been disclosed. The revelation of the scam came at a bad time for the 36-year-old football star, who had hoped to be celebrating his first win of the 2026 NFL star with the Chiefs after beating the Denver Broncos 31-10. Whilst Kenneth Walker III stole the headlines and Patrick Mahomes scored a rushing touchdown, Kelce set history on the night by moving into second for receptions by a tight end by gaining 54 yards after a catch to surpass Jason Witten . Kelce needed 45 yards to claim the record and finished the night with three catches for 71 yards to take his career haul up to 13,073 yards - but seems unlikely to catch Tony Gonzalez as the record holder, who has 15,127 yards.

How did Siddharth Jawahar conduct his scam on Kelce?

Jawahar operated Swiftarc Capital LLC , where prosecutors said he concentrated roughly 99% of client capital in a single stock, Philip Morris Pakistan , but when that investment suffered losses, he allegedly concealed the damage from clients. Authorities said the convict issued falsified statements and used money from newer investors to make payments to earlier clients, and he also controlled 17 additional entities that prosecutors said were used as part of the scheme. The allegations extended beyond the investment losses. Prosecutors accused Jawahar of attempting to obstruct the investigation after his 2023 indictment by coaching a victim to provide a favorable statement to the FBI . The Department of Justice (DOJ) also said Jawahar asked his sister to remotely wipe his iPhone in an effort to conceal evidence as he eventually pleaded guilty to three counts of wire fraud in January 2026. He was sentenced to 11 years in federal prison and ordered to pay $31.35 million in restitution to his victims. At sentencing, Judge Zachary Bluestone said Jawahar had “weaponized” investors’ trust and caused “massive” losses. Court documents and the DOJ indicate he could also face immigration consequences following his conviction. Prosecutors had previously that he presented a flight risk because of his financial resources. His alleged spending included $164,000 toward a luxury New York apartment and another $363,000 toward an apartment in Texas as the lavish purchases now form part of the picture prosecutors presented of a fraud that stretched across several years.

articles.title: NFL WAGs steal the spotlight: Kelly Stafford trolls Brittany Mahomes over her latest postgame role with Patrick
articles.standfirst: Brittany was present as the Kansas City Chiefs defeated the Denver Broncos in Week 1.
articles.summary: Brittany was present as the Kansas City Chiefs defeated the Denver Broncos in Week 1.
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes was in the stands as the Kansas City Chiefs opened their season with a convincing 31-10 victory over the Denver Broncos , backing husband Patrick as he returned to action after a lengthy knee recovery. The Chiefs quarterback looked comfortable in his return, while Brittany offered fans a glimpse behind the scenes with an Instagram carousel featuring her game-day outfit and several personal moments shared with her husband.

One image, however, immediately stood out. Brittany was photographed holding Patrick' s dental retainer while the quarterback spoke with reporters after the game, creating an unexpectedly funny snapshot from the Chiefs ' opening night. And the Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford 's wife, Kelly , spotted the unusual moment and couldn't resist commenting. Her four-word response quickly became one of the most talked-about reactions beneath the post. "Not the retainer holder,” Kelly wrote, poking fun at Brittany 's unexpected postgame responsibility and giving followers a lighthearted moment between two prominent NFL families. Brittany 's game-day look also attracted attention, with the Sports Illustrated model wearing a coordinated dark-denim outfit that included a long-sleeved top, matching trousers, a white shoulder bag and pointed-toe heels.

Rams-Chiefs showdown could add extra meaning to Kelly and Brittany's rivalry

While Brittany 's post centered on life around Patrick , the quarterback had plenty to celebrate himself as Mahomes threw for 184 yards and two touchdowns. One of his two scores came on the ground as he showed little hesitation racing into the end zone with his surgically repaired left knee after an ACL and LCL injury. The Chiefs also received a major boost from Kenneth Walker , who delivered an explosive debut after joining Kansas City . He rushed 23 times for 173 yards and two touchdowns, giving Mahomes valuable support in the season opener. Walker produced 89 rushing yards on 14 first-half carries alone, while also contributing as a receiver. His performance helped his new team control the game and take some pressure away from Mahomes during his return. But the playful exchange with Brittany could have another chapter when the Chiefs and Rams meet on December 3 in Week 13, with the matchup potentially carrying significant postseason consequences for both the AFC West and NFC West races. By then, every victory could matter heavily in the NFL Playoff picture, making the meeting more than an opportunity for Mahomes and Stafford to face off on the field in the race for the Super Bowl . Until that matchup arrives, Kelly 's comment has given fans a memorable piece of off-field banter, while Brittany 's retainer-holding cameo has become an unlikely highlight from the Chiefs ' opening-night celebrations.

articles.title: Lawyers explain how Travis Kelce fell victim to the Ponzi scheme
articles.standfirst: A $35 million Ponzi scheme has put Travis Kelce in the spotlight.
articles.summary: A $35 million Ponzi scheme has put Travis Kelce in the spotlight.
articles.body:
Travis Kelce was named in federal court documents as one of the victims of a $35 million Ponzi scheme , just as the man behind the fraud received a sentence of more than a decade in prison.

U.S. District Judge Zachary M. Bluestone in St. Louis sentenced Siddharth Jawahar to 11 years in prison and ordered him to pay $31.35 million in restitution to the victims, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Missouri .

Prosecutors included the Kansas City Chiefs tight end among the list of victims. The exact amount Kelce may have lost was not disclosed, and there is no allegation that he committed any wrongdoing or participated in illegal activity.

Why high-profile athletes like Travis Kelce can become targets of financial fraud

The case has once again highlighted how wealthy, high-profile investors can become targets of these schemes—especially when the key ingredient is trust.

Texas securities regulators canceled the registration of Swiftarc Capital in June 2022 and ordered Jawahar to stop his fraudulent practices. According to mergers-and-acquisitions attorney Kevin Henderson , that warning was public and available to anyone who researched the entrepreneur’s background.

“It wasn’t sealed or confidential. It was a public enforcement order posted on a state agency website, free to anyone who typed his name into a search box,” Henderson explained while analyzing how the fraud was able to continue for so long.

According to the federal indictment, the scheme operated for another 18 months by using money from new investors to cover obligations to earlier ones—a classic hallmark of Ponzi schemes.

Henderson noted that these scams often succeed because they arrive through people or circles that feel trustworthy.

“Affinity fraud gets otherwise smart but unsuspecting people because it comes from trusted sources,” he wrote. “A teammate, a church member, your mastermind. Somebody you trust vouches for the deal and that vouch replaces due diligence.”

Attorney Eric Pacifici , known online as SMB Attorney, reviewed the timeline of the case and summed it up in one word: greed.

Jawahar pleaded guilty in January 2026 to three counts of wire fraud, two years after a St. Louis grand jury indictment led to his arrest in Miami. Prosecutors said he later tried to influence a victim in connection with an FBI interview and asked his sister to remotely delete information from his phone.

Judge Bluestone described the losses as “enormous” and said Jawahar had “weaponized” the trust his victims placed in him.

Kelce has not commented publicly on the case. The exact amount he may have invested and which specific Swiftarc fund was involved remain outside the public record, even after the sentence that closed the criminal case against Jawahar.

The connection between Travis Kelce and Jawahar’s scheme

The link between Kelce and Jawahar dates back several years before the sentencing. A 2021 Forbes report on NBA player Gary Harris named Kelce, Dallas Mavericks guard Tim Hardaway Jr., and Detroit Pistons center Mason Plumlee as investors in the Swiftarc Venture Labs Fund alongside Harris.

Harris said he learned of the fund through Plumlee, his former Denver Nuggets teammate, before developing a direct relationship with Jawahar.

That detail was one of the points Henderson highlighted after the sentencing. According to the attorney, Swiftarc’s own documents stated that no single investment should exceed 12% of the fund’s capital.

Jawahar allegedly ignored that limit and concentrated an excessive portion of the assets in one holding: roughly 54% of the fund in a single stock by 2015 and as much as 99% by 2019 .

The company was Philip Morris Pakistan, an illiquid stock that, according to Henderson, Jawahar reported to investors at a value of 4,000 rupees per share even as its actual price had fallen to 541 rupees by May 2022 .

Henderson said Jawahar presented the valuation “reporting book value to investors as if it came from somewhere independent,” when in reality the figures did not reflect the true condition of the asset.

articles.title: Travis Kelce reveals how Taylor Swift caught him off guard during a conversation with Tom Cruise
articles.standfirst: Kelce and Swift got married this past July, during Kelce's offseason with the Chiefs
articles.summary: Kelce and Swift got married this past July, during Kelce's offseason with the Chiefs
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs opened the 2026 NFL campaign with a resounding statement, cruising to a dominant 31–10 victory that highlighted their status as perennial championship contenders.

The home opener featured the much-anticipated return of star quarterback Patrick Mahomes from injury, and true to form, his most trusted target remained 36-year-old veteran tight end Travis Kelce , who picked up right where he left off by hauling in 3 receptions for 71 yards , including a explosive 59-yard strike.

The offensive outburst was further propelled by new backfield weapon Kenneth Walker III , who wreaked havoc on the ground. Yet, amid the gridiron action, the most talked-about scene unfolded in a luxury suite at Arrowhead Stadium , where Hollywood icon Tom Cruise and pop superstar Taylor Swift shared a private box to take in the spectacle.

Taylor Swift’s Surprising Football IQ Leaves Travis and Tom Cruis Impressed

During a recent appearance on Travis Kelce’s New Heights podcast , Hollywood superstar Tom Cruise made it clear he holds immense respect for both the All-Pro tight end and his wife, Taylor Swift . Chatting with the couple, Cruise recalled sharing time in the Arrowhead Stadium luxury box, noting that Swift candidly recounted their initial 2023 courtship and early football conversations.

According to Cruise, the Grammy-winning singer jokingly asked him about what it was like for players physically colliding on the gridiron, asking, "What was it like, you two, like, playing against, like hitting each other?"

Laughing at the memory on the podcast, Kelce admitted he had to check his partner's framing, joking that playing football feels less like a traditional sport and more like stepping into a boxing ring, prompting him to playfully respond, "Like, sweetie, what the heck?"

Kelce marveled during the episode that his wife has gone from asking basic introductory questions to possessing a masterclass-level understanding of the game, leaving him completely flabbergasted on Sundays.

"Now she knows everything," Kelce shared. "She sees the flags coming in . Like, ‘Oh, that might be a defensive hold.’ Like, ‘What’d you say, sweetie?’ She’s like, ‘That’s encroachment.’ I’m like, ‘You know what that is?’ She’s on it now. She got fully engulfed in it."

With the Chiefs firing on all cylinders, the team prepares for a high-stakes Sunday Night Football matchup at home against the Indianapolis Colts , followed by consecutive road trips to face Miami and Las Vegas.

Given their explosive opening-week dominance, Kansas City boasts a legitimate path toward cruising into their Week 5 bye with an unblemished record intact.

articles.title: The White House drags Taylor Swift into the nightmare of Travis Kelce's Ponzi scheme and sparks fans' fury
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs star was identified as a victim of a $35 million fraud scheme.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs star was identified as a victim of a $35 million fraud scheme.
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce has been pulled into a political spotlight after The White House referenced his status as a victim of a multimillion-dollar fraud scheme in a post promoting its work against financial crime. Kelce was among 64 victims of Siddharth Jawahar ’s $35 million Ponzi scheme, although prosecutors have not disclosed how much the Kansas City Chiefs tight end invested or ultimately lost.

But nonetheless, after Jawahar was sentenced to 11 years in prison whilst facing the risk of deportation, The White House account took the chance to weigh in via social media. “This is why we do what we do,” The White House wrote via X.com, formerly Twitter. “Seems like a good time to re-up the work of the White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud.” The post then added: “Oh and it looks like the next draft pick to join the Task Force is @tkelce!” Jawahar pleaded guilty to three counts of wire fraud after prosecutors said he collected more than $35 million through Swiftarc Capital between 2016 and 2023. Only about $10 million was actually invested, prosecutors said. The remaining funds were used to repay investors and finance what authorities described as an extravagant lifestyle and Jawahar was also ordered to pay $31.35 million in restitution. Prosecutors said his spending included private jets, luxury accommodations, expensive restaurants and memberships at private clubs, but Kelce ’s investment amount and the timing of his involvement have not been disclosed. However, his name was mentioned during Jawahar ’s sentencing, but prosecutors did not provide any further details about the three-time Super Bowl winning NFL star’s losses.

Not the first time Trump’s Administration has struck close to Kelce

Kelce and Taylor Swift have previously been drawn into political commentary involving President Donald Trump after the popstar endorsed Kamala Harris during the 2024 presidential campaign. A strongly worded post endorsing the Democratic candidate, who eventually lost the election in November that year, prompted an equally strong response from the Republican ’s victorious Trump . The 80-year-old said he was “not a fan of Taylor Swift” in September 2024 and later wrote that he “hated” the singer – although he said he liked Kelce , but suggesting the Chiefs star might be liberal and may dislike the POTUS . The backlash to the 36-year-old singer then continued around the 2025 Super Bowl , when Swift was booed after appearing on the stadium screen as Trump later addressed the reaction on Truth Social. "The only one that had a tougher night than the Kansas City Chiefs,” Trump posted to Truth Social. “Was Taylor Swift. She got BOOED out of the Stadium. MAGA is very unforgiving!" The latest White House post places Kelce back into the crosshairs of the Republican administration, although he got off this time with just a light-hearted joke.

articles.title: 'Until the Wheels Fall Off': Travis Kelce dispels retirement rumors and reveals Taylor Swift's crucial role in his future
articles.standfirst: Could Kelce continue with the Kansas City Chiefs beyond the 2026 NFL season?
articles.summary: Could Kelce continue with the Kansas City Chiefs beyond the 2026 NFL season?
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce entered the 2026 NFL season with retirement questions following him, but the Kansas City Chiefs star has made his intentions clear after another impressive milestone.

The 36-year-old tight end had been linked with retirement after the 2025 campaign, only to return for another season under a contract structured to give both sides flexibility beyond 2026.

Kelce was direct when asked about his future by ESPN 's Chris Berman .

“I don’t want to let this thing go,” Kelce said. “I want to keep playing until the wheels fall off.

“I still have the desire to go out there and compete, and I still think I can compete at a high level.

“I love this game so much that I’m not ready to go into that next phase yet."

While Kelce has spoken openly about wanting to continue playing, his contract gives the Chiefs a clear decision point after the season. The deal carries $12 million in fully guaranteed compensation for 2026.

The agreement uses two void years for salary-cap purposes, reducing his 2026 cap hit to roughly $4.9 million while creating a June 2027 deadline that will determine whether the arrangement continues.

That structure leaves the future open rather than guaranteeing three more seasons in Kansas City . If he remains healthy and productive, another chapter is possible, but retirement remains an option.

For now, his message is straightforward: he is not preparing to leave the game. After helping the Chiefs open the season with a statement victory, Kelce still wants to see how far he can go.

Kelce hints he can’t claim tight end receiving record

For now, Kelce backed his confidence about his talent on the field by catching three passes for 71 yards as Kansas City cruised to a 31-10 victory, and his biggest contribution also delivered another piece of history.

A 59-yard reception from Patrick Mahomes i n the third quarter pushed him beyond Jason Witten and into second place on the all-time receiving-yardage list for tight ends.

He entered the game needing 45 yards to pass Witten 's 13,046. He finished with 13,073 career receiving yards, leaving only the great Tony Gonzalez ahead of him.

Gonzalez finished his career with 15,127 receiving yards, leaving Kelce 2,054 yards behind the longtime Chiefs star but he knows closing that gap would require a remarkable amount of longevity.

The veteran joked about the challenge on the New Heights podcast, acknowledging that catching Gonzalez would mean extending his career considerably beyond the season ahead.

“I’ll have to just play another five years to catch Tony,” Kelce joked, highlighting the enormous distance between his current total and the all-time record.

The milestone nevertheless bolstered his place among the most productive tight ends in NFL history.

articles.title: The love story of Patrick and Brittany Mahomes who went from a small town to dominating the Super Bowl
articles.standfirst: From teenage sweethearts in Whitehouse, Texas, to marriage, three children and multiple Super Bowl celebrations, Patrick and Brittany Mahomes have built their lives alongside one another
articles.summary: From teenage sweethearts in Whitehouse, Texas, to marriage, three children and multiple Super Bowl celebrations, Patrick and Brittany Mahomes have built their lives alongside one another
articles.body:
Long before Patrick Mahomes became one of the NFL's most recognizable quarterbacks, he was a teenager in Whitehouse, Texas, sharing school hallways with Brittany Matthews .

Their relationship began when they were students at Whitehouse High School in 2012, years before Patrick would be drafted by the Kansas City Chiefs and turn into a Super Bowl-winning quarterback.

The two were both athletes, although they followed different paths. Patrick developed into a standout multi-sport player, competing in football, baseball and basketball, while Brittany established herself as a talented soccer player.

Their relationship survived the transition from high school into college, with Patrick attending Texas Tech and Brittany playing soccer at the University of Texas at Tyler.

That period was important because Patrick's professional future was still uncertain. He eventually chose football over baseball and entered the 2017 NFL Draft, where Kansas City selected him 10th overall.

The Chiefs ' decision ultimately changed the course of both his career and the family's future.

Brittany , meanwhile, continued pursuing soccer and later played professionally in Iceland before developing her own fitness business.

She also became involved in the Kansas City Current , the National Women's Soccer League club she co-founded with Patrick as an ownership group member.

Patrick's rise in Kansas City was rapid. He became the Chiefs ' starting quarterback in 2018 and won the NFL MVP award in his first season as a starter.

A year later, Kansas City reached Super Bowl LIV, where Mahomes led the Chiefs past the San Francisco 49ers to secure his first championship.

Brittany was there throughout the transformation from promising young quarterback to NFL superstar.

The relationship reached another major milestone in September 2020, when Patrick proposed to Brittany at Arrowhead Stadium shortly after the Chiefs' Super Bowl ring ceremony.

By then, the couple had already spent roughly eight years together. Their family soon began to grow as well.

From teenage romance to a family celebrating Super Bowl victories

Patrick and Brittany welcomed their first child, daughter Sterling Skye, in February 2021. Sterling later played a special role in her parents' wedding when Patrick and Brittany married in Maui, Hawaii, on March 12, 2022.

Their daughter served as part of the ceremony, while Patrick's brother Jackson was his best man and Travis Kelce was among the wedding party.

The timing of their marriage also coincided with one of the most successful stretches of Patrick's NFL career.

The Chiefs won Super Bowl LVII against the Philadelphia Eagles following the 2022 season, giving Mahomes his second championship.

Brittany and Sterling joined him on the field after the victory, becoming part of the familiar family celebrations that followed Kansas City's biggest wins.

Later that year, the couple welcomed their second child, Patrick "Bronze" Lavon Mahomes III , in November 2022. Their third child, daughter Golden Raye , arrived in January 2025.

The family of five has since become a regular presence around Chiefs games, training camp and other major moments in Patrick's career.

The Chiefs then produced another championship season. Kansas City defeated the San Francisco 49ers in Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024, making Mahomes a three-time Super Bowl champion. Brittany and the children again celebrated with him on the field after the victory.

Their story has continued beyond the football field. Patrick and Brittany have appeared together at sporting and entertainment events, while Brittany has built a public profile of her own through fitness, soccer and business ventures.

Patrick has also repeatedly spoken about the importance of family as he navigates the demands of being an NFL quarterback.

That support was particularly visible during his recovery from a serious knee injury suffered late in the 2025 season. When Mahomes returned for Kansas City's 2026 season opener against Denver on September 14, Brittany was waiting for him on the sideline.

The Chiefs won 31-10, and the couple shared a kiss following his return to action.

The family has also continued to grow away from football. In August 2026, Mahomes said that even during the intensity of training camp, he makes a point of staying connected with Brittany.

He described family, friends, teammates and his foundation work as important parts of keeping perspective beyond football.

From two teenagers at Whitehouse High School to a married couple raising three children while Patrick competes for the Chiefs, the Mahomes story has unfolded alongside one of the NFL's defining modern dynasties.

Their relationship began before the trophies, contracts and international fame, and Brittany has remained part of Patrick's journey through the highs, setbacks and championship celebrations.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes sends a heartfelt message of condolence after the wife of former Chiefs star JuJu Smith-Schuster announced she had suffered a miscarriage
articles.standfirst: Laura Smith-Schuster opened up about two pregnancy losses and her fertility journey
articles.summary: Laura Smith-Schuster opened up about two pregnancy losses and her fertility journey
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes has offered a message of support to Laura Smith-Schuster after the wife of JuJu Smith-Schuster publicly shared the deeply personal story of two pregnancy losses.

Laura opened up about her fertility journey on Instagram, describing the emotional toll of multiple procedures, a failed IVF attempt and, ultimately, back-to-back miscarriages.

Her post prompted messages from people within the NFL community, including Brittany, who has remained close to many members of the Kansas City Chiefs family.

Laura explained that her first pregnancy loss came after she and JuJu learned they were expecting in July 2025. At an eight-week ultrasound, they received devastating news.

“And in July 2025, I found out I was pregnant,” Laura said on Instagram ..

“We were so happy and felt so blessed. But at our eight-week ultrasound, there was no heartbeat. I had never felt a pain like that before, and I felt truly heartbroken. Once again, we had to shift our focus and pour everything we had into each other and into the things that brought us joy, finding so much faith and so many little things to be grateful for along the way.”

Laura said the couple subsequently tried to concentrate on their lives together and their faith. She described several major personal milestones before the family received another pregnancy announcement.

“We bought a house, I got baptized for the first time in my life, and one month later, we found out we were pregnant again. But no one really tells you how fleeting that happiness can feel after a miscarriage. You can be so overjoyed while also carrying this deep feel right alongside it. And unfortunately, at five weeks, I miscarried again. We clung to our faith and helped each other through another heartbreaking loss.”

The Smith-Schusters ' story has also attracted attention because of their connection to the Chiefs community. JuJu spent the 2022 season in Kansas City, where he played an important role on the team's offense during its Super Bowl LVII championship campaign.

The veteran receiver later returned to Kansas City before signing with the New York Giants in June 2026. New York's official announcement noted that Smith-Schuster had accumulated 481 receptions, 5,624 receiving yards and 33 touchdowns over his first nine NFL seasons.

The Giants subsequently released Smith-Schuster on August 18, meaning his time on the team's roster was brief.

Brittany Mahomes joins NFL community in supporting Laura

The connection between the Smith-Schusters and Mahomes family extends beyond football.

Laura and JuJu began their relationship in January 2023, when Smith-Schuster was still playing for Kansas City. He later proposed to her in September of that year during a trip to Nantucket. The couple eventually married at the Ritz-Carlton in Laguna Niguel, California, on July 10, 2026, surrounded by friends and family.

Their wedding also brought together several familiar faces from Smith-Schuster's Chiefs years, including Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce , according to the information shared by Laura.

Now, rather than celebrating a wedding, members of that same circle have rallied around the couple during a painful chapter.

Brittany Mahomes responded directly to Laura's Instagram post with a message of encouragement.

“Sending so many prayers and so much love y’all’s way! Y’all got this,” she wrote.

JuJu also responded publicly, emphasizing the role of faith in helping the couple process what happened.

“Truly a blessing, and God is so faithful! Journey with you 🤎 love you pookie you the best,” JuJu wrote.

Other NFL families added their own messages. Maureen Remigio, wife of Chiefs receiver Nikko Remigio, commented: “Your story is so powerful, and I just know the best is coming ♥️,” while Hilary Trubisky, wife of Titans quarterback Mitchell Trubisky, wrote, “Your rainbow baby is coming soon 🙏♥️ sending love and prayers.”

Parker Elisabeth Henry , wife of Patriots tight end Hunter Henry , also responded: “Laura, your story is going to inspire so many!! Praying for you guys ❤️,” she commented.

Laura's decision to discuss her experience has therefore brought a wave of support from several NFL families, while also highlighting the private struggles that can exist behind the public lives of professional athletes and their families.

For Laura and JuJu, the focus now appears to be on moving through the loss together. Their messages emphasize faith, partnership and gratitude, while the response from friends and fellow NFL families has shown that the couple has a wider support network around them during an exceptionally difficult period.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes' most emotional confession about the struggles in his life
articles.standfirst: Mahomes looks back on the family moment behind his childhood memories
articles.summary: Mahomes looks back on the family moment behind his childhood memories
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes has spent much of his adult life under the brightest spotlight in American sports, but a recent story from his childhood offered a surprisingly personal glimpse into the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback behind the superstar image.

With Kansas City preparing for its Week 2 meeting with the Indianapolis Colts, Mahomes appeared on 96.5 The Fan with Carrington Harrison and found himself reminiscing about an era long before NFL success and the enormous attention that now surrounds him.

The conversation turned to ringtones, prompting Mahomes to recall his fascination with Motorola Razr phones as a youngster. He admitted he had accumulated plenty of ringtones and eventually got into trouble with his mother, Randi Mahomes , after spending too much money on them.

“I had a lot of them,” said Mahomes . “I can’t even rememeber which ones, but I mean that was like the thing back in the day.

“You had the Razr phone, and you’d get all the ringtones and stuff like that. And I forgot how much they were, but my mom got mad at me one time for buying too many ringtones. I remember that and being in trouble for that.”

The story might sound lighthearted, but it offered a rare reminder of how different Mahomes ' life once looked.

From childhood memories to an NFL comeback

Mahomes ' latest reflections also come as he continues adjusting to life after a major knee injury. After tearing his ACL and LCL in December, he returned to action in Kansas City's season opener against Denver and helped the Chiefs secure a 31-10 victory.

The quarterback completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards, two touchdowns and an interception. He also ran for 23 yards and scored on a 15-yard touchdown, providing an early indication that his mobility had returned despite the long recovery process.

However, Mahomes acknowledged that there was still work to do in the Chiefs' passing game. His numbers weren't at the level fans have become accustomed to seeing from the three-time Super Bowl MVP, and Kansas City relied heavily on its running game during the victory.

Speaking after the opener, he explained that his surgically repaired leg was “the least of my worries,” noting that other parts of his body were sore because he hadn't played football for so long.

“Yeah, I feel normal,” Mahomes said. “Actually, I mean, it’s like a blessing and curse. You get sore everywhere else because you haven’t played football in so long. And so, the leg is like the least of my worries right now.

“So, I’m just excited to be out there and playing. At the end of the day, you don’t know until you get out there and play, and I was able to go out there and play, and I feel good today.”

Now, with the Colts awaiting Kansas City in Week 2, Mahomes is preparing for another important step in his comeback.

Speaking after the opener, he explained that his surgically repaired leg was “the least of my worries,” noting that other parts of his body were sore because he hadn't played football for so long.

“Yeah, I feel normal,” Mahomes said. “Actually, I mean, it’s like a blessing and curse. You get sore everywhere else because you haven’t played football in so long. And so, the leg is like the least of my worries right now.
“So, I’m just excited to be out there and playing. At the end of the day, you don’t know until you get out there and play, and I was able to go out there and play, and I feel good today.”
Now, with the Colts awaiting Kansas City in Week 2, Mahomes is preparing for another important step in his comeback.

articles.title: Chiefs Kenneth Walker III fined by NFL after historic debut but revealing why the price was worth it
articles.standfirst: In his debut with the Chiefs, Walker played a key role in their victory over the Broncos, scoring two touchdowns
articles.summary: In his debut with the Chiefs, Walker played a key role in their victory over the Broncos, scoring two touchdowns
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs started the season in an excellent way by defeating their top rivals in the AFC West , the Denver Broncos, by a score of 31-10 . The game brought the highly anticipated return of Patrick Mahomes , who was stepping back onto the gridiron after suffering a devastating season-ending injury a year ago.

While the superstar quarterback looked solid, throwing for 184 passing yards alongside two touchdown passes and a rushing score, his comeback was surprisingly overshadowed by the spectacular debut of off-season acquisition Kenneth Walker III .

The reigning Super Bowl MVP exploded for a career-best 173 rushing yards and 191 total yards from scrimmage , finding the end zone twice and setting the mark for the most rushing yards in a single game for Kansas City since Mahomes took over the offense in 2018.

The Openly Accepted Fine from the NFL to Walker lll

During the Monday Night Football showdown against Denver, Walker carved his name into franchise lore while treating a devoted supporter to an unforgettable memory, though it came directly at the expense of his own personal bank account.

After crossing the goal line for his second touchdown of the evening on a creative single-wing scheme dubbed the "Heisman," the star running back celebrated by launching the match ball straight into the stadium stands .

Revealing the aftermath on his official TikTok account , Walker acknowledged that league headquarters handed down a standard $8,357 fine (commonly cited as an $8K penalty) for violating the strict NFL Sportsmanship policy regarding unauthorized use of game balls.

For a player who secured a lucrative three-year, $43.05 million contract with Kansas City during the offseason, carrying an average annual salary of $14.35 million , the financial reprimand is merely a drop in the bucket.

First-time violations under this specific unsportsmanlike tier carry baseline penalties starting around $8,357 , while repeat infractions escalate to $14,328 .

Brushing off the sanction with a smile, Walker emphasized that the sheer joy illuminated on the face of the fortunate fan who hauled in the souvenir made the expense entirely worthwhile.

Delivering a lifetime memory alongside his dominant gridiron output quickly earned him AFC Offensive Player of the Week accolades, signaling that his electrifying chapter in Kansas City is only just beginning.

articles.title: This is the luxurious restaurant where Patrick Mahomes celebrated with Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback spent the night with his wife Brittany, Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift at a restaurant that also has a direct connection to the Kansas City world.
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback spent the night with his wife Brittany, Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift at a restaurant that also has a direct connection to the Kansas City world.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes had a night to celebrate in Kansas City, and he didn't do it alone . On Friday, September 18, the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback was spotted with his wife, Brittany Mahomes, as well as Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift, during a dinner that drew attention after videos recorded by people inside the restaurant began circulating.

A night with several reasons to celebrate

The dinner came just one day after Patrick Mahomes' birthday, which he celebrated on September 17 . But that wasn't the only reason that made the night special.

The gathering also took place just around the first anniversary of 1587 Prime, a restaurant created by Mahomes and Kelce.

And there was a third reason. Just days earlier, the Chiefs had opened the regular season with a dominant 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos , in a game in which Kenneth Walker III rushed for 173 yards.

Where did the dinner take place?

The group went to 1587 Prime, a luxury steakhouse located in Kansas City's Crossroads Arts District , inside the Loews Kansas City Hotel at 1500 Baltimore Ave.

The restaurant has a particularly close connection to Mahomes and Kelce, as both are part of the project alongside Noble 33. Its concept was designed to compete at the highest level of steakhouses, but the food isn't the only thing meant to grab attention .

From the moment guests arrive, the decor makes references to the world of football and the atmosphere surrounding the Chiefs.

A restaurant designed as an experience

The experience at 1587 Prime begins with a tunnel inspired by the players' entrance onto the field. From there, the space opens into an interior featuring walnut wood, dramatic lighting and custom artwork .

The first floor has a 20-seat bar, live music and an open kitchen that allows guests to watch part of the chefs' work.

The second level has a completely different atmosphere , with private and semi-private spaces designed for those looking for a more secluded dinner.

But if there's one thing that defines the restaurant, it's the food that accompanies the entire experience.

A5 Wagyu, Tomahawk and lobster mac and cheese

The 1587 Prime menu centers on high-end cuts of meat. Among its options is Japanese A5 Wagyu , as well as a 2.5-pound Wagyu Tomahawk that is carved tableside.

The menu also includes seafood, truffle fries and lobster mac and cheese, while the cocktail program was developed by mixologist Juan Carlos Santana.

How much does it cost to eat at 1587 Prime?

Dining at 1587 Prime can cost more than $100 per person , although the final bill can rise depending on the cuts of meat, drinks and other dishes ordered.

articles.title: Travis Kelce enthusiastically supports Caitlin Clark on Instagram as Taylor Swift's fandom reacts
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs star showed his appreciation for Caitlin Clark's latest Nike collection
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs star showed his appreciation for Caitlin Clark's latest Nike collection
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce has offered Caitlin Clark a short but enthusiastic message of support on Instagram, drawing attention from fans following the Indiana Fever star's latest social-media post.

Clark shared a collection of photos on Saturday highlighting her life away from the basketball court, including multiple versions of her signature Nike Caitlin 1 shoe and a cereal product connected to her identity as one of basketball's most prominent three-point shooters.

“Just a very ordinary day on set,” Clark wrote on Instagram.

Kelce quickly noticed the different colorways of Clark's signature shoe and responded in the comments with a message that made his enthusiasm clear, as he used four fire emojis and said: “Every color!!!”

The exchange comes at an interesting point in Clark's season. The Fever have returned from the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup break with their postseason push in full swing, and Clark immediately looked comfortable in her first game back.

Indiana defeated the Toronto Tempo 103-85 on Friday, improving to 27-14. Clark finished with 28 points, six rebounds and 14 assists, recording another double-double as the Fever secured their third consecutive victory.

The official Fever recap confirmed that Clark's 14 assists were part of a dominant offensive performance alongside Kelsey Mitchell , who scored 33 points and broke the WNBA's single-season scoring record.

The victory also marked the Fever's eighth win in their last 10 games, putting them in an important position heading into the final stretch of the regular season.

Caitlin Clark's connection to Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift

Kelce's interaction with Clark also attracted attention because of her well-known connection to his wife, Taylor Swift .

Clark has previously attended Swift's concerts in Indianapolis, while the basketball star has also been seen around the Chiefs.

She was spotted in the same VIP suite as Swift during Kansas City's matchup with the Detroit Lions in 2025, bringing together two of the biggest names in American sports and entertainment.

The relationship between Clark and Swift has become part of the wider cultural attention surrounding the Fever guard. Clark has established a major profile outside basketball through endorsement partnerships and her Nike signature line, while Swift remains closely connected to Kelce and the Chiefs.

Kelce himself has recently been at the center of plenty of attention during Kansas City's season. Swift attended the Chiefs' September 14 game, her first Kansas City game since marrying Kelce, and watched from a star-studded suite alongside family and friends.

On the court, however, Clark's attention is now firmly on the Fever's postseason ambitions.

Her 28-point performance against Toronto came after she and teammate Aliyah Boston helped Team USA win its fifth consecutive FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup title. Clark therefore returned to WNBA action almost immediately after another major international achievement.

The Fever's victory was particularly notable because of Mitchell's record-breaking performance. Mitchell's third-quarter three-pointer took her season total beyond A'ja Wilson 's previous WNBA single-season scoring mark of 1,021 points, giving her 1,034 for the campaign.

Clark's 14 assists, meanwhile, showed that her impact extended beyond scoring. She helped orchestrate an Indiana offense that entered the final portion of the regular season among the league's most productive units.

The timing of Kelce's Instagram comment also means Clark's latest fashion and business ventures are receiving attention while her basketball profile continues to grow.

The Caitlin 1 has become another part of her expanding brand, and the Instagram shoot gave fans a look at several different versions of the shoe.

For the Fever, there is little time to pause. Indiana hosts the Washington Mystics on Sunday at 4 p.m. ET, with the team entering the final games of the regular season focused on its playoff position.

Kelce and the Chiefs also have a busy Sunday ahead. Kansas City is scheduled to face the Indianapolis Colts at 8:20 p.m. ET, meaning both Clark and Kelce will be back in action on the same day.

For now, though, Kelce's four-fire-emoji reaction has added another small connection between the Chiefs star, Clark and the wider fan community surrounding Taylor Swift .

And with Clark continuing to make headlines both on and off the court, even a brief Instagram comment from Kelce was enough to attract plenty of attention.

articles.title: "I literally drenched her in sweat": Pat McAfee reveals his awkward first encounter with Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: The ESPN personality finally got a proper chance to meet Taylor Swift inside Travis Kelce's suite, but the encounter did not go quite as planned after McAfee arrived covered in sweat
articles.summary: The ESPN personality finally got a proper chance to meet Taylor Swift inside Travis Kelce's suite, but the encounter did not go quite as planned after McAfee arrived covered in sweat
articles.body:
P at McAfee has shared an unusually memorable story about his first proper conversation with Taylor Swift , and it involved a selfie, a hug and considerably more sweat than the ESPN personality would have preferred.

McAfee was working Kansas City Chiefs-Denver Broncos coverage at Arrowhead Stadium on September 14 when he made his way into the private suite occupied by Swift , her mother Andrea , Travis Kelce 's family and several celebrity guests.

The Chiefs eventually won the game 31-10, but McAfee's interaction with Swift became one of the more entertaining stories to emerge from the night.

The sports personality explained on his self-titled ESPN program that he had already briefly encountered Swift at her July wedding to Kelce , but the Chiefs ' season opener gave him an opportunity to actually speak with her.

The situation immediately became memorable for an entirely different reason: "Got a chance to chitchat with Miss Taylor Swift last night. Huge day… On the way out, I go, ‘Miss Taylor, is there any way I can get a selfie with you?’ She said, ‘Absolutely!’"

McAfee said Swift was welcoming when he approached her and recalled the exchange before describing the hug that followed: "She was so kind. So hospitable. I go, ‘Miss Taylor’, and she goes, ‘Pat!’ I go, ‘How are you?’"

The problem was that McAfee had arrived in the suite after spending time working around the stadium, and the conditions had left him sweating heavily.

He acted out the hug during his show before delivering the punchline: "Just sweat all over her."

McAfee then remembered immediately apologizing to Swift for the awkward introduction: "So sorry that this happened. Great to meet you. You're the best."

The story was confirmed by other accounts of the evening, with McAfee explaining that he had been "dripping in sweat" after making his way through the stadium. People reported that Swift responded warmly and that she was "all in" throughout the game.

Taylor Swift was completely invested in Travis Kelce's season opener

While McAfee's sweaty introduction provided the comic moment, his bigger takeaway from the suite was just how engaged Swift was with the game.

Swift was attending her first Chiefs game since marrying Kelce over the summer. She watched from a suite alongside Andrea Swift, Donna Kelce, Jason Kelce and actor Tom Cruise , among others.

"She's all in," McAfee said of the new Mrs Kelce. "Every snap. It was... that was the most into-it suite we've ever been in."

He particularly remembered Kelce's 59-yard reception during the game: "Everybody in there was all in, and then [Travis] had that [59]-yard catch. We were in there for that. Oh my god. That was like what being a football fan was like… because I don't know how much she was into football. Watching them experience a game was fantastic."

Kelce's long reception was significant beyond the excitement it generated in the suite. During the game, he moved into second place on the NFL's all-time receiving-yardage list for tight ends, passing Jason Witten and moving behind only Pro Football Hall of Famer Tony Gonzalez .

Swift's presence also came despite the fact that the Emmy Awards were taking place the same night in Los Angeles.

Her concert special, Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour | The Final Show, had received five nominations, although its category had already been decided at the Creative Arts Emmys, where The Muppet Show won outstanding variety special (pre-recorded).

Swift also appeared in a prerecorded Law & Order: Special Victims Unit segment featuring host Mariska Hargitay .

McAfee also revealed another detail from inside the high-profile suite: Andrea Swift had brought candied bacon for the group to enjoy while watching the game.

For McAfee , though, the food and football were secondary to the bizarre circumstances of finally getting a proper introduction to one of the world's biggest music stars.

After asking Swift for a selfie, receiving a hug and promptly covering her in sweat, the broadcaster can at least say his first real conversation with her is unlikely to be forgotten by either of them.

And despite the awkward beginning, McAfee's overall impression was clear: Swift appeared completely invested in supporting her husband as Kelce began his 14th NFL season.

articles.title: Colts vs Chiefs: What time does Travis Kelce play today and where to watch the Kansas City game live
articles.standfirst: Kansas City opens the doors of Arrowhead to a wounded Indianapolis in Week 2
articles.summary: Kansas City opens the doors of Arrowhead to a wounded Indianapolis in Week 2
articles.body:
NFL Week 2 brings a clash marked by contrast at Arrowhead Stadium: the Kansas City Chiefs, who got off to a strong start, host an Indianapolis Colts team that arrives battered after a forgettable debut.

One comes from imposing conditions at home; the other, from getting hit by a gale. Here is everything you need to know, plus the time and where to watch it in the United States.

The Chiefs opened the season by crushing Denver 31-10 at Arrowhead. It was a display of complete football: 392 total yards, 220 on the ground at an average of 5.8 per carry, 33:42 of possession, and 52% efficiency on third down (9 of 17). Kansas City scored four touchdowns and completely smothered the opposing offense, which converted just 2 of 12 on third down.

In contrast, the Colts fell at home 23-41 to Baltimore. The score is hardly misleading: Indianapolis allowed 506 total yards, 202 on the ground, and a devastating average of 7.9 yards per play by the opponent. Ten penalties for 86 yards and one turnover finished sinking a debut that slipped out of their hands in the second half.

Colts vs Chiefs: Time and where to watch the Sunday Night Game live

The game will be played at Kansas City's Arrowhead Stadium, home of the Chiefs, and kickoff for today's marquee matchup will be:

About the game broadcast between Kansas City and Indianapolis, you can follow it live from:

Outside the United States, the Chiefs and Colts matchup can be followed with NFL Game Pass International, through DAZN.

Analysis of the main matchup between Colts vs Chiefs

This is, without question, the marquee matchup of this Sunday’s slate. In Week 1, Patrick Mahomes led Kansas City's offense with 184 passing yards and two touchdown passes, along with a rushing touchdown on five attempts inside the red zone.

Mahomes' connection with Travis Kelce is still going strong: the tight end caught 3 receptions for 71 yards (23.7 average), with a long play of 59. But the big star was Kenneth Walker III, who tore up Denver with 173 rushing yards on 23 carries (7.5 average), a long run of 60, and touchdowns on the ground and through the air. Rashee Rice also got on the scoreboard with a receiving touchdown.

Kansas City's defense was just as emphatic. L"Jarius Sneed led the tackles with 8, Drue Tranquill added 7 and delivered a complete performance in the middle of the field, while Mansoor Delane came away with an interception and Felix Anudike-Uzomah had a sack and forced fumble. In total, three sacks and several plays for loss.

Opposite them, the Colts have the pieces to compete despite a poor opening. Jonathan Taylor rushed for 98 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries against Baltimore, although a fumble proved costly for the team.

Daniel Jones completed 19 of 31 for 166 yards, one touchdown and one interception; his most productive receiver was Alec Pierce (4 receptions, 61 yards, 15.3 average), with Josh Downs providing explosiveness (37 yards on two catches). Rookie Tyler Warren caught the team's only passing touchdown.

The betting thermometer reflects the difference in moods: Kansas City enters as the clear favorite, with an implied probability of 70.8% compared to Indianapolis’s 29.2%. The point spread is around -6.5 in favor of the Chiefs, and the total points line moves between 46 and 47.

The fight for the top: Implications on the road to the NFL playoffs and standings in the overall table

In the American Conference, Kansas City is in third place with a 1-0 record, behind Buffalo and Jacksonville. Within the AFC West Division, the Chiefs lead thanks to their +21 point differential, just ahead of Las Vegas (+14).

A win at Arrowhead would solidify their start and keep pace with the Bills, the only team with two victories in the conference. With so much football still ahead, these kinds of home games are the ones a contender cannot afford to let slip away.

Indianapolis opens the season in fourth and last place in the AFC South, with its -18 point differential the worst in the group after the blowout loss it suffered. In the conference standings, they are in 14th place out of 16.

It's not time to sound the alarm after just one week, but a second stumble would leave the Colts on a short leash in a division where Jacksonville has already taken the lead.

What is the game outlook and predictions for Chiefs vs Colts

The numbers and the momentum are pushing in the same direction. Kansas City arrives in top form, with the offensive line asserting itself on the ground, Mahomes in command, and a defense that has already shown it can bite. The Colts have weapons, but they are coming off a display of serious cracks in both protection and discipline.

At Arrowhead, with the market favoring them and home-field advantage, logic points to a Chiefs victory by a margin close to the -6.5 spread, with Walker and Mahomes once again as the main protagonists. An Indianapolis team that corrects its mistakes can keep it close for a while, but the balance tips toward Kansas City.

Kansas City scored four touchdowns and completely smothered the opposing offense, which converted just 2 of 12 on third down.

In contrast, the Colts fell at home 23-41 to Baltimore. The score is hardly misleading: Indianapolis allowed 506 total yards, 202 on the ground, and a devastating average of 7.9 yards per play by the opponent. Ten penalties for 86 yards and one turnover finished sinking a debut that slipped out of their hands in the second half.
Colts vs Chiefs: Time and where to watch the Sunday Night Game live
The game will be played at Kansas City's Arrowhead Stadium, home of the Chiefs, and kickoff for today's marquee matchup will be:
About the game broadcast between Kansas City and Indianapolis, you can follow it live from:
Outside the United States, the Chiefs and Colts matchup can be followed with NFL Game Pass International, through DAZN.
Analysis of the main matchup between Colts vs Chiefs

This is, without question, the marquee matchup of this Sunday’s slate. In Week 1, Patrick Mahomes led Kansas City's offense with 184 passing yards and two touchdown passes, along with a rushing touchdown on five attempts inside the red zone.

Mahomes' connection with Travis Kelce is still going strong: the tight end caught 3 receptions for 71 yards (23.7 average), with a long play of 59. But the big star was Kenneth Walker III, who tore up Denver with 173 rushing yards on 23 carries (7.5 average), a long run of 60, and touchdowns on the ground and through the air. Rashee Rice also got on the scoreboard with a receiving touchdown.

Kansas City's defense was just as emphatic. L"Jarius Sneed led the tackles with 8, Drue Tranquill added 7 and delivered a complete performance in the middle of the field, while Mansoor Delane came away with an interception and Felix Anudike-Uzomah had a sack and forced fumble. In total, three sacks and several plays for loss.

Opposite them, the Colts have the pieces to compete despite a poor opening. Jonathan Taylor rushed for 98 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries against Baltimore, although a fumble proved costly for the team.

Daniel Jones completed 19 of 31 for 166 yards, one touchdown and one interception; his most productive receiver was Alec Pierce (4 receptions, 61 yards, 15.3 average), with Josh Downs providing explosiveness (37 yards on two catches). Rookie Tyler Warren caught the team's only passing touchdown.

The betting thermometer reflects the difference in moods: Kansas City enters as the clear favorite, with an implied probability of 70.8% compared to Indianapolis’s 29.2%. The point spread is around -6.5 in favor of the Chiefs, and the total points line moves between 46 and 47.
