In the American Conference, Kansas City is in third place with a 1-0 record, behind Buffalo and Jacksonville. Within the AFC West Division, the Chiefs lead thanks to their +21 point differential, just ahead of Las Vegas (+14).

A win at Arrowhead would solidify their start and keep pace with the Bills, the only team with two victories in the conference. With so much football still ahead, these kinds of home games are the ones a contender cannot afford to let slip away.

Indianapolis opens the season in fourth and last place in the AFC South, with its -18 point differential the worst in the group after the blowout loss it suffered. In the conference standings, they are in 14th place out of 16.
It's not time to sound the alarm after just one week, but a second stumble would leave the Colts on a short leash in a division where Jacksonville has already taken the lead.

The numbers and the momentum are pushing in the same direction. Kansas City arrives in top form, with the offensive line asserting itself on the ground, Mahomes in command, and a defense that has already shown it can bite. The Colts have weapons, but they are coming off a display of serious cracks in both protection and discipline.

At Arrowhead, with the market favoring them and home-field advantage, logic points to a Chiefs victory by a margin close to the -6.5 spread, with Walker and Mahomes once again as the main protagonists. An Indianapolis team that corrects its mistakes can keep it close for a while, but the balance tips toward Kansas City.

articles.title: NFL punishes Chiefs star Trey Smith for week 1 chop block against the Broncos
articles.standfirst: It was a relatively minor moment in a game the Chiefs controlled from start to finish
articles.summary: It was a relatively minor moment in a game the Chiefs controlled from start to finish
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Chiefs walked away from Week 1 with a convincing victory over the Denver Broncos , but the aftermath has brought some unwanted attention, and a few lighter wallets. After Kenneth Walker III and Rashee Rice faced scrutiny for their touchdown celebrations, Chiefs offensive guard Trey Smith has now taken a financial hit from the NFL.

Smith was fined $6,750 for a fourth-quarter chop block during Kansas City’s 31-10 victory over Denver on Sept. 14, according to the NFL’s official Week 1 accountability report. The penalty occurred with 9:50 remaining in the game.It was a relatively minor moment in a game the Chiefs controlled from start to finish, but the penalty had an immediate impact on one of Kansas City’s final possessions.

What happened on Trey Smith’s chop block?

By the time Smith was flagged, the Chiefs had already established a commanding 31-10 lead. Walker’s touchdown had extended Kansas City’s advantage to 21 points, and Denver had just gone three-and-out. The Chiefs took over at their own 6-yard line and began working the clock.

Kansas City eventually reached its own 34-yard line. With 9:50 remaining, rookie running back Emmett Johnson took a first-down handoff to the left. That was when Smith was penalized for a chop block. A chop block involves an illegal high-low blocking combination against a defender. The penalty erased Johnson’s run and moved Kansas City back 15 yards, turning first-and-10 at the 34 into first-and-25 at the 19.

The Chiefs managed to recover most of the lost yardage on the following play, with Johnson gaining 19 yards. But the possession eventually stalled. Denver's Zach Allen sacked Patrick Mahomes on third down, and Kansas City punted with 7:08 remaining. The penalty therefore gave Denver an opportunity to get the ball back, even though the Broncos remained three touchdowns behind.

Why was Smith fined $6,750?

The amount of Smith's fine was tied to the NFL's collective bargaining rules. The standard fine for a first-offense chop block is higher, but the collective bargaining agreement limits a player's first-offense fine to 10% of his game check.

Smith's 2026 base salary is listed at $1.215 million. That works out to a $67,500 regular-season game check, making 10% exactly $6,750. The NFL's official accountability report lists Smith's fine at that amount and identifies the violation as a fourth-quarter chop block at the 9:50 mark.

There is also a possibility that Smith ultimately gets the money back.

Under the NFL-NFL Players Association disciplinary system , certain first-time fines can be refunded at the end of the season if the player does not repeat the violation. Chop blocks are among the categories covered by that provision. So while Smith has been officially punished, the financial impact may not necessarily be permanent.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs vs Colts game tonight? This is what we know about it
articles.standfirst: Swift is already in Kansas City, but fans may have to wait until kickoff to know whether she attends
articles.summary: Swift is already in Kansas City, but fans may have to wait until kickoff to know whether she attends
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has made a habit of keeping fans guessing before Kansas City Chiefs games, and that has not changed ahead of Sunday night’s matchup with the Indianapolis Colts .

There's been no public confirmation that Swift will attend the September 20 game at Arrowhead Stadium, where the Chiefs are looking to build on their opening-week win.

She rarely announces her NFL plans beforehand, so her status typically remains uncertain until she is seen arriving at the stadium. Still, there are several reasons an appearance would make sense.

Swift was already in Kansas City this weekend, where she joined Travis Kelce at Patrick Mahomes ’ birthday celebration. She also attended the Chiefs ’ season opener against the Denver Broncos , watching from a suite as Kansas City began the year with a 31-10 victory.

Arrowhead the safest bet for Swift sightings

Swift has generally been much more likely to attend Chiefs home games than road contests in recent seasons. That pattern matters ahead of Week 2.

Arrowhead is a familiar setting, and Swift has repeatedly been seen there since her relationship with Kelce became public. A source previously explained to Page Six that security and familiarity can influence where she chooses to attend.

“She’s not going anywhere unless she knows the venue intimately and it has been thoroughly scouted and secured in advance,” the source said.

That helps explain why home games have remained the more reliable setting for Swift appearances.

Sunday’s matchup also comes at a convenient time. Swift was already in the city this weekend, removing the travel question that often surrounds her attendance.

Next week could be much harder

The timing of Kansas City’s upcoming schedule also makes Sunday’s game stand out. The Chiefs travel to Miami in Week 3 on September 27, the same day the MTV Video Music Awards are scheduled to take place in Los Angeles.

Swift has 11 nominations this year and is tied with Beyonce with 30 career VMA wins, leaving her one victory away from becoming the most-awarded artist in the event’s history.

That creates an obvious scheduling conflict if she plans to attend the awards. Even with private travel, watching an afternoon game in Miami and then getting to Los Angeles in time for the red carpet would be difficult.

That doesn't mean Swift will definitely be at Arrowhead on Sunday. She has never made attendance at every Chiefs game a certainty, and there's no official word from her camp.

The circumstances, however, are favorable. She's in Kansas City, she attended the opener, and Sunday’s game is at a stadium she knows well. Fans may not get their answer until the cameras start scanning the suites.

articles.title: Taylor Swift flashes her shiny wedding ring straight into the cameras after Travis Kelce's touchdown
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift proudly showed off her wedding ring while celebrating Travis Kelce’s first touchdown of the season.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift proudly showed off her wedding ring while celebrating Travis Kelce’s first touchdown of the season.
articles.body:
As has become customary, everyone was wondering whether Taylor Swift would once again be at Arrowhead Stadium to support her husband Travis Kelce — and she was. The pop superstar appeared and was captured by the cameras, putting an end to any doubts about her attendance.

She also celebrated in a big way after her husband scored his first touchdown of the season.

Taylor Swift celebrates in style and shows off her ring

The NFL’s legendary tight end delivered a big moment by scoring the Chiefs’ first touchdown and giving Andy Reid’s team a temporary 10-7 lead . That was when the cameras turned toward Taylor Swift, who was seen celebrating enthusiastically.

What caught the most attention was that she proudly showed off her ring, making it clear she was proud of her now-husband, whom she married in a massive ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York on July 3 , 2026.

Last week, Swift was also seen celebrating one of Travis Kelce’s big receptions during a game against the Denver Broncos . The Chiefs went on to win, while Kelce finished the game with three receptions for 71 receiving yards.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes caught drinking strange liquid on live TV as internet triggers wild theories
articles.standfirst: Fans thought Patrick Mahomes was drinking something unusual before the Chiefs game, but the reality was much different.
articles.summary: Fans thought Patrick Mahomes was drinking something unusual before the Chiefs game, but the reality was much different.
articles.body:
Nothing is more impressive than watching Patrick Mahomes recover from a serious knee injury and return to doing what he does best: winning games. Yet in Week 2 of the NFL season , as he tried to lead the Kansas City Chiefs to a 2-0 start, the quarterback became a trending topic for a completely unexpected reason.

Minutes before the matchup against the Indianapolis Colts , photos and videos began circulating on social media showing Mahomes drinking a mysterious yellowish liquid from a small bottle. Speculation spread quickly, with some users even claiming it was vodka.

Nothing could have been further from the truth

What Mahomes was drinking was pickle juice , a beverage the Chiefs have used for years to help prevent and relieve muscle cramps .

The curious moment became a clear example of why it’s best not to jump to conclusions based on a viral video. Although there is no definitive scientific consensus on the effectiveness of pickle juice, its distinctive yellowish color alone was enough to spark a wave of theories that turned out to be completely false.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes is the same as ever: The Chiefs survive in overtime
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes delivers a clutch performance as Harrison Butker seals a wild overtime win for the Chiefs.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes delivers a clutch performance as Harrison Butker seals a wild overtime win for the Chiefs.
articles.body:
Harrison Butke r kicked two field goals in overtime, the second a 40-yarder as time expired that Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III set up, giving the Kansas City Chiefs a 33-30 victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night.

Mahomes finished with 382 yards passing and three touchdowns, Walker ran for 117 yards , and Travis Kelce looked like a younger version of himself with nine catches for 101 yards and a score as the Chiefs improved to 2-0.

Daniel Jones had 210 yards passing with a touchdown and a pick for the Colts. Jonathan Taylor had 92 yards rushing and two TDs.

The Chiefs thought they had won the game earlier in overtime on a bizarre sequence of events.

Butker kicked a 31-yard field goal to give them the lead, and the Colts (0-2) responded on their possession by having Jones throw deep to Laquon Treadwell, who had beaten L'Jarius Snead . Treadwell appeared to be bobbling the ball as he hit the ground, got up after he had completed the catch, had the ball popped loose and watched as the Chiefs pounced on it.

The play was ruled a fumble on the field, but the officials reviewed it and determined Treadwell was down by contact. That gave the Colts a chance to score a go-ahead touchdown, but they ended up having to settle for Spencer Shrader's tying 38-yard field goal.

The Chiefs took over once more with 3:11 left in the extra session, and they handed off to Walker on three straight plays to reach midfield. But the backbreaker for Indianapolis was a 22-yard pass to the running back, which set up Butker's winning kick.

The Colts had chalked up a disastrous defensive performance against Baltimore in Week 1 to communication problems, and they hoped to solve them by having linebacker Akeem Davis-Gaither relay the play calls rather than safety Cam Bynum . But the tweak didn’t seem to make much difference as Kansas City was marched up and down the field throughout the game.

Each of the Chiefs’ first four drives would have produced points had Butker not missed a 51-yard field goal try.

Yet the Colts were able to match Mahomes and Co. blow-for-blow over the first 30 minutes. Tyler Warren had three catches and a touchdown, Josh Downs picked apart a Chiefs secondary missing safety Chamarri Conner for a second straight game, and Taylor had 75 of his rushing yards — the highlight a 24-yard touchdown scamper that gave Indianapolis a 20-17 lead at the break.

The Chiefs allowed Denver to run for just 61 yards total in their 31-10 win last week.

Kansas City finally slowed the Colts’ offense by refusing to give them the ball. The Chiefs held it for all but 2:22 of the third quarter, getting a go-ahead TD pass to Jalen Royals and setting up Butker’s field goal to start the fourth.

Indianapolis answered with an 8 1/2-minute drive that Taylor finished with his second TD run to tie it at 27l with 5:37 to go.

Neither offense could produce points down the stretch, though, leaving the game to be decided in overtime.

articles.title: Long live the king: Travis Kelce rewrites the NFL record books
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs tight end combined another 100-yard performance with a milestone that places him alone at the top of the NFL's all-time yards-after-catch list
articles.summary: The Chiefs tight end combined another 100-yard performance with a milestone that places him alone at the top of the NFL's all-time yards-after-catch list
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce added another major achievement to his already remarkable NFL résumé on Sunday night, helping the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the Indianapolis Colts 33-30 in overtime while simultaneously moving to the top of one of the league's most notable statistical categories.

Kelce finished the dramatic Week 2 contest with nine receptions for 101 yards and a touchdown, giving Patrick Mahomes another dependable target during a game that eventually required overtime to settle.

The Chiefs improved to 2-0 with Harrison Butker 's 40-yard field goal as time expired, while the Colts fell to 0-2.

The performance was significant for Kelce beyond the box score. During the first half, the Chiefs announced that the 36-year-old had surpassed Pro Football Hall of Famer Marshall Faulk for the most receiving yards after the catch in NFL history.

Kansas City's own player profile now lists Kelce with 6,158 career yards after the catch, placing him at the top among tight ends and, following the latest milestone, at the summit across all positions.

He entered the 2026 campaign having already accumulated 443 yards after the catch during the 2025 season.

The record reflects one of the defining characteristics of Kelce's game. Rather than simply making catches at the line of scrimmage and going down, he has repeatedly turned short and intermediate completions into substantial gains by finding space, breaking tackles and creating additional yardage once the ball is in his hands.

That ability was on display again against Indianapolis.

Kelce's touchdown came on a 13-yard connection with Mahomes , giving the Chiefs veteran his first touchdown of the 2026 season. He averaged 11.2 yards per reception against the Colts and was one of the central pieces of an offense that produced 33 points.

Another chapter in an extraordinary Chiefs career

The latest record is another addition to a résumé that already places Kelce among the most productive pass catchers in NFL history.

According to NFL career statistics, Kelce entered the season with 1,092 receptions and 13,174 receiving yards across his career. Through two games of 2026, he has added 12 receptions for 172 yards and a touchdown.

His consistency has been particularly striking for a player now in his 14th NFL season. Kelce has produced multiple 1,000-yard seasons and became the first tight end in league history to record multiple seasons with at least 100 receptions.

His combination of volume, longevity and production has allowed him to accumulate records traditionally associated with wide receivers.

Sunday's achievement came during a game in which Kansas City needed virtually every major contributor to deliver.

Mahomes completed 32 of 47 passes for 382 yards and three touchdowns without an interception. Kenneth Walker III added 117 rushing yards while also contributing 61 receiving yards, and Xavier Worthy and Jalen Royals each caught touchdown passes.

Indianapolis kept the pressure on throughout the night. Jonathan Taylor scored twice, and the Colts eventually forced overtime after the teams traded scores late in regulation.

Kansas City and Indianapolis exchanged field goals during the extra period before Mahomes connected with Walker on a crucial completion to put Butker in position for the decisive kick.

Butker's field goal completed the 33-30 victory and preserved Kansas City's unbeaten start.

For Kelce , however, the result was accompanied by an individual landmark that will remain part of NFL history long after the details of the Colts game fade.

The veteran tight end now owns the league's all-time yards-after-catch record, adding another distinction to a career that continues to produce milestones even in its later stages.

The Chiefs ' attention now turns toward Week 3. Kansas City will travel to Miami to face the Dolphins on Sunday, September 27, with kickoff scheduled for 1 p.m. ET.

After Kelce's latest record-setting night, the Chiefs will continue their pursuit of another deep postseason run with their longtime star still playing a central role in the offense.

articles.title: Who needs Paris? Fans crown Taylor Swift the new queen of KC at Travis Kelce's local hotspots
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift's growing connection to Kansas City has fans defending her decision to spend time in Missouri with husband Travis Kelce and the Chiefs community
articles.summary: Taylor Swift's growing connection to Kansas City has fans defending her decision to spend time in Missouri with husband Travis Kelce and the Chiefs community
articles.body:
T aylor Swift' s latest Kansas City appearance has once again turned an ordinary night out into a social-media event, with fans debating whether the pop superstar has effectively become the newest celebrity fixture of the Chiefs ' hometown.

Swift and her husband, Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce , were spotted at 1587 Prime on Friday, September 18, as they joined Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes for his 31st birthday celebrations.

The restaurant is particularly significant to the group because it is co-owned by Kelce and Mahomes , making the evening as much a gathering of friends and teammates as a celebrity outing.

The appearance came shortly after Swift had already been photographed at the same Kansas City restaurant with Kelce.

Her repeated visits have fueled online discussion about how comfortable she appears to be spending time in the city where her husband plays and has established business interests.

One fan shared footage and praised the couple's appearance, writing: “Taylor and Travis at 1587 Prime celebrating Patrick’s birthday! Taylor looking absolutely beautiful🫠🫠🫠,”

Not everyone viewed the Kansas City lifestyle in quite the same way. Another social-media user took a more sarcastic approach, writing: “ Taylor Swift married a football player and now she spends her evenings at a mid steakhouse in a midwestern convention hotel. Incredible.”

But the criticism prompted other Swift fans to defend the singer's choice to spend her free time in Kansas City rather than constantly seeking out the world's most glamorous destinations.

“It’s their private clubhouse. They are loving life!” one fan wrote.

Another argued that the location itself should not be the focus, writing: “Realizing this and a fine steak house in Paris are a small hair in difference from each other does a lot for your mental health. Not sure if u knew that.”

A third fan pointed out the ownership connection behind the restaurant: “He owns that steak house with Patrick Mahomes you know,”

And another offered a broader defense of Kansas City, writing: “Seems to be okay as far as Kansas City Experience. KCMO is the closest thing to a big city experience out in that area. Has to be wild to be eating at a decent KC restaurant and then OH SNAP Taylor Swift is there,”

Kansas City has become part of Swift and Kelce's new chapter

Swift's relationship with Kansas City has naturally become more prominent since she began dating Kelce .

Her appearances at Chiefs games have repeatedly brought enormous attention to the franchise, but her recent activities suggest her connection with the area extends beyond watching football.

The 1587 Prime outings are particularly notable because they center on a business venture shared by Kelce and Mahomes .

The restaurant takes its name from the players' jersey numbers, 87 for Kelce and 15 for Mahomes , and opened as part of their partnership with hospitality company Noble 33.

Swift's latest Kansas City weekend also came during a particularly busy period for the Chiefs. Mahomes celebrated his birthday on September 17, while Kansas City was preparing for its Week 2 matchup with the Indianapolis Colts .

Swift subsequently attended that game at Arrowhead Stadium, where she watched from Kelce's suite with her parents.

She had already attended Kansas City's season opener against the Denver Broncos on September 14, demonstrating how closely her schedule has become connected to Kelce's football season.

There has also been a major personal change since the beginning of the summer. Swift and Kelce married at Madison Square Garden in New York on July 3, with the ceremony officiated by Adam Sandler and attended by hundreds of guests.

Their post-wedding life has therefore included both high-profile moments and relatively ordinary outings. While Swift remains one of the world's most recognizable entertainers, her recent Kansas City appearances have largely centered on restaurants, Chiefs games and time with Kelce's close circle.

That contrast is precisely what many of her fans appear to appreciate. Rather than viewing Kansas City as a downgrade from international destinations, they see the city as part of the couple's everyday life.

And with Swift continuing to appear around Kelce's hometown while the Chiefs season progresses, the debate over whether she belongs in Kansas City may have already been settled by her actions: for now, the Missouri city appears to be very much part of her new life with the Chiefs star.

articles.title: "Break them all": Andy Reid issues the ultimate challenge to prevent Travis Kelce from retiring
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce's latest NFL record has given Andy Reid another reason to believe his veteran tight end still has plenty left to accomplish in Kansas City
articles.summary: Travis Kelce's latest NFL record has given Andy Reid another reason to believe his veteran tight end still has plenty left to accomplish in Kansas City
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce 's retirement remains one of the biggest questions surrounding the Kansas City Chiefs , but Andy Reid appears to have found a simple way to keep the conversation going: give his longtime tight end more records to chase.

At 36, Kelce is entering the latter stages of a remarkable NFL career. Yet the 2026 season has quickly provided evidence that the veteran remains capable of producing at an elite level.

His latest statement came Sunday night, when he helped Kansas City escape the Indianapolis Colts 33-30 in overtime.

Kelce finished the game with nine receptions for 101 yards and a touchdown, leading the Chiefs in receiving and giving Patrick Mahomes another dependable target during a dramatic contest at Arrowhead Stadium.

Mahomes threw for 382 yards and three touchdowns as Kansas City improved to 2-0. But Kelce's biggest contribution was not simply measured by his stat line.

During the first half, he moved past Pro Football Hall of Famer Marshall Faulk to become the NFL's all-time leader in receiving yards after the catch. Kelce finished the night with 6,288 career yards after the catch, according to the information surrounding the milestone.

Reid's response to yet another achievement from his longtime tight end was characteristically straightforward.

“I see Kelce broke another record. He hangs around long enough, he’ll break all of ‘em,” Matt Foster shared Coach Reid’s response on X.

The comment perfectly captured the unusual position Kelce finds himself in. Rather than simply trying to extend his career, he now has an enormous collection of records within reach, giving him plenty of statistical targets should he decide to continue playing.

The latest milestone also followed a significant achievement from Week 1.

In Kansas City's season-opening victory over the Denver Broncos, Kelce surpassed Jason Witten for second place on the all-time receiving-yardage list among tight ends. His 59-yard catch-and-run helped push his career total beyond Witten's mark.

The Chiefs ' official statistics now list Kelce with 13,174 regular-season receiving yards after two games of the 2026 season.

Travis Kelce still has a long list of records in sight

Kelce's latest performances have made the retirement question increasingly difficult to separate from his production.

Reid has already joked about the possibility of the two longtime Chiefs figures leaving the NFL together. Before the season, when asked whether he would retire before Kelce, Reid avoided making a prediction.

“Oh, my goodness,” Reid said. “How about if I just stay in the middle? How about if we both go out together? How’s that?”

The relationship between the coach and tight end has been central to Kansas City's extraordinary run over the past decade. Kelce entered the league in 2013, while Reid became the Chiefs ' head coach the following year.

Together, they have won three Super Bowls and helped establish Kansas City as one of the NFL's defining teams of the era.

Kelce's statistical résumé is now enormous. He has 1,092 regular-season receptions, 13,174 receiving yards and 83 receiving touchdowns after Week 2, according to NFL.com. He also owns 178 postseason receptions, the most in NFL history.

There are still major postseason milestones available, too. Before the season began, the NFL identified Jerry Rice 's career postseason receiving-yardage record as one of the marks Kelce could potentially challenge.

Rice has 2,245 postseason receiving yards, while Kelce entered 2026 needing 168 yards to move past him. Rice also owns the postseason record for receiving touchdowns with 22.

That does not necessarily mean Kelce intends to remain in the league until every record is within his grasp. His future will ultimately depend on his own decision, physical condition and desire to continue.

For now, however, his comments during the offseason suggested that retirement was not necessarily imminent.

“I still think I can go out and play at a high level, and I want to go out there and prove to myself that I can play at a better level than I did last year,” Kelce said.

“I think that’s probably the biggest thing for me is making sure that I’m accountable for the guys in this room every single play that I’m out there.” That mindset has already translated into production.

Through two games, Kelce has 12 receptions for 172 yards and one touchdown, according to NFL.com.

His 101-yard performance against Indianapolis also gave Kansas City a major offensive boost in a game that required Mahomes and the passing attack to keep pace with an impressive Colts offense.

The question now is not whether Kelce has already accomplished enough to walk away. He clearly has.

The more intriguing question is whether performances like Sunday's give him another reason to keep going.

Reid's challenge was delivered with a joke, but the underlying message was unmistakable: if Kelce continues to hang around, there are still plenty of records for him to break.

And after two weeks of the 2026 season, the Chiefs are showing no signs of wanting their veteran tight end to stop.

articles.title: Taylor Swift can’t contain herself after Travis Kelce touchdown with ultimate “That’s my husband!” scream
articles.summary: Taylor Swift had the ultimate proud-wife reaction after Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift had the ultimate proud-wife reaction after Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season.

Patrick Mahomes connected with Kelce for a 13-yard touchdown during the first quarter of the Chiefs’ game against the Indianapolis Colts, giving Kansas City a 10-7 lead.

The broadcast immediately cut to Taylor celebrating inside a suite at Arrowhead Stadium.

Swift pointed directly at her wedding ring and appeared to shout, “That’s my husband!” before hugging and high-fiving the people around her.

She attended the game alongside her parents, Andrea and Scott Swift, and made it very clear who she was there to support.

articles.title: Taylor Swift makes her feelings clear after controversial Chiefs refereeing decision
articles.summary: Taylor Swift is becoming increasingly immersed in the world of football, and now she is even reacting to referees’ decisions. During a controversial overtime sequence between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Indianapolis Colts, a disputed call gave the Chiefs possession after Laquon Treadwell appeared to have completed a catch. As the Arrowhead Stadium crowd reacted, Swift was caught on camera expressing her disapproval, clearly mouthing “bullshit” as she watched the play unfold, showing that she understands the game well enough to question the officials.

articles.title: Get the look before it sells out: How to snag the $40 tank top Taylor Swift wore at Arrowhead
articles.standfirst: Swift turned an affordable Chiefs tank from Erin Andrews’ WEAR collection into the latest must-have piece
articles.summary: Swift turned an affordable Chiefs tank from Erin Andrews’ WEAR collection into the latest must-have piece
articles.body:
Taylor Swift may be known for stepping out in designer fashion, but her latest Kansas City Chiefs game-day outfit proved that a Swift -approved look does not necessarily require a four-figure budget.

The pop star returned to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, September 20, to support her husband, Travis Kelce , as the Chiefs faced the Indianapolis Colts .

For the occasion, Swift opted for a red Kansas City Chiefs tank top from her friend Erin Andrews' WEAR collection, a piece that originally retailed for $39.99.

The simple choice quickly became a shopping sensation. Multiple retailers reported the tank top selling out after Swift was shown wearing it during the game, meaning fans looking to recreate her outfit may now have to rely on restocks or remaining inventory.

The item is the Kansas City Chiefs WEAR by Erin Andrews Women's Colorblock Tank Top. It features a red-and-black color-block design, distressed Chiefs graphics and a sleeveless cut.

The garment is made from 100% cotton and was designed as a casual game-day piece rather than a traditional jersey.

That low-key approach fit Swift 's latest Arrowhead appearance. She tucked the tank into light-wash jeans and added a black belt, allowing the Chiefs -themed top to remain the focal point of the outfit.

She finished the look with diamond hoop earrings, a pendant necklace and her Cartier Love Unlimited bracelet. The outfit also carried a personal connection. Andrews , the Fox Sports broadcaster and founder of WEAR, is a friend of Swift and Kelce .

Andrews has previously taken credit for helping bring the couple together, making Swift 's decision to wear one of her friend's designs particularly fitting.

This isn't the first time Swift has promoted Andrews' NFL-focused clothing line at a Chiefs game. In 2023, she wore an Andrews WEAR windbreaker to Arrowhead, pairing it with a Balenciaga corset top and leather miniskirt.

Where to find Taylor Swift's $40 Chiefs tank top

The biggest problem for shoppers is availability. The tank was listed at $39.99 by official Chiefs and NFL retailers, but reports following Sunday's game indicated that Swift's appearance helped push the item out of stock.

At the time of the latest retail checks, however, inventory information has been changing rapidly. The official NFL Shop listing has carried the exact Colorblock Tank Top, while the official Kansas City Chiefs Shop listing has also offered the same design. Fanatics' listing has likewise carried the product.

Because Swift 's appearance appears to have triggered a rush of interest, shoppers who cannot find their size should keep checking those official retailers for returned stock or replenishment rather than immediately turning to third-party resellers.

Swift 's fashion choices have already demonstrated how quickly a game-day outfit can become a sought-after item.

At the Chiefs ' previous game against the Denver Broncos , she wore a red gingham polo dress from Gigi Hadid's Guest in Residence line, continuing a recent habit of supporting friends through her wardrobe.

The same pattern was visible again Sunday. Rather than relying on an extravagant designer look, Swift chose a relatively accessible piece connected to someone close to her and Kelce .

Her appearance also generated plenty of attention for reasons beyond fashion. When Kelce scored a touchdown against the Colts , Swift jumped up in the suite, pointed toward her wedding ring and shouted, “That’s my husband!”

She watched the game alongside family members, including her parents and Kelce's mother, Donna. The appearance marked her second consecutive Chiefs game of the 2026 season.

Swift 's Arrowhead wardrobe has therefore become its own storyline, but this particular look could prove especially popular because of its price point.

For fans hoping to copy the outfit, the key is simple: check the official retailers frequently and move quickly if the $39.99 tank returns in stock.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes was drinking vodka according to fans but the truth finally comes to light
articles.summary: NFL fans sparked a viral theory after spotting Patrick Mahomes with a mini bottle before the Chiefs' clash against the Colts, with some speculating that the quarterback was drinking vodka or limoncello. However, the mystery surrounding the bottle's contents has apparently been solved, as Mahomes was actually drinking pickle juice, a practice that has been known for years. The Chiefs encourage their players to drink pickle juice before games to help prevent cramping during competition.

articles.title: Proud Wife Era: Brittany Mahomes celebrates Patrick's return to elite form in thrilling victory over the Colts
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes powered Kansas City to 2-0 with one of his strongest performances since returning from ACL surgery
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes powered Kansas City to 2-0 with one of his strongest performances since returning from ACL surgery
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes didn't need a long caption to sum up what she had just watched. After Patrick Mahomes led the Kansas City Chiefs to a 33-30 overtime victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night, Brittany posted a five-word reaction to her Instagram Story that reflected the chaos of the evening.

“That was a game wow,” she wrote. The Chiefs quarterback completed 32 of 47 passes for 382 yards and three touchdowns as Kansas City improved to 2-0, continuing a strong start to a season that carries extra significance after the team missed the playoffs last year.

Mahomes ’ performance also provided another encouraging sign in his return from the ACL injury he suffered last December.

The final numbers were impressive, but Mahomes made clear afterward that Kansas City had to grind through stretches in which the offense was far from its best.

“I mean, I think guys were resilient, and we just strained to finish,” Mahomes said.

“It wasn't always pretty. There were times we didn't execute at a high level. But guys continued to fight and continued to push and we found a way at the end.”

That ability to recover from mistakes and still close out games has long been one of Kansas City’s defining traits during the Mahomes era. Sunday’s win offered another example, with the Chiefs forced deep into the night before finally putting Indianapolis away.

Brittany Mahomes was living every snap

Brittany ’s reaction went beyond the five-word post. She also reshared a photo from friend Dani Austin Ramirez and acknowledged just how emotionally invested she had been while watching from a suite at Arrowhead.

“Sorry you had to hear me scream and say a lot of bad words for several hours,” Brittany wrote.

Her support has been especially visible during Mahomes ’ comeback from knee surgery.

When the quarterback returned to training camp in July, Brittany celebrated the moment by sharing team footage and writing: “Seeing him back doing what he loves. So thankful.”

Mahomes has previously credited his wife with allowing him to keep his focus on football.

“I think people don’t even realize how much she does,” he said during a 2024 appearance on the “Impaulsive” podcast. “[She’s] a Hall of Fame mom and a Hall of Fame wife.”

The Chiefs now turn their attention to Week 3, when they travel to face the Miami Dolphins on September 27. Kansas City will arrive at 2-0, while Miami is 0-2 after losing to San Francisco.

If Sunday night was any indication, Brittany may want to prepare for another stressful few hours.

When the quarterback returned to training camp in July, Brittany celebrated the moment by sharing team footage and writing: “Seeing him back doing what he loves. So thankful.”
Mahomes has previously credited his wife with allowing him to keep his focus on football.
“I think people don’t even realize how much she does,” he said during a 2024 appearance on the “Impaulsive” podcast. “[She’s] a Hall of Fame mom and a Hall of Fame wife.”
The Chiefs now turn their attention to Week 3, when they travel to face the Miami Dolphins on September 27. Kansas City will arrive at 2-0, while Miami is 0-2 after losing to San Francisco.
If Sunday night was any indication, Brittany may want to prepare for another stressful few hours.

articles.title: Taylor Swift can’t contain herself with ultimate “that’s my husband” scream
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift had the ultimate proud-wife reaction after Travis Kelce found the end zone for the first time this season
articles.summary: Taylor Swift had the ultimate proud-wife reaction after Travis Kelce found the end zone for the first time this season
articles.body:
Taylor Swift still can’t get over the fact that she is married to an NFL superstar, and we can agree that married life has treated Travis Kelce well, as the tight end has started the season on the right foot. ​ ​Kelce found the end zone for the first time this season Sunday night when Patrick Mahomes connected with him for a 13-yard touchdown during the first quarter against the Indianapolis Colts, giving the Chiefs a 10-7 lead . But the touchdown quickly became Taylor’s moment too, as the broadcast cut to her celebrating inside a suite at Arrowhead Stadium.

Swift made sure everyone knew who she was celebrating

Cameras caught the superstar pointing directly at her wedding ring and seemingly shouting that Kelce was her husband before hugging and high-fiving the people around her. Swift attended the game alongside her parents, Andrea and Scott Swift, and made it very clear who she was there to support.

Swift has not been afraid to fully embrace the game, showing that she is her husband’s No. 1 fan while making it clear how proud she is to be his wife. She has taken the time to study football and understand the game , knowing what she is talking about and, most importantly, recognizing when her husband makes big plays that give the Chiefs an advantage . She is not just cheering for Kelce either, as she has become a fan of the Chiefs.

Taylor is fully embracing her WAG era

The moment instantly set social media ablaze, with fans celebrating her full arrival into NFL WAG status as Kelce finished the game with nine catches for 101 yards and a touchdown. Swift takes her WAG role seriously and has no problem making sure everyone in the stadium knows exactly who she is there to support.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes is rewriting what it means to be “Mr. Clutch” with an overtime record no quarterback can match
articles.standfirst: No player has had more winning drives (31) in the fourth quarter or overtime since Patrick Mahomes's first start in 2018
articles.summary: No player has had more winning drives (31) in the fourth quarter or overtime since Patrick Mahomes's first start in 2018
articles.body:
Are the Kansas City Chiefs and Patrick Mahomes fully back? A spotless 2-0 record and scoring over 30 points in both contests certainly validates a phenomenal offseason that featured the addition of this season's rushing leader and reigning Super Bowl MVP, Kenneth Walker III .

Unlike their comfortable Week 1 win over the Broncos, this Sunday night required the Chiefs to sweat out a thrilling 33-30 overtime victory against the Indianapolis Colts , leaning heavily on their elite offensive playmakers to deliver when it mattered most.

Patrick Mahomes shredded the secondary for 382 passing yards and three touchdowns (his highest single-game passing mark since 2023 ), Travis Kelce hauled in nine receptions for 101 yards and a touchdown , and Walker continued his dominant form by churning out 117 rushing yards alongside 61 receiving yards .

Patrick Mahomes Extends Historic Overtime Streak

When the Colts knotted the score at 30-30 late in extra time, nearly everyone packed inside Arrowhead Stadium and watching on television knew that the remaining 3 minutes and 15 seconds were more than enough time for Mahomes to orchestrate a game-winning march into field goal range for reliable kicker Harrison Butker .

True to form, the Chiefs drove methodically down to the Indianapolis 24-yard line, setting the stage for Butker to drill a 40-yard field goal with a mere one second remaining on the overtime clock.

This clutch sequence marked Mahomes' 31st fourth-quarter or overtime game-winning drive since stepping into the starting role in 2018 , the most of any player over that span, reinforcing why he remains the league's ultimate "Mr. Clutch" and why opponents dare not leave him with the ball with the game on the line.

The dramatic overtime triumph pushes Mahomes to an unblemished 8-0 record in regular-season overtime games , officially passing Jake Plummer for the longest winning streak by a starting quarterback at any point in their career since the NFL introduced overtime rules in 1974 .

There is a distinct reason why all three of his Super Bowl victories required overcoming deficits of at least 10 points, and why he has now accumulated the most total wins (114) , including playoffs, for any quarterback in their first 10 seasons , despite currently playing in just his ninth year as a starter.

Looking ahead, the Chiefs face a pair of crucial road tests against Miami and Las Vegas , matchups they are heavily favored to control as they aim to climb to 4-0 before taking an early Week 5 bye . Watch out, NFL, the reigning power is fully back and hitting its stride.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes speaks out and addresses theories that “the Chiefs get all the calls in their favor”
articles.standfirst: The quarterback joked about the reaction a controversial overtime ruling could have sparked
articles.summary: The quarterback joked about the reaction a controversial overtime ruling could have sparked
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes has heard the jokes, seen the complaints and knows the reputation that follows the Kansas City Chiefs whenever a close officiating call swings their way.

So when replay review overturned what initially looked like a game-ending fumble in Kansas City’s favor during Sunday night’s 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts , Mahomes couldn't resist addressing it afterward.

“We had the big play in overtime where we think we stripped the ball,” Mahomes told reporters. “I was actually kinda glad, I didn’t want to see Twitter’s reaction if they would’ve called it a fumble.”

It was a revealing moment because Mahomes was acknowledging something Chiefs fans and rivals have debated for years, the perception that Kansas City benefits from favorable officiating in big moments.

Whether that criticism is fair is another question. What is clear is that Mahomes is fully aware of it.

Mahomes’ late-game composure

The officiating discussion came after another game in which Kansas City had to fight its way through adversity. Mahomes completed 32 of 47 passes for 382 yards and three touchdowns as the Chiefs improved to 2-0.

Travis Kelce caught nine passes for 101 yards and scored his first touchdown of the season, while Kansas City repeatedly answered after falling behind.

The Chiefs were unable to end the game on the overturned fumble, but Mahomes still found a way to finish the job.

“I mean, I think guys were resilient, and we just strained to finish,” he said. “It wasn't always pretty. There were times we didn't execute at a high level. But guys continued to fight and continued to push and we found a way at the end.”

That has become a familiar theme throughout Mahomes ’ career. Mahomes keeps adding to his reputation in close games Sunday’s win also reinforced just how difficult Kansas City has been to put away with Mahomes at quarterback.

Including the playoffs, he now has 31 game-winning drives in the fourth quarter or overtime since 2018. He also improved to 8-0 as a starter in overtime games, extending what is already the best undefeated overtime record by a starting quarterback in NFL history.

Those numbers explain why even controversial moments involving the Chiefs draw such intense scrutiny. Kansas City has spent years playing meaningful games, and Mahomes has repeatedly delivered when the margin is thin.

Mahomes understood the moment

Mahomes ’ comment wasn't a complaint about the officials. It was a joke about the reaction he knew would follow if Kansas City had benefited from the ruling.

That self-awareness seemed to land well with fans because it acknowledged the broader conversation without turning it into an argument.

The Chiefs now head to Miami in Week 3 with a chance to move to 3-0. And if another close call goes their way, Mahomes already knows what the internet will say.

articles.title: Taylor Swift Unfiltered: The popstar loses her cool and swears over controversial call against the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: Swift was visibly furious when replay review wiped out a potential game-ending turnover
articles.summary: Swift was visibly furious when replay review wiped out a potential game-ending turnover
articles.body:
Taylor Swift had already spent most of Sunday night riding the emotional swings of a tense Chiefs-Colts matchup. Then came the overtime replay decision that briefly convinced Arrowhead Stadium that Kansas City had been denied a game-winning turnover.

New footage showed Swift reacting in disbelief after officials overturned a fumble recovery that initially appeared to end the game in the Chiefs’ favor.

As the ruling was announced, Swift appeared to mouth: “That’s bulls***.”

The clip quickly spread online, adding another layer to a chaotic finish that had already left players, commentators and fans struggling to process what they had seen.

Replay review flips game on its head

The pivotal play came in overtime when Indianapolis completed a deep pass to Laquon Treadwell .

Treadwell went to the ground, got back up and continued running. Chiefs defender Nohl Williams then knocked the ball loose, and Kansas City recovered.

The initial ruling treated Treadwell as a live runner, meaning the Chiefs appeared to have forced a game-ending turnover. Then came the review.

Officials determined that L’Jarius Sneed had touched Treadwell on the hip while the receiver was down and had possession, making him down by contact before the ball came free. The decision drew immediate disbelief inside the stadium.

“Absolutely insane! Wow!” NBC announcer Mike Tirico said. Cris Collinsworth was just as stunned.

“I've never been a part of a game where anything like that happened to decide the game,” Collinsworth said. “Wow!”

Swift ’s reaction mirrored the frustration around the stadium, especially after Kansas City had already started celebrating what it believed was the winning play.

Indianapolis suddenly had possession back and a chance to steal the game.

The Colts moved within striking distance, but the drive stalled after consecutive Jonathan Taylor runs lost yardage and Daniel Jones was unable to create enough on third down.

Coach Shane Steichen ultimately settled for a field goal. That left Patrick Mahomes with one more possession, and Kansas City needed only three points.

Mahomes delivered. He drove the Chiefs into range, and Harrison Butker converted a 40-yard field goal to seal the 33-30 win.

Swift’s night full of emotion

The overturned fumble was not the only moment that put Swift on camera.

Travis Kelce finished with nine catches for 101 yards and a touchdown, producing his first 100-yard game since the 2024 AFC Divisional Round.

After Kelce scored, Swift celebrated wildly and appeared to point to her wedding ring while saying: “That’s my husband!”

By the end of the night, she had gone from celebrating one of Kelce ’s best performances in years to raging at an overturned call, then finally watching Kansas City escape with the win anyway.

The Chiefs got the result. Swift still made sure everyone knew exactly what she thought of the ruling.

articles.title: “It's not about the shape I'm in”: Travis Kelce puts stop to awkward questions about weight after driving Taylor Swift and Chiefs Kingdom wild against the Colts
articles.standfirst: Kelce delivered a vintage night against Indianapolis, then brushed off body talk after the game
articles.summary: Kelce delivered a vintage night against Indianapolis, then brushed off body talk after the game
articles.body:
Travis Kelce had already answered questions about his age, his workload and whether he could still produce at an elite level. After Sunday night, the conversation shifted to something even more personal.

The Kansas City Chiefs tight end turned back the clock in a 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts, catching nine passes for 101 yards and scoring his first touchdown of the season.

Taylor Swift , watching from a suite at Arrowhead Stadium, exploded in celebration when Patrick Mahomes found Kelce for the score. Cameras caught her pointing to her ring finger and shouting, “That’s my husband!”

Kelce ’s performance was his first 100-yard regular-season game since 2024 and reinforced the sense that he has started his 14th NFL season in better form than many expected. Then came an unusual postgame question.

Kelce brushes off offseason weight chatter

During an appearance on SportsCenter, Scott Van Pelt referenced a viral training-camp photo that sparked discussion about Kelce ’s weight and conditioning.

“There was a picture that went viral of you in camp as if you were some fat guy,” Van Pelt said.

Kelce didn't take the bait: “You know what, I can't say enough about the support system and the people that I have around me and just the ability to focus in on the goal and task, and one of them through training camp was to get in the best shape of my life,” he said.

The 36-year-old credited Andy Reid ’s demanding camp with helping prepare Kansas City for games like Sunday’s.

“Coach Reid set the bar high for everyone in that building to get through training camp, and training camp was a lot of dog days,” Kelce said.

Grit matters more than appearance

Kelce ’s real point came when he shifted the conversation away from how he looks and toward how he plays.

“It's not as much about the shape that I look like I'm in," Kelce added. "It's about the grit that I have and the heart that I have to get that ball north and find a way to get a victory for our team.”

Sunday gave him plenty of evidence. Kelce was Mahomes ’ most productive target and looked sharper than he did for stretches last season, helping the Chiefs improve to 2-0.

Mahomes also earns huge praise

Kelce saved some of his strongest words for Mahomes , who threw for 382 yards and three touchdowns.

“I can't say enough about who that guy is as a person, how he leads this team, and how he just shows up every single day,” Kelce said. “15 is one of the best fathers, one of the best husbands, and one of the best teammates I've ever played with.”

Kansas City now heads to Miami in Week 3 with momentum building around both stars. And after Sunday night, the questions about Kelce ’s conditioning suddenly look a lot less important than the numbers he is putting up.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes’ glamorous party takes a wild turn as she unleashes bad words during intense Chiefs game
articles.standfirst: Brittany Mahomes couldn’t hide her emotions as the Chiefs battled through a wild finish against the Colts
articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes couldn’t hide her emotions as the Chiefs battled through a wild finish against the Colts
articles.body:
T here is no doubt Brittany Mahomes gets fully invested in Chiefs games and lives every moment on the field . As the wife of quarterback Patrick Mahomes, she likely feels the same nerves as her husband, especially as he continues to return from a serious injury. With the pressure building, Brittany made sure everyone in the suite knew exactly how intense the game felt.

The Chiefs were far from having an easy afternoon against the Indianapolis Colts, turning the game into an emotional roller coaster for everyone watching. The players and the fans in the stands had to push through the difficult moments as Kansas City fought to keep its season moving and eventually secured a 33-30 overtime victory.

The party was already underway

Before the game even started, the party was already taking place inside the Mahomes’ suite. Brittany and her friend Dani Austin, a model and the founder of Divi Growth Care, hosted a glam event for the brand’s hairsprays . Brittany recently became the face of Divi, making the Chiefs suite the perfect setting to showcase the partnership.

Brittany teamed up with Divi to host the glam suite for several of the Chiefs’ WAGs before kickoff , including Ana Demmer, who got engaged to Kansas City offensive lineman Creed Humphrey in June. The group got ready to support the Chiefs, but after the thriller against the Colts, the celebration inside the suite took a chaotic turn.

Brittany couldn’t hold back

Brittany later revealed on Instagram just how intense things became in the suite . As the Chiefs held off the Colts 33-30 in overtime, she spent hours screaming and letting plenty of curse words fly . She apologized to Dani for having to hear her yelling for several hours while sharing an Instagram Story of the two posing together in Chiefs colors, adding laughing and blushing emojis.

Her husband also played a key role in the dramatic finish . Patrick Mahomes connected with running back Kenneth Walker III for a clutch 22-yard gain, setting up Harrison Butker’s 40-yard game-winning field goal in overtime.

After all the nerves, yelling and chaos, the WAGs’ day in the suite ended with the Chiefs walking away with the win.
